job.title: DATA & AI PRODUCT MANAGER
job.snippet:
אנו מחפשים Product Manager מנוסה ובעל/ת ניסיון מוכח לצוות ה- DATA & AI שלנו.
מועמד/ת המסוגל/ת להוביל פרויקטים מורכבים בתוך ארגון פיננסי גדול ומוסדר – תוך ניהול אפקטיבי של ממשקים מרובים, התמודדות עם חסמים ארגוניים ומורכבויות, ויכולת לקדם יעדים גם בסביבות עם אי-ודאות גבוהה.
בעל/ת יכולת מנהיגות, נחישות ועמידות, לצד כישורי תקשורת ויחסי אנוש מעולים – המאפשרים הנעת גורמים שונים לפעולה ויצירת שיתופי פעולה פרודוקטיביים.
מה תוביל/י? תשמש/י כגורם המחבר בין העולם העסקי, הדאטה והטכנולוגיה, ותוביל/י פרויקטים ממשלב הגדרת הבעיה העסקית ועד להטמעה מלאה בשטח, מדידת ערך עסקי ומסירה מסודרת למנהל/ת המוצר הייעודי/ת.
התפקיד כולל:
 הגדרת בעיות עסקיות, זיהוי הזדמנויות לפתרונות מבוססי AI ותרגומן לפתרונות טכנולוגיים ישימים
 כתיבת מסמכי דרישות (BRD/PRD)
 ניהול Backlog, Roadmap ותיעדוף משימות לפי ערך עסקי
 הובלת POCs בחינת טכנולוגיות ומוצרי GenAI חדשים וזיהוי הפתרונות המתאימים ביותר לצרכים העסקיים
 עבודה רוחבית ומתמשכת מול גורמים עסקיים, טכנולוגיים, הנהלה, ציות ורגולציה
 ניהול אסקלציות, עדכוני סטטוס ושמירה על קצב התקדמות  גם מול מורכבויות ארגוניות
 הגדרת KPIs, מדידת הצלחה ווידוא שהפרויקט מניב ערך עסקי מדיד
מה אנחנו מחפשים ?
 לפחות 3 שנות ניסיון באחד מהתחומים: ניתוח מערכות / ניהול מוצר או פרויקטים / Business Analysis
 יכולת מוכחת לכתיבת אפיונים פונקציונליים וטכניים מתוך דרישות עסקיות
 ניסיון בהובלת פרויקטים טכנולוגיים מקצה לקצה, כולל בעולמות ה-AI
 הבנה מערכתית רחבה של תהליכים ארגוניים מורכבים
 ניסיון בעבודה עם מערכות Enterprise ונתונים מורכבים
 ניסיון בעבודה עם DATA והגדרת KPIs
 כישורי תקשורת בינאישית ברמה גבוהה  יכולת להניע גורמים מגוונים לפעולה ולהעביר מסרים טכניים לכל קהל
 ניסיון בכתיבת מסמכי אפיון פונקציונליים וטכניים
 ניסיון בניהול ממשקים מרובים במקביל (עסקי, טכנולוגי, הנהלה)
 יכולת גבוהה לפתרון בעיות ופירוק אתגרים עסקיים מורכבים למשימות טכנולוגיות ישימות
 תואר ראשון בהנדסת תעשייה וניהול / מערכות מידע / מדעי המחשבים / תחום רלוונטי
 ניסיון קודם בשירותים פיננסיים, פינטק או תעשיות עתירות רגולציה
יתרון משמעותי:
 ניסיון בתכנון והטמעה של יישומי Generative AI ופתרונות RAG
 היכרות עם טכנולוגיות ענן ופתרונות AI על גבי AWS
 ניסיון בהובלת POCs ובחינת מוצרים וטכנולוגיות GenAI חדשות
 ניסיון בסביבת עבודה Low Code / No Code
למה כדאי לך לבוא?
זהו תפקיד מוביל ובעל השפעה מהותית על ליבת הפעילות הארגונית. תקבל/י בעלות מלאה על פרויקטים אסטרטגיים המשפיעים על הארגון לעומק, תעבוד/י עם הטכנולוגיות המתקדמות ביותר בתחום ה-AI, ותהיה/י שחקן/ית מרכזי/ת בצומת שבין עסקים לטכנולוגיה באחד הבנקים הגדולים בישראל.

job.title: Product Manager
job.snippet:
Skana Robotics is a defense-tech startup building the future of the maritime domain through autonomous systems and fleet-level software. We operate at the fascinating junction of AI, robotics, and the sea. We build both hardware and software, featuring an amazing team and a hangar full of autonomous vessels.
We are seeking a highly motivated and technically oriented ASV Product Manager to lead the development and execution of complex multidisciplinary products. This role combines product ownership with program execution responsibilities and serves as a key interface between engineering teams, customers, operations, and company leadership.
The ideal candidate is comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment, possesses strong technical background, and has proven experience driving sophisticated systems from concept through deployment and operational use.
In this role, you will own multidisciplinary product management spanning the full development journey from the lab, through the production floor, to sea and field conditions. You will work with vessels operated both via remote tele-operation and in full autonomy. You will develop vessels of varying sizes and challenges, driven by the evolving demand across the industry and the global maritime domain.
Product Management
Define and maintain product requirements based on customer needs, operational use cases, and business objectives.
Develop and manage product roadmaps, ensuring alignment with company strategy and customer priorities.
Translate high-level requirements into clear technical specifications and actionable development plans.
Work closely with customers, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to continuously refine product capabilities.
Support product validation, demonstrations, field deployments, and feedback collection.
Project Management
Lead end-to-end execution of multidisciplinary development programs, from concept and design through integration, testing, and delivery.
Build and maintain development plans, schedules, milestones, and deliverables.
Track progress, identify risks and dependencies, and drive mitigation plans.
Coordinate activities across software, AI, embedded, electrical, mechanical, autonomy, and systems engineering teams.
Facilitate cross-functional communication and ensure alignment between all stakeholders.
Manage external vendors, subcontractors, and strategic partners as needed.
Systems Integration & Field Activities
Support system integration efforts and verification activities.

job.title: Principal Product Manager - AI Agent Platform
job.snippet:
About Payoneer
Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.
By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.
Glilot
Hybrid
Full-time
Payoneer is building the AI platform that will enable teams across the company to create, deploy, and operate AI agents safely, consistently, and at scale.
We are looking for a
Principal Product Manager to lead our AI Control Plane
, the platform layer that allows developers, and over time broader teams across Payoneer, to build agents without having to solve the underlying infrastructure challenges themselves.
The vision is simple: teams should be able to focus on
what an agent needs to accomplish, the business outcome it should drive, and how it should behave
, while the platform takes care of the infrastructure, controls, governance, and reusable capabilities required to make it work reliably.
This is not a role for someone who has only shipped individual AI features or customer-facing products. We are looking for a product leader who has built
internal platforms that other teams build on
, understands Agentic AI deeply, and is excited by the challenge of creating foundational capabilities that can unlock AI across an entire organization.
You will operate at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Architecture, Security, and AI, helping shape how Payoneer builds and scales agentic products for the future.
What You'll Do
Own the AI Control Plane. Define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the platform that enables teams across Payoneer to build and operate AI agents.
Build for builders. Create a platform experience that allows developers and other teams to focus on business logic and agent behavior while the platform handles the underlying complexity.
Create reusable platform capabilities. Define common services, patterns, and infrastructure that can support multiple agents, teams, and use cases rather than one-off implementations.
Shape the agent infrastructure. Partner deeply with Engineering and Architecture on the capabilities required to build, manage, and scale agentic systems.
Establish control and governance. Define how users, permissions, policies, monitoring, risk, and governance should work across the agent ecosystem.
Make agents observable and manageable. Build the capabilities needed to understand how agents behave, where they fail, how they are being used, and how teams can operate them safely.
Drive platform adoption. Make the platform simple enough and valuable enough that teams choose to build on it rather than creating their own infrastructure.
Set the product standards. Define what good looks like for agent infrastructure, platform quality, scalability, developer experience, and operational readiness.
Lead through ambiguity. This is a rapidly evolving space. You will make decisions with incomplete information, evaluate new technologies quickly, and turn emerging capabilities into a coherent platform strategy.
Move fast. We are accelerating significantly in this area and are looking for someone who can bring relevant experience from day one and quickly become a driving force behind the platform.
Who You Are
An experienced product leader. You have 9+ years of Product Management experience, with a track record of owning complex, technical products.
A proven platform builder. You have built or led an internal platform that other teams, products, or developers rely on and build on top of.
Principal-level in scope and impact. You have led complex, cross-organizational product areas with a high degree of independence, ambiguity, technical complexity, and influence.
Deeply fluent in Agentic AI. You understand how agentic systems work beyond the surface level and can engage meaningfully on agent architecture, orchestration, tools, context, control, reliability, and lifecycle.
Platform-minded. You naturally think in reusable capabilities, common infrastructure, self-service, and scalability rather than solving one use case at a time.
Technically strong. You can partner closely with senior engineers and architects, understand technical trade-offs, and translate infrastructure complexity into clear product decisions.
Comfortable building products for internal users. You do not need your product to be directly customer-facing to see its impact. You are motivated by enabling many teams and products through the capabilities you create.
Experienced in 0→1 and transformation. You know how to define a platform before all the answers are known, establish product principles, and evolve capabilities as adoption grows.
Strong at influence without authority. You can align Engineering, Architecture, Security, Product, and other stakeholders around a shared platform strategy.
What Could Set You Apart
Experience building an AI Platform, Agent Platform, LLM Platform, Developer Platform, or other core technical platform.
Experience with AI Agents or Agentic Systems.
Experience with areas such as agent orchestration, tool use, MCP, evaluation, guardrails, observability, monitoring, human-in-the-loop, permissions, governance, or policy management.
Experience building self-service capabilities for developers or internal product teams.
Experience with SDKs, APIs, developer tooling, platform adoption, or developer experience.
Experience making build-vs-buy decisions around AI infrastructure or third-party technologies.
The Payoneer Ways of Working
Act as our customer’s partner on the inside
Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.
Do it. Own it.
Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.
Continuously improve
Always striving for a higher standard than our last.
Build Each Other Up
Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.
If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.
We are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please speak to the recruiter managing the role for any adjustments. Decisions about requests for reasonable accommodation are made on a case-by-case basis.

job.title: AI & Technology Transformation Manager
job.snippet:
AI & Technology Transformation Manager
Shape the way people find love.
Are you ready to build the operational architecture of an AI-first company? Mylo isn't just another dating app. It's an AI matchmaker built to find love - and we need an
AI & Technology Transformation Manager
to ensure our internal culture, systems, workflows, and tools move as fast as the AI technology we build. Dating is broken. Together, we're fixing it.
Based in the heart of Tel Aviv, we're a dynamic startup with big dreams and an even bigger mission. As we expand into the U.S., we expect every department — from product and engineering to marketing, HR, and ops — to work with AI natively. You will lead this mission, integrating cutting-edge technology, automation, and AI workflows across the entire organization.
What You'll Do
Drive AI-First Operations:
Audit, design, and implement AI-driven workflows and tools across engineering, product, marketing, HR, and customer operations to maximize speed and quality.
Implement Enterprise Tech & Automation:
Identify, test, and deploy emerging AI tools, LLM APIs, and internal automation (via platforms like n8n, Zapier, custom scripts, or internal bots).
Champion AI Adoption:
Lead hands-on workshops, training sessions, and continuous education to elevate the team’s fluency in prompting, workflow automation, and tool leverage.
Optimize Cross-Functional Tech Stack:
Partner with tech leads, CFO, and product management to streamline company software infrastructure and eliminate operational bottlenecks.
Measure Impact & ROI:
Establish clear benchmarks and KPIs to measure productivity gains, cost efficiencies, and velocity improvements from AI initiatives.
Who You Are
Experienced:
Proven track record in operational management, tech transformation, or tech consulting within fast-paced tech companies or startups.
Technically Fluent & AI-Obsessed:
Deep hands-on experience with modern AI models (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini), workflow automation, API integrations, and low-code/no-code stacks.
A Process Architecture Specialist:
You can break down complex business processes, spot inefficiencies instantly, and redesign them into streamlined automated flows.
An Inspiring Change Agent:
Exceptional communication and leadership skills — you know how to teach, convince, and guide teams to adopt new ways of working smoothly.
A Startup Operator:
You execute independently, solve ambiguous operational challenges, and deliver high impact rapidly.
Bonus Points:
Background in software engineering, technical program management (TPM), custom LLM application development, or experience scaling ops in hyper-growth startups.
Work Setup & Perks
Location:
Hybrid position based out of our office in the heart of Tel Aviv.
Impact:
High ownership, a competitive salary, and a key leadership role in building an AI-native startup culture.
Mission:
Work on a product with real emotional depth, cultural relevance, and the power to change lives.
﻿
Sound Like Your Perfect Match?

job.title: Staff Product Manager - Prompt Security
job.snippet:
Our Purpose
At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.
About Us
SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.
Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.
What Are We Looking For?
We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.
As a Staff Product Manager, ou will be tasked with joining our AI Security business unit built from SentinelOne's acquisition of Prompt Security, and one of the company's rocketship bets, growing at a phenomenal rate. You will own — end to end, with high autonomy — the AI security products that some of the world's largest enterprises rely on to adopt AI safely, with a sharp focus on where the industry is already heading: securing agentic AI. You'll set direction and drive daily execution alongside R&D, design, GTM, and customers, turning an urgent market need into best-in-class products that are flying off the shelves. This is a builder's seat on a winning team that ships at high velocity, treats the prototype as the spec, and lives on the AI frontier — where PMs don't just write requirements, they use Claude Code to build and ship features themselves.
If you love owning the outcome, moving fast, and shipping products people actually buy — read on.
What Will You Do?
Primary responsibilities include:
Own products the way a founder would, with real autonomy — you're the CEO of the outcome, not just the backlog. Frame the problem, build working prototypes (the prototype is the spec, not a 40-page PRD), drive it all the way to shipped, polished product at pace, and help run the roadmap sessions that set direction.
Build and ship, hands-on — use Claude Code and other AI tools to prototype, spec, and take features end-to-end yourself, moving faster than teams ever thought possible and raising the bar for how the whole org leverages AI.
Join a high-performing, high-velocity team delivering impactful solutions to some of the world's largest companies — surrounded by excellent people across R&D, design, and GTM who raise the level of everyone around them, with that bar for excellence held across every department.
Think, don't just take orders — treat every request as a hypothesis, dig past the stated ask to the real problem, and define the outcome (not the output) that proves it worked.
Stay laser-focused on users, customers, and GTM — run user interviews and usability sessions, and stay close to exactly how the product is used, how it's messaged, and how it's sold.
Drive commercial success with the field — work directly with sales and marketing to build technical demos, documentation, and enablement that help close deals and make the product sell.
Become the company's recognized expert on securing AI — stay abreast of market trends, emerging threats, and best practices in the fast-moving field of AI agent security, and be the go-to authority in the domain.
What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?
Ideal candidates will have:
4+ years in product management for B2B SaaS security products, with a track record of launching enterprise products that tackle emerging technology risk — and that actually sold.
A builder's instinct — you'd rather show than tell, you prototype your own ideas, and you already build with AI tools like Claude and Claude Code (or you're hungry to).
High autonomy paired with sharp judgment — comfortable making fast calls on incomplete information, ruthless about scope, and skeptical by default. Startup experience a strong plus.
You enjoy both sides of the job — building features, capabilities, and products, and engaging directly with customers and prospects; equally at home working with engineers and with users.
Strong command of enterprise security, compliance, and security operations, plus real familiarity with generative and agentic AI risk — prompt injection, jailbreaking, toxicity, red-teaming, and agentic/MCP systems (e.g., Microsoft Copilot Studio).
Strong verbal and written communication skills — you can explain a complex concept (or your own recommendation) in one clear sentence, to engineers and executives alike.
Founder-grade ownership and a commercial edge — you care as much about whether a product sells as whether it ships.
Why SentinelOne?
AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.
We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:
Equity & Rewards
Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
Time Off & Wellbeing
Competitive leave benefits
Gender-neutral parental leave
Employee Assistant Program
Workout sessions and a Wellness App
Insurance & Financial Security
Medical and insurance benefits
Pension
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
Work Perks & Flexibility
Global home office allowance
Mobile phone reimbursement
Study Fund
SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
SentinelOne participates in the E-Verify Program for all U.S. based roles.
To learn more about how we use AI in our hiring process, please review our AI in Hiring Candidate Disclosure.

job.title: Senior Statistician | Public Sector
job.snippet:
A leading public sector organization is seeking an experienced Statistician to join its Economics & Statistics Division and contribute to advanced statistical research, modeling, and data-driven decision-making.
This is a senior professional role for someone with a strong academic foundation in statistics, proven experience in complex statistical analysis, and the ability to develop robust methodologies and translate research findings into actionable insights.
Key Responsibilities:
Develop and validate advanced statistical models, forecasting tools, simulations, and impact evaluation methodologies.
Conduct complex quantitative analyses, including longitudinal and panel data analysis.
Evaluate the effectiveness of policies, programs, and resource allocation using rigorous statistical methods.
Review statistical models and analytical outputs, identifying methodological limitations, biases, and measurement issues.
Apply Machine Learning and AI techniques to prediction, classification, and large-scale data analysis.
Establish professional standards and provide methodological guidance to analysts and statisticians.
Collaborate with senior stakeholders, multidisciplinary teams, and external partners.
Requirements:
Advanced academic degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Quantitative Economics, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.
At least 3 years of proven experience in advanced statistical analysis, statistical modeling, or quantitative research.
Strong understanding of statistical methodologies, model validation, forecasting, and research design.
Experience working with complex and large-scale datasets.
Proficiency in Python and/or R - an advantage.
Experience in impact evaluation, panel data analysis, or applied quantitative research – a significant advantage.
Excellent interpersonal skills, independent thinking, and the ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders.

job.snippet:

הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
דרוש/ה אחראי/ת תפעול הפצה
אנחנו מחפשים איש/אשת תפעול עם ראש גדול, אחריות ויכולת לעבוד באופן עצמאי, לתפקיד מרכזי במערך הפצה בהקמה.
מה כולל התפקיד?
- אחריות על התפעול השוטף של ההפצה והוצאת קווי חלוקה בזמן.
- עבודה בשטח: הכנת משלוחים, סריקות, העמסה וסידור סחורה.
- עבודה מול מחשב: תעודות משלוח, עדכון נתונים ובקרה על משלוחים.
- עבודה מול נהגים וצוות המחסן, בשיתוף עובד נוסף.
תנאים שווים למתאימים:
עובד\ת חברה מהיום הראשון , קרן השתלמות לפי וותק, עבודה בסביבה נעימה ומכבדת.
אירועים , סיורים וגיבושים, רווחה מפנקת ועוד.
דרישות התפקיד
- ניסיון בתפעול, מחסן או הפצה – יתרון משמעותי.
- שליטה טובה במחשב – חובה.
- רישיון מלגזה – יתרון.
- אחריות אישית גבוהה, סדר, עצמאות ויכולת לפתור בעיות בשטח.
- נכונות לשלב עבודה פיזית ועבודה ממוחשבת.
שעות העבודה: א׳–ה׳, 05:00–15:00, עם אפשרות לשעות נוספות.
מחפשים מישהו שאפשר לסמוך עליו, שיודע לקחת אחריות ולדאוג שהדברים יעבדו כמו שצריך.
* משרה זו פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.

job.snippet:
ק
אחראי/ת תפעול לכפר נופש אלמוג (כ 30 דקות מירושלים)
קיבוץ קלי"ה
אלמוג
1-2 שנים
משרה מלאה
לפני 9 שעות
הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
תחומי אחריות עיקריים:
1.	 ניהול צוותי שטח (משק בית, תחזוקה ומטבח/חדר אוכל):
•	חלוקת משימות יומיות וקביעת סדרי עדיפויות.
•	מעקב אחר ביצוע, פתרון בעיות בזמן אמת ומתן הדרכה שוטפת.
•	קליטה, הכשרה והובלת עובדים חדשים.
•	תכנון סידורי עבודה בהתאם לתפוסה, קבוצות ואירועים.
2.	פיקוח על תקינות, ניקיון ואיכות השירות:
•	ביצוע סיורי שטח יומיים בחדרים, תשתיות ושטחים ציבוריים.
•	בקרה על ניקיון, סדר, תחזוקה ועמידה בנהלים.
•	דיווח ופתיחת קריאות שירות לאחזקה לטיפול בתקלות.
•	מעקב אחר רמות ביצוע ושיפור מתמיד של סטנדרטים.
3.	עבודה מול הקבלה והזמנות:
•	תיאום רציף בנושא כניסות/יציאות אורחים, זמינות חדרים וסטטוס ניקיון.
•	טיפול מיידי בפניות אורחים בשטח (חדר לא מוכן, תקלה, שינוי וכו').
•	תיאום צרכים מיוחדים של אורחים וקבוצות.
4.	 אחריות על מלאי וציוד:
•	ניהול מלאי ציוד ניקיון וציוד טכני.
•	הזמנות רכש ותחזוקה של המחסנים.
•	מעקב אחר שימוש וביצוע בקרה תקופתית על מלאי.
5.	 בטיחות, סדר ונהלים:
•	הקפדה על נהלי בטיחות, תברואה, ניקיון והיגיינה בכל אזורי כפר הנופש.
•	שמירה על סביבת עבודה בטוחה לצוות ולאורחים.
•	דיווח על מפגעים ויישום נהלים לשיפור הבטיחות.
6.	 אחריות על הרצף התפעולי וכיסוי ניהולי:
•	קבלת החלטות בזמן אמת במצבי עומס, תקלות או מחסור בכוח אדם.
•	תיאום בין כל הגורמים בשטח: משק בית, אחזקה, מטבח וקבלה.
•	בעת היעדרות מנהל הכפר- ניהול כולל של המתחם, לרבות ייצוג מול אורחים וספקים
דרישות התפקיד
ניסיון קודם בתפעול ובניהול צוותי עובדים- יתרון.
ניסיון בניהול צוותי שטח, כגון ניקיון, אחזקה או מטבח.- יתרון.
יכולת ארגון, חלוקת משימות ותעדוף עבודה.
יכולת פתרון בעיות ומתן מענה בזמן אמת.
יכולת עבודה מול ממשקים שונים ומתן שירות לאורחים.
נכונות לעבודה במשרה מלאה, 6 ימים בשבוע
* משרה זו פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.

job.snippet:
א
מנהל/ת עבודה שלד לפרוייקט מגורים
אביב מליסרון בע"מ
נתניה

משרה מלאה
לפני 37 דקות
הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
ניהול שוטף של עבודות השלד באתר, משלב ההתארגנות והעלייה לקרקע ועד להשלמת השלד.
ניהול ופיקוח על קבלני משנה, עובדים וספקים באתר.
תכנון, תיאום וניהול סדרי העבודה בהתאם לתוכניות הביצוע ולוחות הזמנים.
פיקוח על איכות הביצוע והתאמתו לתוכניות, למפרטים ולדרישות הפרויקט.
אחריות על קצב התקדמות העבודות, איתור חסמים ומתן פתרונות בזמן אמת.
אחריות על הבטיחות באתר, אכיפת נהלי הבטיחות ועמידה בדרישות החוק והחברה.
ניהול ותיאום אספקת ציוד וחומרים בהתאם להתקדמות הביצוע.
עבודה שוטפת מול מנהל הפרויקט, מהנדסי הביצוע, קבלני המשנה ויתר גורמי האתר.
ניהול יומן עבודה ותיעוד הפעילות באתר
סביבת עבודה מקצועית בחברה יזמית-קבלנית צומחת, פרויקטים למגורים ואפשרות להשתלב לטווח ארוך ולהתפתח יחד איתנו.
דרישות התפקיד
תעודת מנהל/ת עבודה מוסמך/ת בבנייה.
ניסיון קודם של 3 שנים ומעלה כמנהל/ת עבודה שלד בפרויקטים למגורים- חובה.
ניסיון בניהול עבודות שלד בפרויקטים גדולים בהיקפים משמעותיים- יתרון משמעותי.
ניסיון בניהול קבלני משנה וצוותי עבודה באתר.
יכולת קריאת תוכניות והבנה מקצועית גבוהה בתהליכי ביצוע.
שליטה גבוהה בנושאי בטיחות ויכולת להוביל תרבות עבודה בטוחה באתר.
יכולת ניהול, אסרטיביות, סדר וארגון, אחריות ויכולת הנעת ממשקים.
נכונות לעבודה במשרה מלאה באזור המרכז (באתר בנייה בנתניה או בגבעתיים).
* משרה זו פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.

למי עדן דרוש/ה איש/אשת אחזקה לתפקיד הכולל אחריות על תחזוקה שוטפת של מבני החברה, המרכזים הלוגיסטיים, מרכזי ההפצה והמשרדים ברחבי הארץ.
מה כולל התפקיד?
ביצוע עבודות אחזקה שוטפות ותיקונים במבני החברה, לרבות עבודות גבס, צבע, טיח, איטום וריצוף.
ביצוע עבודות אינסטלציה: איתור ותיקון נזילות, החלפת ברזים, טיפול בצנרת ושחרור סתימות.
עבודות נגרות קלה, הרכבת ריהוט, תיקון דלתות והחלפת מנעולים.
טיפול בתקלות חשמל בסיסיות ועבודות תאורה, בהתאם להסמכה.
ביצוע תיקוני בטיחות, חידוש סימונים ושמירה על נראות ותקינות אתרי החברה.
עבודה שוטפת מול מנהלי הסניפים והאתרים, תיעדוף משימות ומתן מענה לקריאות שירות.
ליווי ופיקוח על ספקים וקבלני משנה בהתאם לצורך
דרישות התפקיד
ניסיון של 3–5 שנים לפחות בתפקיד איש/אשת אחזקה או הנדימן – חובה.
ניסיון ושליטה בעבודות גבס, צבע, אינסטלציה, נגרות קלה ושימוש בכלי עבודה מקצועיים – חובה.

הסמכה לעבודה בגובה בתוקף או נכונות לעבור הכשרה – חובה.
עברית ברמה טובה מאוד, כולל קריאה, כתיבה ודיבור – חובה.

ניסיון בתחזוקת מערכות מידוף ומחסנים לוגיסטיים – יתרון.
מה מחכה לך במי עדן?
רכב שירות צמוד ומצויד בכלי עבודה מקצועיים.
תפקיד עצמאי, מגוון ודינמי עם אחריות רחבה.
השתלבות בחברה מובילה ויציבה.
עבודה בפריסה ארצית מול ממשקים מגוונים.

דרישות התפקיד
תואר ראשון בהנדסת תעשייה וניהול / כלכלה / מערכות מידע או תחום רלוונטי אחר
הסמכת PMI/PMP והכשרות בתחום הבינה המלאכותית - יתרון

חשיבה יצירתית ופתרון בעיות, תקשורת גבוהה בכתב ובעל-פה (דוחות, מצגות, מדריכים, הדרכות)

תיאור משרה
אנחנו מחפשים את רכז/ת התרבות ופנאי הבא/ה שלנו – איש שטח, מעולה ביחסי אנוש, בעל תפיסת עולם הומניסטית, אנרגטי יזם ויצירתי. הזדמנות לקחת חלק מוביל בקהילה ולהוביל את תחום התרבות והפנאי של הכפר.

o	אחריות על פיתוח ותפעול תכנית התרבות והפנאי של הכפר.

o	הפקת אירועים תרבותיים וחברתיים  בהתאם לתוכנית התרבות ופנאי ולוח השנה העברי.
o	תפעול אדמיניסטרטיבי ועבודה מול ספקי שירות פנים וחוץ ארגוניים.

o	ממשקי עבודה קרובים מול/עם מערך הרווחה, תעסוקה וכו'.
o	עבודה בכפיפות למנהלת מערך התרבות והפנאי, ובשיתוף עם רכזת הצוות הצעיר.

?	בעל ניסיון מוכח בניהול או הובלת צוות – יתרון משמעותי.
?	שליטה מלאה בישומי מחשב
?	סדר וארגון
?	ניסיון בניהול תקציב – יתרון
?	הכרות מוקדמת עם צרכים מיוחדים - יתרון

job.title: Project Manager
job.snippet:
Company Description
Deutsch & Co. is a private investment company based in Tel Aviv, Israel, focused on elevating AI, Cloud, and Cybersecurity companies into globally recognized brands. The firm works closely with a curated portfolio of ambitious technology businesses, providing hands-on strategic guidance. Core services include branding, positioning, and go-to-market support tailored to each company’s growth stage and market context. Team members collaborate with founders and executive teams on high-impact initiatives that drive international visibility and commercial success.
Role Description
This is a full-time, on-site Project Manager role based in Tel Aviv-Yafo. The Project Manager will oversee end-to-end project planning and execution for branding and go-to-market initiatives across the company’s portfolio, ensuring timelines, budgets, and quality standards are met. Responsibilities include coordinating cross-functional teams, managing stakeholders, tracking deliverables, and reporting progress to leadership. The role involves organizing logistics for project activities, facilitating inspections or reviews of project outputs, and proactively resolving risks and dependencies. The Project Manager will also contribute to process improvement, documentation, and best practices to support scalable, repeatable project delivery.
Qualifications
Candidates should possess strong Project Management skills, including planning, scheduling, risk management, and stakeholder coordination.
Candidates should possess Expeditor and Expediting skills to drive timely completion of tasks and ensure critical project items are delivered as planned.
Candidates should possess Inspection skills to review project outputs, verify compliance with requirements, and maintain quality standards.
Candidates should possess Logistics Management skills to organize resources, manage dependencies, and support smooth project operations.
Relevant experience in technology, investment, consulting, or related fields is beneficial, especially within AI, Cloud, or Cybersecurity domains.
Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to present clear updates to internal and external stakeholders.
Ability to work collaboratively in an on-site team environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced setting.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Management, or a related field; advanced certifications in project management (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, Agile) are an advantage.

קצת על התפקיד למפעל משגב בחטיבת אלתא דרוש/ה מנהל/ת תפעול
ניהול התפעול בפרויקט תוך אחריות לעמידה בתוכניות העבודה, התקציב ואבני הדרך.
עבודה מול גופי הייצור והרכש
בניית תוכניות עבודה ועצי מוצר בהתאם לחוזים ולאבני הדרך בפרויקטים.

job.title: Supply Chain & Logistics Coordinator
job.snippet:
GlassesUSA.com, part of the Optimax Eyewear group, has rapidly grown into a leading direct-to-consumer online eyewear retailer in the U.S. With the largest selection of styles and brands, we make it easy for everyone to find their perfect pair. Our mission is to enrich lives by offering eyewear tailored to individual needs, style preferences, and budgets.
Through innovative technology and AI-driven solutions, GlassesUSA.com is reshaping the eyewear industry and delivering a seamless, personalized shopping experience. We ensure quality, affordability, and efficiency by controlling the full supply chain, from product design and manufacturing to optical lens production and digital experience.

Monitoring Inventory levels on different platforms. (ERP/ Magento).
Assistance with financial-related aspects and follow-ups.
Maintain continuous communication with global warehouses to ensure smooth coordination and information flow.

Track order status and ensure timely delivery.
Support inventory management and distribution processes.
Assist in analyzing reports and key performance indicators for supply chain operations.
Collaborate with operations, sales, and logistics teams to optimize workflows.
What do you need to have?
At least 1 year of experience in a large-scale, in-house inventory company – a must.
High proficiency in Excel - a Must.
Experience working with ERP systems – a Must.
Fluent English (Writing, reading, speaking) – a Must.
Basic experience with Power Query for data transformation - an advantage.
Knowledge with Priority – an advantage.
Experienced with Microsoft Office or similar.
Detail-oriented with an operational mindset; experience with ERP/CRM systems is a plus.
Ability to work effectively in a team and in a dynamic environment.

job.title: Lead Software Engineer (Gameplay)
job.snippet:
Playrix
— одна из самых успешных компаний по разработке мобильных игр, входит в топ-3 компаний-разработчиков мобильных игр в мире. Наши игры установили 2,3 миллиарда раз (треть населения Земли), каждый день в них играет более 30 миллионов людей!
Чтобы повышать качество продуктов и выводить их на новый уровень, мы строим
AI-first-культуру
внутри инженерных команд: разрабатываем агентные воркфлоу, внедряем новые инструменты, измеряем прирост скорости — и в особенности
следим за качеством результата
.
Поэтому мы ищем
сильнейших экспертов,
которые готовы
внедрять и развивать AI практики внутри команд.
При этом опыт работы на С++ и/или в геймдеве совсем необязателен: у нас отличная система адаптации для комфортного перехода новичков с Unity и из других индустрий.
Команды разработки для нас - ядро компании, благодаря которому наши игры растут и развиваются уже 21 год.
Lead Software Engineer
– драйвер технического развития продукта, который ведет и развивает команду с точки зрения архитектуры, качества, культуры разработки и инженерных практик.
В каждом проекте у нас есть основные направления:
Фичевое: разработка событий и мини-игр с нуля (от различных соревнований до мини-игр типа Merge);
Техническое: оптимизация, поддержка технической стабильности, SDK (сокращение скорости загрузки, потребление памяти и др.);
Match-3 и мета: работа с графикой и основной механикой игры (добавление нового функционала, рефакторинг и оптимизация).
Задачи, которые предстоит решать:
People management:
ответственность за
развитие, найм/увольнение, оценку команды;
Развитие процессов внутри команд (как на уровне команды, так и на уровне всей разработки на проекте), включая внедрение и масштабирование AI-практик;
Продюсирование: решение сложных технических проблем на проектах, разработка архитектуры решения и обеспечение быстрой реализации;
Контроль стабильности и качества программной части игры;
Code review и design review;
Программирование и рефакторинг игровой логики.
Наш стек:
Языки: С++, для единичных задач Lua и Python;
Графика: OpenGL ES и Metal;
Собственный движок, похожий на Unity или Unreal, который мы постоянно развиваем (
почитать о нашем движке
);
Продвинутый CI/CD, автоматическое тестирование, процессы code review и многое другое;
AI: Claude, Cursor, Codex с настроенными правилами репозиториев, растущим каталогом специализированных скиллов и агентских режимов под конкретные задачи. MCP-интеграциями с внутренней инфраструктурой (GitHub, Asana, Amplitude и тд). Агентские воркфлоу покрывают весь цикл: от генерации игровых элементов и автотестов до автоматического создания и ревью PR.
Мы ожидаем:

Понятные возможности развития в технического директора, программинг менеджера или проджект менеджера.

job.title: Product Manager – AI-First EdTech (PO / Technical BA welcome)
job.snippet:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Manager – AI-First EdTech (PO / Technical BA welcome) based in Israel.
We are seeking a proactive and technically minded Product Manager to drive the development of an innovative learning management platform supporting licensed healthcare professionals in maintaining their skills and certifications. In this role, you will oversee product features from initial stakeholder discussions through development, testing, and release. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional development and QA teams operating in an AI-first environment, using modern AI tools to accelerate product discovery and delivery. You will also have the opportunity to experiment with AI-powered prototyping to validate ideas before they enter development. This position is ideal for experienced Product Owners, Technical Business Analysts, or developers transitioning into product management. Join a fully remote, collaborative team where innovation, ownership, and continuous learning are central to the product development process.
Accountabilities
Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs, gather requirements, and translate them into clear, actionable, development-ready tickets.
Leverage AI tools to streamline product workflows, including drafting requirements, analyzing data, and improving documentation while maintaining high-quality outputs.
Build clickable prototypes using AI-powered coding tools to test concepts, validate solutions, and gather feedback before development begins.
Own and maintain a well-organized, prioritized product backlog and ensure the product roadmap remains accurate and aligned with business objectives.
Define clear acceptance criteria and conduct feature acceptance testing to verify that deliverables meet requirements before release.
Work closely with developers and QA specialists throughout the development lifecycle to coordinate implementation, testing, and successful releases.
Analyze customer feedback and product usage data to identify improvement opportunities and guide future product decisions.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date product documentation to ensure alignment and effective communication across stakeholders and technical teams.
Balance business priorities, technical considerations, and user needs while communicating product decisions and trade-offs effectively.
Requirements
3–5 years of hands-on experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, Technical Product Management, or Business Analysis within a SaaS environment.
Proven ability to gather requirements, write clear user stories, define acceptance criteria, and translate business needs into technical specifications.
Experience owning or conducting acceptance testing to ensure product features meet expectations before release.
Daily, practical experience using AI tools such as Claude, Claude Code, or similar solutions to improve productivity and support product-related tasks.
Strong curiosity and willingness to explore new AI capabilities, particularly AI-assisted development and rapid prototyping.
Experience working in Agile development environments using tools such as Jira and Confluence.
Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and communicate technical concepts and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in an international remote environment.
Availability to work with at least six hours of overlap with US Eastern Time business hours.
Nice to have: Previous experience creating clickable prototypes using AI-powered coding tools.
Nice to have: Ability to read, understand, and make basic modifications to HTML, CSS, or React.
Nice to have: Experience with Learning Management Systems (LMS), EdTech platforms, or continuing education products.
Nice to have: Background in healthcare or another regulated industry.
Nice to have: Basic SQL knowledge and familiarity with working with product data.
Benefits
Fully remote working arrangement, offering flexibility to work from anywhere in India.
Long-term professional opportunity within an innovative, AI-first product development environment.
Opportunity to work on a meaningful product that helps healthcare professionals maintain their knowledge, skills, and professional certifications.
Hands-on exposure to modern AI tools and AI-assisted product development practices.
Opportunity to develop new skills in AI-powered prototyping and rapid product experimentation.
Collaboration with an experienced, cross-functional international development team.
Room for professional growth and continuous learning as AI transforms the product management landscape.
How Jobgether Works
We use an
AI-powered matching process
to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!
Why Apply Through Jobgether?
Data Privacy Notice:
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

job.title: Control Systems Engineer
job.snippet:
CodeValue is looking for an experienced Control Systems Engineer to join a challenging engineering project, working on advanced control systems, embedded technologies, and industrial automation.
In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, integrating, and testing control solutions that combine industrial PLCs, embedded controllers, and electromechanical systems.
You will work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, translating system requirements into reliable control solutions and taking part in the full development and integration lifecycle.
Key Responsibilities
Design, implement, and optimize closed-loop control systems, including PID-based control for motors, actuators, and motion systems.
Develop and program industrial PLC applications using IEC 61131-3 languages, including Structured Text, Ladder Logic, and Function Block Diagram.
Develop and integrate embedded firmware in C/C++ for microcontrollers and embedded control units.
Integrate sensors, actuators, hardware components, and communication interfaces.
Perform hardware bring-up, system integration, debugging, and troubleshooting.
Implement control logic, state machines, diagnostics, interlocks, and fault-handling mechanisms.
Participate in safety-related control design, including safe states, fault detection, and emergency-stop functionality.
Conduct testing and verification on test benches and integrated systems.
Collaborate with hardware, software, mechanical, and system engineering teams.
Participate in technical reviews and document design decisions, testing results, and integration findings.
Work Location:
On-site in Modi'in, Israel. This is a fully on-site position with no hybrid or remote work option.
Key Responsibilities:
B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.
3–6 years of hands-on experience in Control Systems, Embedded Development, or Industrial Automation.
Practical experience with closed-loop control systems and PID-based motion or actuator control.
Hands-on experience with industrial PLC programming using IEC 61131-3 languages (Structured Text, Ladder Diagram, or Function Block Diagram).
Experience developing embedded firmware in C/C++ for microcontrollers such as STM32 or ARM Cortex-M.
Good understanding of analog and digital electronics, sensors, actuators, PWM, and hardware interfaces.
Experience with communication protocols such as CAN, SPI, I²C, and UART.
Practical experience with hardware debugging tools, including oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and multimeters.
Experience with hardware bring-up and system integration.
Understanding of safety-related control concepts, including interlocks, fault detection, and safe-state mechanisms.
Advantages
Experience with safety PLCs or functional safety standards.
Experience with linear actuators, proportional valves, DC/BLDC motors, or motion control systems.
Familiarity with robotics, autonomous systems, unmanned ground vehicles, or drive-by-wire architectures.
Experience with CANopen, SAE J1939, or vehicle electrical systems.
Experience with NVIDIA Jetson or other embedded edge computing platforms.
Familiarity with Git, automated testing, and CI/CD processes.

job.title: Associate Scientist
job.snippet:
Who We Are
At Tracells, we're on a mission to make gastrointestinal disease diagnostics smarter, simpler, and less invasive.
We're a biotech startup combining molecular biology, human transcriptomics, and computational science to uncover meaningful biological insights from something surprisingly powerful: stool samples.
We're a fast-pace, ambitious team that loves solving challenging problems, asking good questions, and turning exciting science into technology that can make a real difference for patients.
The Opportunity
We're looking for a
talented, hands-on Associate Scientist
to join our R&D team!
This is a role for someone who genuinely loves working at the bench, takes pride in getting the details right, and enjoys the challenge of making complex experiments work.
You'll play an important part in developing and optimizing our RNA-based assays and NGS workflows, working closely with scientists, computational researchers, and clinical collaborators.
This is a full-time, on-site position.
What You'll Be Doing
Perform hands-on molecular biology experiments, including RNA extraction, PCR, and NGS library preparation
Work with clinical samples and challenging biological materials
Execute, troubleshoot, and optimize RNA-based assays and NGS workflows
Maintain high standards of experimental accuracy, quality control, and documentation
Identify opportunities to improve protocols, efficiency, and reproducibility
Collaborate with our team and clinical partners to keep research moving forward
What We're Looking For
Must-haves:
M.Sc. in Biology, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or a related field
Strong hands-on molecular biology experience
Excellent bench skills, with a demonstrated ability to perform precise, reproducible experiments
Strong attention to detail and a commitment to high-quality scientific work
Ability to troubleshoot experiments, think critically, and solve problems independently
A big plus:
Experience with NGS workflows and library preparation
Experience working with RNA or clinical samples
Experience using Electronic Lab Notebooks (ELNs) for experimental documentation and data management
You'll Thrive Here If You...
Love the bench.
You're happiest when you're experimenting, troubleshooting, and figuring things out.
Have high standards.
You care about the small details because you know they make a big difference.
Are curious and resourceful.
You don't just follow protocols; you want to understand why things work (and why they sometimes don't).
Learn fast and take ownership.
You're comfortable with new challenges and don't wait for someone else to solve every problem.
Are a great teammate.
You enjoy collaborating, sharing ideas, and helping others succeed.
Want your science to matter.
You're excited about building something that could genuinely improve patient care.

job.title: מנהל/ת פיתוח תוכניות לימודים לבית ספר וירטואלי מבוסס AI
job.snippet:
תיאור החברה
אנחנו מקימים בית ספר וירטואלי לכיתות א׳–י״ב, שיכסה את כלל מקצועות הלימוד. אנחנו מחפשים מנהל/ת שיוביל את ההקמה הפדגוגית של בית הספר, יבנה את תוכנית הלימודים הכוללת ויגדיר איך הופכים אותה לשיעורים, תרגול ומבחנים במערכת מבוססת AI.
תיאור המשרה
בניית תוכנית הלימודים לכיתות א׳–י״ב
— מיפוי תוכניות משרד החינוך, הגדרת יעדי למידה ובניית רצף לימודי בכל מקצוע ובין שכבות הגיל.
הובלת פיתוח תוכני למידה והערכה
— בניית יחידות לימוד, תרגילים ומבחנים, כולל עבודה מעשית על התכנים הראשונים. בשלב הראשון העבודה תתמקד בחטיבת הביניים.
הקמת תהליכי עבודה לפיתוח תוכן
— הגדרת תבניות וכללים לכתיבה, לבדיקה ולעדכון של תכנים, כך שאפשר יהיה להרחיב את העבודה למקצועות ולשכבות גיל נוספים.
שילוב AI בפיתוח התוכן
— שימוש בכלי AI ליצירת חומרי למידה ושאלות, להתאמת רמות קושי ולהכנת הסברים, תוך בדיקת הדיוק וההתאמה ליעדי הלמידה ולגיל התלמידים.
דרישות המשרה
ניסיון בפיתוח ובהובלת תוכנית לימודים בבית ספר מוביל.
היכרות מעמיקה עם תוכניות הלימודים של משרד החינוך לאורך הרצף מכיתה א׳ עד י״ב, והבנה של יעדי הלמידה והמעבר בין יסודי, חטיבת ביניים ותיכון.
ניסיון בהוראה בפועל ובהקמה של תוכנית לימודים או תהליך פדגוגי חדש מאפס.
לפחות שנה של שימוש מעשי ושוטף בכלי AI ליצירה או לשיפור של חומרי למידה והערכה.
יתרון
ניסיון בהוראה בחטיבת הביניים, במיוחד במתמטיקה, בשפה או במדעים.
ניסיון בפיתוח תוכניות לימודים לסביבה דיגיטלית ובבניית מבחנים או מאגרי שאלות.

job.title: SW Engineering Program Manager
job.snippet:
Summary
As an Engineering Program Manager within the Storage organisation, you will be responsible for setting development goals, building development and integration plans, and tracking project milestones. The role requires inbound cross-functional management and outbound vendor-facing activities.
Description
Your responsibilities in this role are likely to include:
Creating and maintaining project schedules for innovative storage modules & ASICs Collaborating and facilitating communication across engineering and operation managers to meet very aggressive cost, schedule and quality goals
Leading cross-functional communication between project teams and external multinational vendors
Build and manage projects/communication with external vendors.
Setting development goals and tracking execution and compliance with aggressive technical and quality standards
Understanding technical issues and driving them to closure by bringing together key stakeholders for decision-making
Offering multiple levels of status across a wide spectrum of individual contributors in multiple geographic locations to executive management
Minimum Qualifications
5+ years of managerial experience/ engineering program management experience
8+ years of hands-on experience as a SW Engineer; experience across multiple SW disciplines is highly preferred
Experience in driving cross-functional activities or matrix management
Excellent communication, presentation, interpersonal, and leadership skills
B.Sc / M. Sc in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering from a leading university.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience presenting to executives and working directly with executive leadership
Ability to filter and distill relevant information for the right audience

job.snippet:
מטרת התפקיד
אחריות מקצועית על יישום, פיתוח, תחזוקה ושיפור מערכות המידע התפעוליות של החברה, בדגש על Priority ו-WMS; תרגום צרכים עסקיים לפתרונות טכנולוגיים וליווי פרויקטים התומכים בצמיחת הארגון.
תחומי אחריות מרכזיים
• Priority: יישום, קונפיגורציה, תמיכה במשתמשים, פתרון תקלות ופיתוח עצמאי של מסכים, דוחות, פרוצדורות וממשקים.
• ניתוח מערכות: מיפוי תהליכים, איסוף דרישות, כתיבת אפיונים פונקציונליים וטכניים, בדיקות, הדרכות והטמעה.
• WMS: בעלות מקצועית פנימית על המערכת, אפיון שינויים, תעדוף משימות, טיפול בתקלות וניהול עבודה שוטפת מול הספק.
• אינטגרציה: שמירה על רציפות ואיכות הנתונים והטיפול בממשקים בין Priority, WMS ומערכות נוספות.
• פרויקטים: ליווי יוזמות BI ודשבורדים, אוטומציה, אופטימיזציה של תהליכים והטמעת פתרונות AI לפי צורכי החברה.
• עבודה חוצת ארגון מול לוגיסטיקה, מחסן, רכש, מכירות וכספים תוך שיפור חוויית המשתמש ויעילות העבודה.
דרישות חובה
• לפחות 3 שנות ניסיון מעשי ביישום מערכת Priority.
• ניסיון מוכח בפיתוח במערכת Priority.
• ניסיון בניתוח מערכות, אפיון צרכים ותהליכים עסקיים.
• היכרות טובה עם תהליכי מלאי, רכש, מכירות ולוגיסטיקה.
• עצמאות, יכולת פתרון בעיות, תודעת שירות גבוהה ועבודה מול ממשקים מרובים.

job.title: Director of IT Security
job.snippet:
About Aidoc
Aidoc is the market leader in healthcare AI and has developed the world's largest clinical frontier model, supporting nearly 50 million patients each year.
Aidoc is deployed in more than 2,000 medical centers worldwide. Since our founding in 2016, Aidoc has raised over $500 million and achieved a record number of FDA-cleared solutions.
Medical diagnosis is hitting a breaking point, where the number of physicians hasn't kept up with the rapidly growing patient load. This leads to misdiagnosis and treatment delays that result in hundreds of thousands of deaths every year. Aidoc assists clinicians by precisely highlighting diseases directly on medical images, preventing misdiagnosis and ensuring that urgent patients receive the immediate attention they need.
About This Role
The Director of IT Security leads Aidoc's corporate IT security function and oversees the day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of security controls across the organization.
The role operates within the IT strategy, budget, and governance framework. Leads the day-to-day security function and escalates strategic decisions and material approvals to IT ownership.
The role focuses on protecting Aidoc's identities, endpoints, SaaS and AI environments, corporate systems, suppliers, and information assets, and partners with IT, Operations, R&D, Security, Compliance, Legal, and business stakeholders.
The role manages the IT Security team and builds a scalable function that strengthens security maturity, control coverage, compliance readiness, cyber resilience, and secure business operations.
Responsibilities
Lead and execute the corporate IT security roadmap and operating plan, and formulate IT Security procedures, standards, and security improvement initiatives, within the strategy and governance framework, in collaboration with the Director of IT.
Manage the IT Security team, starting with a Security Engineer, and support the function's continued growth.
Implement, operate, and improve security controls across identity and access management, endpoint security, DLP, SaaS, AI tools, and corporate systems, including access reviews, endpoint compliance, and secure configuration standards.
Own the corporate vulnerability-management lifecycle, including risk-based prioritization, remediation SLAs, remediation tracking, reporting, and escalation.
Lead the assessment and approval process for internal SaaS and AI tools, approving low- and medium-risk requests and escalating high-risk requests in collaboration with the Director of IT and the appropriate governance forum.
Define and manage IT Security requirements for suppliers, vendors, third parties, and enterprise platforms, and lead security reviews for corporate IT systems, coordinating with R&D Security when product or engineering environments are affected.
Maintain security monitoring, technical enforcement, control documentation, and audit evidence for IT controls.
Lead corporate cyber-resilience activities, including business continuity, disaster recovery, tabletop exercises, and ransomware readiness.
Support incident response for corporate IT Security events and coordinate with R&D Security on incidents affecting both corporate and R&D environments.
Provide IT Security subject-matter expertise for audits, customer security requests, and compliance activities, while overall security and customer-assurance ownership remains with the relevant organizational function.
Requirements
Undergraduate degree and/or relevant experience in Information Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
At least 8 years of experience in IT Security, Information Security, Security Operations, or a related field.
Experience leading corporate security programs across identity and access management, endpoint security, SaaS, cloud, data protection, and security governance.
Experience managing security controls, access reviews, vulnerability remediation, DLP, security monitoring, incident response, cyber resilience, and audit evidence.
Experience with SaaS and AI security assessments, vendor security, and third-party risk management.
Experience managing or mentoring security professionals and working with cross-functional teams.
Experience working in global high-tech and highly regulated technology organizations.
Familiarity with ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST CSF, GDPR, HIPAA, or similar standards and frameworks.
Experience with BCP/DR, tabletop exercises, ransomware preparedness, or corporate vulnerability management.
Excellent English verbal and written skills.
Excellent interpersonal, communication, analytical, and risk-assessment skills.
Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and present clear recommendations to management.
Working at Aidoc
Our Perks
Be part of something big - using cutting-edge technologies to transform the Healthcare industry (while saving patients’ lives)
Amazing and healthy breakfasts and lunches prepared daily by our personal chef!
Stocked up kitchen & meal card
Wellness: Aidoc employees-only gym, plus Pilates, Yoga, and functional workouts classes.
Amazing culture - collaborative, transparent & fun!
Attractive compensation package & benefits
Aidoc is deeply committed to creating an inclusive workplace, and to the principle of equal opportunity for all individuals. We prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

job.title: E-commerce & Growth Manager
job.snippet:
We're Hiring! E-commerce & Growth Manager at KUNI
KUNI is looking for a results-driven
E-commerce & Growth Manager
with a strong business mindset, excellent analytical skills, and a hands-on approach to lead our online sales and growth strategy.
In this role, you'll take ownership of our e-commerce operations, drive revenue and profitability, manage advertising budgets, and continuously optimize performance across the entire customer journey.
What You'll Do
Manage and grow our Shopify store, taking full ownership of sales performance, conversion rates, and the overall shopping experience.
Develop commercial strategies, promotions, product bundles, and pricing structures to increase revenue and average order value (AOV).
Manage marketing and advertising budgets, set performance targets, and continuously monitor results and profitability.
Independently plan, launch, manage, and optimize paid campaigns across Meta and Google.
Analyze sales data, conversion funnels, and key performance metrics, including ROAS, CAC, and LTV.
Drive initiatives to increase repeat purchases, subscription sign-ups, and customer retention.
Leverage AI tools to improve performance, develop creative assets, and streamline workflows.
What We're Looking For
At least 3 years of proven experience managing e-commerce operations, with direct responsibility for sales results.
Strong hands-on experience with Shopify and e-commerce store management.
Proven ability to independently launch, manage, and optimize Meta and Google advertising campaigns.
Excellent analytical skills, strong commercial understanding, and experience in budget management and profitability analysis.
Experience with D2C brands and familiarity with analytics and automation tools such as GA4 and Klaviyo.
Ability to lead projects end-to-end while remaining actively involved in day-to-day execution.
Experience in consumer brands, retail, beauty, fragrance, or cosmetics is a significant advantage.
Familiarity with AI-powered marketing and e-commerce tools is a plus.
Location & Employment
Full-time position
based near Kanot Junction, Israel, with a hybrid work option.
This position is open to candidates of all genders.
Ready to drive growth and make an impact at KUNI? We'd love to hear from you!
KUNI מגייסת מנהל/ת E-commerce & Growth
אנחנו מחפשים מנהל/ת סחר דיגיטלי עם חשיבה עסקית, יכולת אנליטית גבוהה וגישה מעשית (Hands-on), להובלת פעילות המכירות והצמיחה של KUNI.
התפקיד כולל אחריות על ניהול אתר הסחר, הגדלת המכירות והרווחיות, ניהול תקציבי הפרסום ושיפור הביצועים לאורך מסע הלקוח.
מה תעשו בתפקיד?
* ניהול שוטף ופיתוח פעילות אתר הסחר ב-Shopify, כולל אחריות על מכירות, שיעורי המרה וחוויית הקנייה.
* בניית תוכניות מסחריות, מבצעים, חבילות ומבני תמחור להגדלת המכירות וסל הקנייה.
* ניהול תקציבי השיווק והפרסום, הגדרת יעדים ומעקב שוטף אחר ביצועים ורווחיות.
* הקמה, ניהול ואופטימיזציה של קמפיינים ב-Meta וב-Google, בעבודה עצמאית ומעשית.
* ניתוח נתוני מכירות, משפכי המרה ומדדי ביצוע מרכזיים, כולל ROAS, CAC ו-LTV.
* הובלת מהלכים להגדלת רכישות חוזרות, הצטרפות למנויים ושימור לקוחות.
* שימוש בכלי AI לשיפור ביצועים, יצירת קריאייטיב וייעול תהליכי העבודה.
מה אנחנו מחפשים?
* לפחות 3 שנות ניסיון משמעותי בניהול פעילות E-commerce, עם אחריות ישירה לתוצאות מכירה.
* ניסיון מוכח בעבודה עם Shopify ובניהול אתר סחר.
* ניסיון מעשי ועצמאי בהקמה ובניהול קמפיינים ב-Meta וב-Google.
* יכולת אנליטית גבוהה, הבנה מסחרית וניסיון בניהול תקציבים ובניתוח רווחיות.
* ניסיון במותגי D2C והיכרות עם כלי מדידה ואוטומציה כגון GA4 ו-Klaviyo.
* יכולת להוביל תהליכים מקצה לקצה, לצד נכונות לעבודה מעשית ויומיומית.
* ניסיון במותגי צריכה, Retail, ביוטי, בישום או קוסמטיקה, יתרון משמעותי.
* היכרות עם כלי AI בעולמות השיווק והסחר, יתרון.
משרה מלאה באזור צומת כנות, עם אפשרות לעבודה היברידית.
המשרה מיועדת לכל המגדרים.

job.title: Head of Operations
job.snippet:
Kibbutzim College is seeking an experienced Head of Operations to take overall responsibility for operations, maintenance, infrastructure, safety and service across the College’s campuses, while also playing a key role in the development of its new campus.
This is a broad and central management position, suited to experienced professionals from operations, maintenance, facilities and Facility Management. Relevant backgrounds may include public and academic institutions, hospitals, hotels, logistics, construction companies, project management, service companies and organizations managing complex sites and operational systems.
Key Responsibilities
• Lead the overall operations and infrastructure functions across the College’s campuses.
• Oversee maintenance, cleaning, landscaping, security, parking and safety operations.
• Manage teams and managers, as well as suppliers, contractors and service providers.
• Ensure the proper operation and maintenance of buildings, systems and infrastructure.
• Lead safety, emergency preparedness, accessibility and access-control functions.
• Manage renovation, space development and construction projects from planning through handover.
• Manage the annual operations budget and monitor expenditure.
• Oversee the unit responsible for renting classrooms and spaces to external organizations.
Requirements
• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Industrial Engineering & Management, Logistics or a related field – required.
• At least 10 years of experience managing complex, multi-interface operational systems.
• Experience managing employees and managers, budgets, suppliers, contractors and projects.
• Strong experience in operations management of a site, complex or large-scale facility – an advantage.
• Excellent management, organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
• Experience with facilities and maintenance management systems – a significant advantage.
• An engineering degree or practical engineering qualification in Civil, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering – an advantage.
Relevant Candidate Backgrounds
The role may suit senior professionals in operations, maintenance, facilities management, Facility Management, logistics or project management, including candidates from academic and public institutions, hospitals, hotels, facilities-management and maintenance companies, construction and development companies, logistics companies, operational centers, retail chains and organizations with complex physical operations.
Position Details
Full-time position | Reports to: College CEO

job.title: Operations Manager – Motor Repair Division
job.snippet:
Company Description
Amppera Ltd. is a long-established manufacturer with over 50 years of experience in designing and producing high-performance, energy-efficient motors. The company focuses on delivering innovative motor technologies that support a more sustainable and resource-conscious future. Amppera Ltd. serves a broad range of industrial customers and emphasizes reliability, quality, and continuous improvement in its products and processes. Team members join a company that values technical excellence, operational efficiency, and the development of cleaner, smarter energy solutions.
Role Description
The Operations Manager – Motor Repair Division will oversee the day-to-day operations of the motor repair department, ensuring safe, efficient, and high-quality service delivery. Responsibilities include managing workflows, supervising repair technicians, allocating resources, and monitoring turnaround times for motor diagnostics, repair, and testing activities. The role will coordinate with supply chain, quality assurance, and customer service teams to maintain inventory levels, meet client timelines, and uphold service standards. The Operations Manager will implement process improvements, track key performance indicators, prepare operational reports, and support compliance with relevant safety and industry regulations. This is a full-time, on-site role located in Be'er Sheva.
Qualifications
Proven experience managing operational activities in a technical industrial environment, preferably in repair, heavy maintenance, or workshop operations.
Significant managerial experience leading professional teams, team leaders, and cross-functional interfaces.
Experience leading process improvement initiatives, implementing management routines, and developing employee accountability and independence.
Strong systemic and strategic perspective, with the ability to make decisions and lead processes in a dynamic, multi-task environment.
Strong customer service orientation.
Full proficiency in ERP systems, computer applications, and management and control tools.
Application process!
To be formally considered for this position, in addition to applying via LinkedIn, it is important that you register your application in our CIVI AI system.
Please complete your application here:
https://app.civi.co.il/promo/id=726674&src=23561
Only applications submitted through CIVI AI will be considered for the next stages of the recruitment process.

job.title: TAKEANAP מנהל/ ת אתר אי קומרס
job.snippet:
למותג הלייף סטייל TAKEANAP דרוש/ה מנהל/ת אתר איקומרס עם הבנה מסחרית, יכולות טכנולוגיות, עין עיצובית מצוינת ותשוקה אמיתית לעולם הדיגיטל.
אנחנו מחפשים מישהו/י שחי/ה ונושם/ת E-commerce, מבין/ה איך אתר צריך להיראות, לעבוד ולמכור, ויודע/ת לקחת רעיונות ולהפוך אותם לחוויית קנייה מצוינת.
מה כולל התפקיד?
ניהול שוטף של אתרי האיקומרס בישראל ובארה״ב.
עדכון והעלאת מוצרים, קולקציות, תכנים ובאנרים.
הקמה וניהול של מבצעים, באנדלים, הטבות ודפי נחיתה.
אחריות על נראות האתר, חוויית המשתמש ושיפור מסע הלקוח.
עבודה על שיפור שיעורי המרה, הגדלת סל הקנייה וביצועי האתר.
עבודה עם כלי Shopify, אפליקציות ואוטומציות.
שיפור ופיתוח האתר בשיתוף אנשי פיתוח וספקים חיצוניים.
עבודה שוטפת מול צוותי השיווק, הקריאייטיב והסושיאל.
ניתוח נתוני מכירות, התנהגות גולשים והפקת תובנות.
מה אנחנו מחפשים?
ניסיון מוכח בניהול אתר E-commerce — חובה.
ניסיון מעשי ב־Shopify — יתרון משמעותי. ניסיון ב־Shopify Plus — יתרון נוסף.
הבנה טובה ב־UX/UI, מסחר אונליין ואופטימיזציה להמרות.
יכולת עבודה עצמאית, דיוק, סדר וירידה לפרטים.
עין עיצובית מפותחת והבנה בשפה מותגית.
ניסיון ב־Canva, Photoshop או תוכנות עיצוב — יתרון.
הבנה ב־SEO, כלי אנליטיקה ודיוור — יתרון.
אנגלית ברמה טובה.

job.title: Technical Program Manager
job.snippet:
Job Description
About Us
HiBob helps modern, mid-size businesses transform the way they manage people, giving HR and managers all they need to connect, engage, develop, and retain top talent. Since 2015, we’ve achieved consecutive triple-digit year-over-year growth, all backed by our amazing team of Bobbers from across the globe, making us the choice HRIS of over ~5500 midsize and multinational companies and over 1 Milion users.
Our HR platform is intuitive, data-driven, and built for the way people work today: globally, remotely, and collaboratively.
About the role
As a Technical Program Manager at HiBob, you will partner with Product and Engineering leadership to turn strategic priorities into clear plans and successful delivery across business units and the technology organization.
You will lead complex programs across teams and business units, strengthen alignment across our technology organization, and improve how we plan, execute, and communicate. You will also help shape how AI is used in program
Job Requirements
At least 5 years of program management experience in the software industry, leading complex technical programs.
Proven ability to drive large-scale, cross-functional initiatives, managing dependencies and delivering measurable outcomes.
Strong practical experience with Agile principles and Scrum, with the ability to adapt ways of working to different teams and contexts.
Ability to work independently, take ownership, and influence outcomes without direct authority.
Hands-on experience using AI tools to improve day-to-day work, with the ability to identify opportunities for automation, build effective workflows, and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs.
Strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills, using data to identify issues, assess trade-offs, and support decisions.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust, facilitate alignment, and navigate competing priorities.
Experience partnering with senior leadership, presenting clear recommendations and driving decisions.
Fluent English, both written and verbal.
Advantages
Experience in a SaaS company.
Experience partnering with business unit leadership on planning and execution.
Experience implementing AI-enabled workflows or process automation across teams.
PMP or an
Job Responsibilities
Lead complex technical programs from planning through execution and delivery, managing scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, and success measures.
Partner with business unit leadership to lead planning and execution processes, translate priorities into actionable plans, and drive accountability and follow-through.
Drive programs across business units, aligning Product, Engineering, and other stakeholders around shared goals, priorities, and dependencies.
Provide clear visibility into progress and delivery confidence, communicating risks, trade-offs, and decisions needed to teams and senior leadership.
Proactively resolve delivery challenges, bringing the right stakeholders together to remove blockers and make timely decisions.
Improve the development lifecycle by applying Agile principles and continuous improvement practices in close partnership with Product and Engineering teams.
Identify and scale effective processes across the technology organization, improving coordination and delivery while keeping ways of working practical and efficient.
Apply AI tools and automation to improve program management, including reporting, risk and dependency analysis, knowledge sharing, and workflow efficiency.
Job Benefits
Join our village
HiBob is a village filled with amazing people and we’re especially proud of that. It’s a place where Bobbers can be themselves. We’re about fun, dreams, hopes and ambition, just as much as we are about precision, growth, and top performance. Becoming a Bobber means you’ll receive competitive Total Reward offer including:
Financial & Equity Incentives
💰
Equity Plan: Participation in the Company Share Options Plan
Social Contributions and Keren Hishtalmut
Employee Referral Program: $2,500 for each successful hire
Wolt Benefit (meal card): ₪1,000 per month
Health, Wellness
🏥
Private Health Insurance: C​​​​​omprehensive premium medical coverage
Sick Leave: Full payment from the first day of illness
Wellness Benefits: Annual Headspace subscription and dedicated wellness programs
Preventive Screening: Health screenings for employees aged 40+
Work-Life Balance & Leave
⚖️
Paid Time Off: Competitive paid time off policy
HiBaby: 3 weeks of additional fully paid bounding time for new parents
Bob Balance Days: 4 additional company-wide "long weekend" days (one per quarter)
Social Impact: 2 paid days per year for volunteering and social contribution
Work from Anywhere: Temporary remote work option for up to 2 months (available after 6 months of tenure).
Birthday Day Off: Enjoy a day off during your birthday month
Hybrid Work & Office Environmen
t 🏠
Hybrid Model: A flexible balance between office and home-based work
Home Office Allowance: One-time stipend to ensure an ergonomic and productive home setup
Transportation: Monthly travel allowance or parking arrangements
Pet-Friendly: Dog-friendly office environment to support a stress-free workplace
Culture & Growth
🎉
Social Events: Regular team-building and company-wide events, both local and global
Professional Growth: A culture built on precision, performance, and ambitious career scaling
If this sounds like something you’ve been looking for, we’d love to have you. Come on, join our village 🚀

job.title: OT Infrastructure Project Manager
job.snippet:
OT infrastructures Project Manager
PETACH TIKVA HYBRID
Job Description:
A leading organization looking for an infrastructure and information systems person for the OT environment.
As part of the IT team that handles the infrastructure environment and the OT network will engage in the design, construction, maintenance of computing, Information security and network solutions.
About this job:
Carry out projects in the company's plants to address information security gaps and address IT / OT infrastructure.
Carry out projects for new equipment and production lines.
Ongoing support with factory personal.
Requirements:
Knowledge and experience in the fields of computing and IT infrastructure (communication, information security, system and workstation O.S) in a factorys in a large organization.
At least 3 years of experience in PLC, Industrial communication protocols, HMI and SCADA systems.
Knowledge in programmable controllers such as Siemens, Allen-Bradley, Unitronics.
Experience in System Platform and Cimplicity.
At least 3 years of experience in infrastructure planning and equipment acquisition for the OT network.
Advantage in knowing Real Time protocols such as: ProfiNet, EtherNet IP, Modbus, BACnet.
Excellent verbal and written communication in English & Hebrew.
Skills:
Human relations, expressiveness and high interpersonal communication.
Initiative, independence, ability to lead projects. Order and organize, ability to map and prioritize tasks.
Ability to work with cross functional teams and manage projects that involves people from different teams.
Passion in the field, work ethic and high motivation - a must!
The job is in our offices in Petah-Tikva and requires mobility to factories around the country.

job.title: יועצת רגולציה ותקינה (החלפה לחל״ד)
job.company: Federation of Israeli Chambers of Commerce (FICC)
job.snippet:
דרוש/ה יועצ/ת רגולציה ותקינה - החלפה לחל"ד
ללשכת המסחר תל אביב והמרכז דרוש/ה יועצ/ת רגולציה ותקינה.
דרישות התפקיד:
• השכלה אקדמית (עדיפות כלכלה /מנהל עסקים /משפטים/ מדע המדינה).
• הכרות עם דרישות רגולציה ותקינה ביבוא - יתרון.
• תכונות וכישורים הכרחיים: יכולת למידה מהירה, יכולת עבודה עצמאית ובצוות, תודעת שירות מפותחת, יכולת ביטוי גבוהה בכתב ובעל-פה, יכולת ניתוח מסמכים בתחומי רגולציה, שליטה טובה באנגלית, עמידה בלחץ עבודה וריבוי משימות.
• יכולת עבודה ושליטה בסביבה ממוחשבת.
תיאור התפקיד:
• מתן ייעוץ ושירות לעוסקים בסוגיות רגולטוריות ובהקשר של דרישות תקינה.
• סיוע לעוסקים שנתקלים בקושי לקבל מענה בכלל ו/או מענה ראוי ממגוון גורמי ממשל שונים.
• סיוע לפעילות אגף הרגולציה בלשכת המסחר מול משרדי הממשלה והכנסת לטיוב הרגולציה החלה על היבוא ולהסרת חסמי יבוא.
• הנגשת מידע רגולטורי באתר הלשכה.
• דיוור עדכונים שוטפים וסיוע לגורמים נוספים בלשכת המסחר בהפצת עדכוני רגולציה בצורה מפולחת לסוגי עוסקים שונים.
• ייזום וקיום הדרכות לעוסקים בסוגיות רגולטוריות שונות.
• היקף משרה: 100%
• מקום עבודה: תל אביב
• המשרה מיועדת לנשים ולגברים כאחד
מייל לשליחת קו"ח (רק פניות מתאימות תענינה) razh@chamber.org.il
