job.title: Head of Production
job.snippet:
Head of Productions
Mainstream Media | Kiryat Bialik, Israel | Full-time
About us
Mainstream Media is a full-service advertising agency working with close to 50 active brands, from government offices to retail, finance and restaurants. We do it all under one roof: paid campaigns, social media management, content and video production, photography, influencer marketing, branding, and AI-driven automations. We move fast, we care about results, and we treat every client's budget like it's our own.
The role
We run more than 20 shoot days every month. Some are quick, phone-based shoots with a content creator, and others are full professional productions with a camera crew. We're looking for a Head of Productions to own all of them: planning, scripting, coordinating, directing on set when needed, and taking every project through post-production to final client approval. You're the person who makes sure every shoot day is well prepared, runs smoothly, and delivers content that actually works.
What you'll do
Planning & pre-production
Own the monthly shoot calendar across all agency clients
Plan each shoot day: goals, shot lists, schedules, locations, talent and equipment
Write scripts, concepts and creative briefs for reels, ads and branded video
Build clear production documents so everyone on set knows exactly what to do
Coordination & logistics
Coordinate shoot days with clients: dates, locations, products, people on camera and approvals
Manage our network of photographers, videographers, content creators and other suppliers
Handle all production logistics, from bookings and equipment to timing and on-set needs
Keep production budgets and timelines under control
On set
Join selected shoot days and lead them in practice as director and producer
Guide crews, creators and talent to capture the content as planned, and adapt quickly when things change
Make sure every shoot ends with all the content we need
Post-production
Oversee the editing process with our editors, from first cut to final version
Give clear, creative feedback to make sure content is on brief, on brand and on time
Manage review rounds and approvals with clients
Teamwork
Work closely with our social media managers and account managers to turn content plans and campaign needs into shoot days
Make sure what we shoot connects to the client's strategy, both organic and paid
What we're looking for
3+ years of experience in video or content production, ideally in an agency or production company
Proven experience writing scripts and concepts for social media and short-form video
Hands-on experience directing or producing shoots, both small and professional
Strong understanding of what makes content work on Instagram, TikTok and Facebook
Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage many shoots, clients and suppliers at once
Great interpersonal skills: clients, crews and creators enjoy working with you
Calm under pressure and solution-oriented on set
Familiarity with the editing process and the ability to give precise feedback
Driver's license and availability to travel to shoots across Israel
Fluent Hebrew and good working English
Nice to have
Hands-on shooting or editing skills
An existing network of photographers, creators and production suppliers
Familiarity with AI tools for video and content creation
Why join us
Lead the production department of a fast-growing agency
A diverse client portfolio, so no two shoot days look the same
Real creative influence, from the idea to the final cut
Direct work with the CEO and a strong in-house creative, video and AI team behind you
Interested? Send your CV to arad@msmedia.co.il or apply here on LinkedIn.

job.title: Power Delivery Design Engineer, Google Cloud
job.snippet:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
Tel Aviv, Israel; Haifa, Israel
.
Minimum qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
4 years of experience in power delivery network design and verification in nodes technologies.
Experience with Electromigration (EM)/IR tools (e.g., RedHawk-SC, Totem, Voltus, Spice).
Experience scripting in TCL, Python, or C++.
Preferred qualifications:
Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
Experience with power components, modeling/trees/network design.
Experience in battery droop mitigation, overcurrent protection, thermal shutdown.
Experience in power consumption estimation/calculation of System-on-a-Chip (SoC).
Familiarity with low power design techniques (e.g., power/voltage domain design, clock gating, power gating, dynamic voltage frequency scaling).
About The Job
In this role, you’ll work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration. You will have an opportunity to drive cutting-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers Google's most demanding AI/ML applications. You’ll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's TPU. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide, and leverage your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML-driven systems.
In this role, you will collaborate with functional design, Design for Testing (DFT), architecture, and packaging engineers. You will solve technical problems with innovative micro-architecture and practical logic circuits solutions, while evaluating design options with optimized performance, and power.
Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.
Responsibilities
Define and drive the implementation of physical design methodologies. Define the physical design related rule sets for the functional design engineers.
Work closely with power architects and produce detailed trade-off analysis of impact of Power Delivery Network (PDN) on different use-case power.
Work on system and block level simulations (e.g., IR drop, electromigration).
Take ownership of one or more physical design partitions or top level.
Drive to the closure of timing and power consumption of the design. Contribute to design methodology, libraries, and code review.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

job.title: R&D Technical Project Manager
job.snippet:
We are looking for an
R&D Technical Project Manager
to drive early-stage engineering projects and technology initiatives.
The role combines hands-on engineering, technical investigation, supplier engagement, and project ownership. You will work on new challenges in the space domain, evaluate technical alternatives, reduce uncertainty, and help mature ideas into clear engineering directions.
Requirements:
B.Sc. or higher in Engineering or another relevant technical field.
7+ years of relevant engineering experience, preferably working on complex, multidisciplinary systems or R&D projects.
Strong engineering judgment and problem-solving skills.
Ability to independently drive technical work in an environment with incomplete or evolving requirements.
Ability to quickly learn new technologies and technical domains.
Ability to independently engage suppliers and external technical partners.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Responsibilities:
Lead early-stage R&D and engineering projects, from initial exploration through feasibility and recommendation.
Investigate new technologies, solutions, and system concepts.
Define and execute feasibility studies, technical evaluations, experiments, and PoCs.
Identify key technical risks, unknowns, and trade-offs.
Develop initial concepts, requirements, and technical scopes.
Independently identify relevant suppliers, vendors, and external partners.
Proactively approach suppliers, lead technical discussions, and evaluate proposed solutions.
Work with engineering experts across hardware, software, mechanical, optics, RF, and other disciplines.
Support projects with technical studies, preliminary design work, and SOW preparation.
Present findings and provide clear recommendations for Go / No-Go / Next Phase decisions.
Advantages:
Experience in R&D, advanced development, or early-stage product development.
Experience with prototypes, demonstrators, or experimental setups.
Background in aerospace, robotics, sensing, or communications.
Experience working with suppliers, subcontractors, or research partners.
Experience writing technical specifications, requirements, or SOWs.

job.title: Director of Engineering & NPI
job.snippet:
We are looking for an experienced Director of Engineering & NPI to lead Manufacturing Engineering and New Product Introduction, ensuring a controlled transition from development to scalable production and supporting the integration of ZutaCore’s liquid cooling solutions into server platforms. The role combines hands-on engineering leadership, team development, and ownership of critical and strategic projects, working closely with R&D, global contract manufacturers, and server OEM/ODM partners.
Key Responsibilities
Lead and develop the Engineering, NPI, and Technical Documentation team, defining ownership, priorities, and deliverables.
Take the lead on critical and strategic cross-functional projects, aligning stakeholders, resolving barriers, and driving execution through completion.
Own industrialization and manufacturing readiness for CDUs, cold plates, cooling loops, manifolds, and related assemblies.
Lead NPI from early design reviews through prototype builds, pilot production, and ramp-up, establishing clear production readiness criteria.
Drive DFX with R&D and OEM/ODM partners, addressing manufacturability, assembly, testing, serviceability, and reliability.
Develop and qualify manufacturing processes, tooling, fixtures, and production tests, including leak, pressure, flow, and functional testing.
Ensure complete production files, accurate BOMs, configuration control, and controlled engineering changes in ERP/PLM systems, including NetSuite.
Lead transfers to global manufacturing partners and support supplier and alternate-source qualification.
Resolve complex manufacturing issues and improve yield, cycle time, cost, and process stability.
Manage external engineering resources and incorporate production and field lessons into product improvements.
Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering
At least 10 years of experience in Manufacturing Engineering, NPI, or complex hardware industrialization, including at least 3 years of direct management of engineers.
Proven experience transferring products from development to serial production through contract manufacturers.
Demonstrated ability to lead complex cross-functional projects, take initiative, and drive decisions and execution in a dynamic environment.
Strong hands-on mechanical engineering skills, including SolidWorks, DFX, process qualification, and root cause analysis.
Experience with production testing, BOMs, configuration management, and ERP/PLM systems.
Strong leadership, communication, and collaboration skills, with a clear sense of ownership and accountability.
Fluent in English.

job.title: UAV Pilot Integrator
job.snippet:
DRS RADA
is a global pioneer of RADAR systems for active military protection, counter-drone applications, critical infrastructure protection, and border surveillance
As a
UAV Pilot and Integrator
for an Experimental Drone System, you will support the development and testing of advanced drone systems. Your responsibilities will span system preparation and the integration of components and sub-systems, platform operation during development tests and field trials, and ongoing technical support throughout integration and testing.
The position requires hands-on and system-level work in collaboration with system, software, hardware, mechanical, and algorithm teams, while maintaining a strong focus on quality, safety, and meeting test objectives.
Responsibilities:
Prepare, assemble, and integrate the drone system for testing
Operate the platform during development tests, integration activities, and field trials
Install and integrate sensors, cameras, communication systems, telemetry systems, and other components
Perform pre-flight checks
Configure, calibrate, and operate flight controllers and control systems
Identify and troubleshoot system faults
Maintain test platforms, batteries, chargers, and ground equipment
Document system configurations, test findings, and faults identified during integration and testing
Requirements:
Previous experience operating drones or unmanned aerial vehicles
UAV pilot license
Experience integrating electronic systems or airborne systems
Good technical understanding of drone systems, avionics, communications, and sensors
Experience working with flight controllers; experience with PX4 is an advantage
Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team
Responsibility, organization, accuracy, and the ability to work under pressure
Willingness to work in the field and flexible hours according to operational needs
Personal Skills:
Hands-on approach, high personal responsibility, and quick learning ability
Systems thinking and problem-solving skills
Strong safety discipline
Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to work with multiple interfaces
Flexibility, commitment, and the ability to respond quickly in a dynamic environment

job.title: Algorithms Engineer (Drones & UAV)
job.snippet:
We're looking for a
Senior Flight Control Algorithms Engineer
to join an innovative startup developing cutting-edge autonomy technology for
drone
operations in complex real-world environments.
This is an opportunity to join the company at an early stage, work directly with the CTO, and become one of
two senior algorithm engineers
shaping the core technology behind the product. As the company grows, you'll have the opportunity to influence both the technical direction and the future of the engineering organization.
What you'll do
Design and develop F
light Control algorithms
for autonomous drone systems
Develop navigation, estimation and sensor fusion algorithms using GNSS, IMU, Radar, LiDAR and additional sensors
Build simulations, analyze flight performance and validate algorithms
Participate in flight testing, log analysis and continuous algorithm improvement
Collaborate closely with software, electronics and mechanical engineers to bring algorithms into production
We're looking for someone with
Proven experience developing navigation algorithms for autonomous systems (UAV experience is highly preferred)
Strong understanding of control theory, navigation and state estimation
Hands-on experience with sensor fusion and real-world autonomous systems
Experience taking algorithms from concept and simulation through testing and deployment
B.Sc. or higher in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
Experience with ROS, PX4 or ArduPilot is an advantage, but strong algorithmic fundamentals and real-world GNC experience are far more important.
Why join?
Join at a pivotal stage before significant company growth
Work directly with the CTO and a small, highly experienced core engineering team
Own a critical part of the autonomy stack
Build technology that goes from mathematical design to real-world flight
Help shape both the product and the future of the company

job.title: Product Manager
job.snippet:
We are Tailor Brands
We built a platform that builds businesses. From launching and managing to growing your business, Tailor Brands is the all-in-one solution that empowers you. Our "Guidance Engine" assesses each new business that arrives on the platform and devises a tailored plan for it. From formation and compliance to accounting and payments, millions of people choose Tailor Brands for over 20 business services on a single platform.
Our mission is to help anyone shape their life by building a business and creating a simple path to independence.
There are point solutions for every bump in the road, a tool for each challenge you might face. But we are more than a toolbox, we are your guide. We hand you the compass to chart a smoother course, and turn the journey from complicated to clear, from daunting to doable.
Building a business is tough. While 61% of Americans have a plan to start a business, only a third will actually take the steps to make it happen. We believe the present favors independence, but the future will require it.
﻿About the role
You own the product end to end: the problem, the prototype, the spec, the release, the experiment, and the call to keep it, change it, or kill it. Which parts of the product you're focused on follows the opportunities we decide to invest in, and you'll hold several of them at once. The craft is the same in all of them.
Some of what we build is AI itself: an AI co-founder for business owners, and an AI-led signup flow. Some of it is ordinary product work: checkout, pricing, compliance filings, a dashboard. In both cases, AI is how the job gets done here, not a type of project you get assigned.
You build the prototype yourself.
Our PMs build working prototypes in AI coding tools such as Lovable and Claude Code — alone or with a designer, depending on the project. The prototype goes to engineering as the spec, with real components, real states and real copy. Not a wireframe and a document.
You move fast.
You have an engineering team building against your decisions, and you are responsible for what they spend their time on. We release several times a day, nothing waits for a quarterly plan, and what you sketch on Monday can be live by Wednesday.
You run your own experiments.
Design the test, declare the primary metric before you open it, set exposure, get it instrumented with the data team, read it, and call it. Tests run in Statsig, with results in Heap and Tableau, though often we skip the dashboard and have an AI agent read the test straight out of the warehouse. Closing your own test on control is part of the job.
You get your own answers.
The same habit applies to every question, not only to tests. Instead of filing a request and waiting, you go and find out. You are expected to notice when a number is wrong, and to say so before a decision gets made on it.
You own the consequences.
When a price renders wrong or a payment method stops appearing on one browser, you are the person who works out how many customers it reached, decides what we do for them, and makes sure it cannot happen the same way twice.
You hold the stakeholders.
Requests reach you from other product teams, BizDev, Marketing, Finance, Legal, CX and Data, and they will not agree on what matters most. You hear them out, decide what your team takes on and in what order, and tell the people who did not get what they asked for why not. They also need to know what is changing, what it means for their work, and when it lands, before it lands.
Requirements:
3-5 years in product management, on a consumer or self-serve product.
You already build with AI coding tools. This is a requirement, not an advantage. If you have never shipped a working prototype yourself, this role will be frustrating.
Deeply analytical. Given a metric that moved, you can break it into the parts that could have moved it, work out which one did, and say how confident you are in the answer.
Monetization experience preferred: pricing, packaging, checkout, upsell, billing. These are the decisions that move revenue rather than engagement.
Experimentation you have run yourself: designed, powered, read, decided. Be ready to talk about a test you killed and why.
Strong stakeholder management. You can hold competing requests from several functions at once, decide what your team takes on, sequence the rest honestly, and keep the people you said no to on your side.
Enough UI/UX judgment to design a flow rather than describe one, down to layout, states, empty states and copy.
A quantitative B.A./B.Sc. from a leading academic institution (advantage for entrepreneurship programs such as Zell, Adelson, We, Coller Ignite, TAU Up).
Working English, written and spoken. Most of our customers and some of our team are native English speakers.
You have made something exist that did not exist before, such as a startup, a side project or a product line.
Nice to have
Domain experience in US small business, fintech or compliance: formation, registered agent, payments, bookkeeping, tax.
Experience shipping a partner or channel integration.
You have been a small business owner.
A link to something you built, such as a prototype, an internal tool or a side project. Send it with your application.
This role is probably not for you if
You expect a designer to hand you screens and an analyst to hand you numbers.
You want to write requirements and hand them over.
You want one area that stays yours, with a fixed scope and a quarterly planning cycle.
You want one stakeholder and a tidy backlog.
"AI-first" reads to you as a line in a job ad rather than a description of the day.
Nice to know
We are located in Rothschild, Tel Aviv.
Our hybrid model includes four days in the office and one day at home.

תיאור משרה
מחלקת פרוייקטים באגף התפעול של חברת קו צינור אירופה אסיה בע"מ (קצא"א), מחפשת מפקח/ת, לעבודה במשרדים הראשיים.
- פיקוח על עבודות קבלנים וניהול הביצוע בשטח תוך הקפדה מלאה על יישום המפרט הטכני בכפיפות לנהלי החברה לרבות בטיחות.
- יישום כתב כמויות, תזרימים ושרטוטים.
- בקרה תקציבית ובקרת איכות הפרויקט.
העסקה בחוזה אישי.
עבודה בתנאי שטח בכפיפות למנהל מחלקת פרויקטים / מהנדס ביצוע.
השתלבות בחברת תשתיות לאומית אסטרטגית, יציבה ומובילה.
תנאי העסקה טובים וסביבת עבודה מקצועית ומאתגרת.
דרישות התפקיד
- מהנדס/ת או הנדסאי/ת בניין, מכונות, תעשיה וניהול, חשמל ואלקטרוניקה, או בעל/ת ניסיון בעבודות פיקוח - על פרויקטים בתעשייה (קווי דלק - יתרון), של לפחות 5 שנים.
- מנהל/ת עבודה בתעשייה / בבניה – יתרון.
- ממונה בטיחות בתעשייה – יתרון.
- יכולת קריאה והבנה של מפרטים / שרטוטים.
- רישיון נהיגה - חובה (רישיון ג' – יתרון).
- נכונות לעבודה מאומצת ובשעות לא שגרתיות.
- נכונות ללינה מחוץ לבית לתקופות ארוכות.
- עדיפות למגורים באזור שבין תל אביב לחיפה.
- אנגלית ו/או ערבית ו/או רוסית – יתרון.
- כושר ביטוי בעל פה ובכתב.
- הכרת תוכנות אופיס.
- יחסי אנוש טובים.
- תינתן עדיפות למועמדים עם מוגבלויות, נכי צה"ל, חרדים, דרוזים ומועמדים מבני העדה האתיופית.
* משרה זו פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.

job.snippet:
אחראי/ת פרויקטים טכנולוגיים לגופים ממשלתיים

הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
אנחנו מגייסים למספר משרות ניהול פרויקטים במשרדי ממשלה בירושלים ומכרז ( גוש דן)
הפרויקטים בתחומים: מערכות מידע ו-WEB, דיגיטל, ענן ו-AI, תשתיות IT וסייבר, והקמת מערכות חדשות מול ספקים.
משרה מלאה, בחלק מהמשרות יש אפשרות לעבודה היברידית.
מה התפקיד?
- ניהול פרויקטים טכנולוגיים מקצה לקצה: תוכנית עבודה, לו"ז, תקציב וסיכונים
- עבודה מול צוותי פיתוח, ספקים וגורמים שונים בארגון
- ליווי ההטמעה עד העלייה לאוויר
דרישות התפקיד
ניסיון של 4 שנים לפחות בניהול פרויקטים טכנולוגיים או פרויקטי מערכות מידע
תואר ראשון במדעי המחשב / הנדסת מחשבים / הנדסת תעשייה וניהול (מערכות מידע) / מערכות מידע, או תואר אחר + קורסים במערכות מידע, או הנדסאי/ת מחשבים.
יתרון לניסיון באחד או יותר מהבאים:
- ענן, AI ודיגיטל: פרויקטים מבוססי ענן (כגון נימבוס), פרויקטים משולבי AI, פלטפורמות Low-Code / No-Code (כגון OutSystems) ופלטפורמות לטפסים ותהליכים דיגיטליים
- אינטגרציה: הטמעת מערכות וחיבור למערכות ליבה ארגוניות
- מערכות CRM: הובלת פרויקטים ב-Salesforce או במערכות CRM אחרות
- ניתוח מערכות ונתונים: כתיבת אפיונים, עבודה עם Oracle / SQL / TOAD ובניית דוחות
- תפעול מערכות: תמיכה במערכות בסביבת ייצור וטיפול בתקלות מורכבות
- תשתיות וסייבר: אבטחת מידע, סייבר, תשתיות IT, שרתים או מערכות וידאו
- מגזר ציבורי ובריאות: עבודה מול גופים ממשלתיים או ציבוריים, ובפרט מערכות מחשוב רפואיות / מעבדות או חינוך
- ניהול: ניהול ספקים, התקשרויות ומכרזים; Agile / Scrum לצד Waterfall וכלים כמו Monday; הסמכת PMP או קורס ניהול פרויקטים מוכר
* משרה זו פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.

job.title: חשמלאי.ת מכונות, בקרה ותשתיות - מיל"י
job.snippet:
חשמלאי.ת מכונות, בקרה ותשתיות - מיל"י
כלמוביל
רמת חובב
3-4 שנים
משרה מלאה
לפני 9 שעות
הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
איך יראה היום שלך?
אחזקת מכונות וקווי ייצור:
איתור ופתרון תקלות (Troubleshooting) מורכבות במכונות תעשייתיות, מערכות הנעה, מנועים, ווסתי מהירות וחיישנים.
אחזקת מערכות בקרה ואוטומציה:
טיפול במערכות פיקוד ובקרה, קריאת תוכניות חשמל ודיאגרמות, עבודה מול בקרים מתוכנתים (PLC) ומערכות HMI/SCADA (איתור תקלה ברמת תוכנה/חומרה).
אחזקת תשתיות חשמל:
אחריות על לוחות החשמל המפעליים (לוחות חלוקה, תאורה, כוח), מערכות אל-פסק (UPS), ומערכת גיבוי (גנרטור).
אחזקה מונעת ומתוכננת:
ביצוע סבבים שוטפים, בדיקות תקופתיות (כגון סריקות תרמו גרפיות ללוחות) וטיפולים מונעים בהתאם לתוכנית האחזקה השנתית שמתווה מנהל האחזקה, תוך שימוש והטמעה במערכת ה-Datwise
תמיכה בפרויקטים ושיפורים: השתתפות בהקמה, חיווט, שדרוג והרצה של מכונות חדשות ושיפור קווים קיימים בהתאם לצרכי המפעל.
בטיחות בחשמל:
שמירה קפדנית על חוק החשמל, נהלי הבטיחות בעבודה ופקודות הבטיחות במפעל .
מתח גבוה (יתרון):
תפעול, אחזקה וטיפול בציוד מתח גבוה במפעל (שנאים, מסדרים, מפסקי זרם) – ככל וקיימת הסמכה מתאימה.
דרישות התפקיד
רישיון חשמל בתוקף: חשמלאי מוסמך / ראשי / טכנאי / הנדסאי – חובה.
רישיון חשמלאי מסויג/מורשה מתח גבוה – יתרון משמעותי.
השכלה: הנדסאי/טכנאי חשמל או בקרה ואוטומציה – יתרון.
ניסיון מקצועי: ניסיון של 3-5 שנים לפחות כחשמלאי אחזקה במפעל תעשייתי (עדיפות לתעשייה תהליכית או קווי ייצור אוטומטיים).
ידע טכני מובהק: ניסיון מעשי באיתור תקלות במערכות בקרה, קריאת שרטוטי חשמל מורכבים (רשת ופיקוד), הבנה במערכות פנאומטיקה והידראוליקה (יתרון).
מחשוב: היכרות וניסיון עבודה עם בקרים מתוכנתים (כגון Siemens, Allen Bradley וכדומה) ומערכות דיווח אחזקה (רצוי).
ניסיון בהקמה והטמעה של מערכת  (יתרון) פרואקטיביות והנעה עצמית - חתירה אקטיבית לשיפור מתמיד.
יוזמה בתפקיד ומחוץ לגבולות התפקיד.
* משרה זו פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.

job.title: Billing & Order-to-Cash (O2C) Specialist
job.snippet:
Behind the world’s leading cyber-takeover counter-drone technology is an extraordinary team!
At D-Fend Solutions, a Motorola Solutions company, subject matter experts and veterans of elite military tech and intelligence units come together to solve critical security challenges for top-tier customers worldwide.
If you are driven by innovation and thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative culture, we want to meet you.
Join D-Fend Solutions and help us make the world a safer place on the front lines of airspace defense.

Key Responsibilities::
Sales Order Review & Setup: Review executed customer contracts, purchase orders (POs), and quotes for accuracy, payment terms, and proper approvals before provisioning or booking Sales Orders (SOs) in our ERP system.
Invoicing & Billing: Generate and dispatch customer invoices across global entities (US, EMEA, Israel) according to contract milestones, delivery terms (fulfillments), and applicable local tax codes (VAT, sales tax).
Cash Application & Bank Operations: Match daily/weekly incoming bank deposits with outstanding invoices, record cash receipts in the ERP, and manage daily and weekly customer payment reconciliations.
Collections & AR Aging: Monitor outstanding customer balances, generate weekly AR aging reports, follow up proactively on past-due invoices, and resolve billing disputes in coordination with Account Executives.
Audit & Banking Support: Assist with routine banking documentation, audit requests, customer onboarding forms (W-9 / tax residency forms), and cross-functional administrative requests.
Process Improvement: Collaborate closely with the Revenue Accounting team to continuously improve the Quote-to-Cash cycle, streamline billing automation, and minimize processing bottlenecks.

Requirements & Qualifications::
Experience: 1–3 years of hands-on experience in billing, accounts receivable (AR), or order-to-cash operations within a global technology/SaaS/hardware company.
System Proficiency: Prior experience working with ERP systems — NetSuite experience is a significant advantage.
Accounting Background: Certified Bookkeeper ( סוג 2/3 ) or Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, or a related field.
Communication & Languages: Excellent verbal and written English communication skills; comfortable interacting directly with global enterprise customers and international sales teams.
Skills & Attributes:
High level of accuracy, organizational skills, and attention to detail.
Strong Excel skills (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, SUMIFS).
Problem-solving mindset with the ability to manage competing priorities under tight month-end deadlines.

job.title: Vice President of Government Relations
job.snippet:
About D-Fend Solutions
D-Fend Solutions, a Motorola Solutions Company, is the leading global provider of field-proven, RF cyber-driven, non-kinetic, AI-enhanced, counter-drone takeover technology. Our mission is to provide advanced counter-UAS (Unmanned Aerial Systems) solutions that address rogue drone threats in the most sensitive environments. Our core offering, EnforceAir, autonomously executes radio-frequency cyber-takeovers to deliver safe landings and controlled outcomes, enabling military, law enforcement, and critical infrastructure organizations to maintain operational continuity.
 
Position Summary
As Vice President of Government Relations, you will serve as D-Fend Solutions' primary advocate and strategic liaison within the public sector. Operating at the intersection of public policy, defense technology, homeland and national security, you will cultivate relationships with key decision-makers across the Executive Branch, Congress, and relevant regulatory agencies (such as the DoD, DHS, FAA, and DOJ).
You will help shape legislative and regulatory frameworks to support the safe adoption of counter-drone technologies and advance the company's long-term commercial and operational goals in a complex regulatory environment through thought leadership and association engagements.
Location: In-office, McLean, VA / Tysons Corner
Reports To: General Manager
Travel: ~40%

Key Responsibilities::
Strategic Advocacy: Develop and execute a comprehensive U.S. government relations strategy to advance D-Fend Solutions’ interests in coordination with the Motorola Government Affairs team, specifically focusing on policies surrounding airspace security, counter-UAS authorities, defense appropriations, and market access.
Executive Advocacy & Strategy: Design, lead, and execute a comprehensive, multi-year U.S. government relations strategy to advance D-Fend Solutions’ interests. Align these initiatives in coordination with the Motorola Government Affairs team, focusing heavily on enterprise-level policies surrounding airspace security, counter-UAS authorities, defense appropriations, and market access.
Executive Relationship Management: Build, maintain, and leverage a powerful network of trusted relationships with senior congressional members, key committee leadership (Judiciary, Homeland Security, Armed Services, Transportation, etc.), top Executive Branch officials, and federal agency heads (DoD, DHS, FAA, DOJ, TSA), and relevant state-level stakeholders.
Legislative & Regulatory Tracking: Monitor, analyze, and influence federal legislation, budgets, and regulatory developments affecting counter-drone technology, airspace security, public safety, and national security. Track political and regulatory risks, brief leadership on emerging issues, and recommend mitigation strategies, including efforts to expand authorities for trained state, local, tribal, and territorial law enforcement and security personnel.
Internal Executive Collaboration: Serve as a core member of the leadership team, partnering closely with legal, public affairs, and business development executives to ensure government relations strategies integrate seamlessly with broader corporate and go-to-market strategies. Lead post-acquisition coordination with Motorola Solutions’ senior government affairs and public policy teams.
Thought Leadership: Represent D-Fend Solutions at industry coalitions, public forums, trade associations, and working groups (including the Security Industry Association Counter-UAS efforts, AUVSI, and others), contributing to policy papers and joint advocacy campaigns to position the company as the premier authority on non-kinetic rogue drone mitigation.
Resource & External Management: Oversee and direct external lobbying firms, consultants, and advisory boards, establishing performance metrics and ensuring strict adherence to all federal lobbying laws and corporate ethics compliance guidelines.
Executive Communications: Oversee the drafting and approval of high-level briefing materials, talking points, congressional testimony, official comment letters, and overarching position papers for both internal leadership and external policymakers.
Strategic Business Development Support: Empower business development and sales teams by providing strategic insights on high-value public sector opportunities across airports, critical infrastructure, major events, public safety, and federal markets.
Government Engagement & Events: Organize and support site visits, demonstrations, congressional briefings, and industry events as needed.

Qualifications::
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Political Science, Public Policy, International Relations, or a related field; Master’s degree or J.D. highly preferred.
Experience: 12–15+ years of progressively senior executive experience in government relations, public affairs, or legislative roles, with a proven track record of executive leadership within the defense, aerospace, or homeland security sectors.
Network: Demonstrated success building relationships and advancing policy objectives with senior officials across the Executive Branch, Congress, and federal agencies on a broad range of public policy issues.
Network: Demonstrated executive-level success building relationships and advancing enterprise-level policy objectives with senior officials across the Executive Branch, Congress, and federal agencies.
Subject Matter Expertise: Deep, authoritative understanding of the U.S. legislative and regulatory process, federal procurement and multi-million-dollar appropriations, and the regulatory landscape governing domestic airspace, national security, aviation, critical infrastructure, and defense technology.
Executive Skills: Exceptional executive leadership, strategic vision, and tactical adeptness to balance high-level policy advocacy with actionable, enterprise-wide business goals. Proven ability to build and manage high-performing teams.
Communication: Masterful written and verbal communication skills, capable of distilling highly complex technical and policy issues into persuasive executive briefing materials and overarching advocacy campaigns.
Industry Engagement: Extensive history of holding leadership or board roles within industry associations, coalitions, or multi-stakeholder advocacy efforts.
Adaptability: Ability to operate effectively as an executive in a fast-growing, entrepreneurial environment while seamlessly coordinating with the senior leadership of a larger parent organization (Motorola Solutions).
Travel: Willingness to travel regularly (~40%) between the McLean, VA office, Washington, D.C., and high-level customer or event locations throughout the U.S.

Preferred Experience::
Extensive prior executive work shaping policy on counter-UAS, unmanned systems, aviation security, or related airspace policy issues.
Direct experience delivering or prepping C-suite executives for congressional testimony, high-stakes hearings, or national industry advocacy campaigns.
Deep familiarity with public safety technology markets and Motorola Solutions’ executive customer base.
Pre-existing, highly leveraged relationships within relevant congressional committees, DoD, DHS, or FAA leadership.

job.title: Multilayer Systems QA Team Lead
job.snippet:
Behind the world’s leading cyber-takeover counter-drone technology is an extraordinary team!
At D-Fend Solutions, a Motorola Solutions company, subject matter experts and veterans of elite military tech and intelligence units come together to solve critical security challenges for top-tier customers worldwide.
If you are driven by innovation and thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative culture, we want to meet you.
Join D-Fend Solutions and help us make the world a safer place on the front lines of airspace defense.

Responsibilities::
Team Leadership: Manage, mentor, and lead a team of manual system QA engineers across both indoor lab testing and outdoor field trials, acting as a technical focal point for the team.
Field Trials Management: Define, plan, and manage operational field trials to validate the real-world performance of company products.
End-to-End Quality Assurance: Ensure the reliability and consistency of D-Fend products by auditing processes and final outputs from feature development to GA release.
Test Planning & Execution: Design comprehensive test plans (STP, STD, STR) based on product requirements, and execute them efficiently in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Owners and Business Analysts to thoroughly understand requirements and recommend feature or product improvements.
Regression & Reporting: Oversee regression test plans, complete documentation checklists, report exceptions, and maintain accurate records of quality reports and statistical reviews.
Process & Infrastructure Improvement: Implement manual test cases, infrastructures, and quality control Standard Operating Procedures, while evaluating new testing technologies and methodologies.

Qualifications::
Experience: 5+ years of proven experience as a QA Team Lead with strong people and project management skills.
Multidisciplinary Background: Hands-on system-level testing experience across Software, Hardware, and Application layers on multidisciplinary products ( Must ).
Education: B.Sc. in a technical field such as Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline from a recognized university.
QA Methodologies: Deep knowledge of QA tools, concepts, and methodologies, including proven experience writing STP, STD, and STR documentation.
Personal Attributes: Highly detail-oriented, organized, and methodical, with the ability to thrive in a dynamic environment.

Advantages::
Experience in QA testing for defense, military, or HLS (Homeland Security) products.
Expertise with Radar systems – big advantage.

Job Summary
The Front Desk Manager is responsible for overseeing the overall guest arrival, departure, and guest service experience while ensuring operational excellence across the Front Office function. Reporting directly to the Director of Rooms, this position leads and manages three key operational areas: Front Desk, Telephone Operations (PBX), and Bell Services (Bellmen & Doormen).
The Front Desk Manager is accountable for delivering exceptional guest satisfaction, driving service standards, optimizing departmental performance, and leading a high-performing team that reflects the hotel's commitment to excellence and personalized hospitality.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education And Experience
Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
Minimum 3 years of experience in a similar management role.
Previous hospitality experience is required; experience with an international hotel chain is preferred.
Proven managerial and team leadership experience is mandatory.
Fluent in Hebrew and English, both written and spoken.
Strong guest service, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced hospitality environment
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Key Responsibilities
Lead and manage the daily operations of the Front Desk, Telephone Operations, and Bell Services departments.
Ensure smooth and efficient guest arrivals, departures, and overall guest experience.
Handle guest concerns and resolve escalated service issues in a professional and timely manner.
Oversee staffing, scheduling, training, coaching, and performance management of team members.
Ensure compliance with hotel policies, procedures, and service standards.
Collaborate closely with other hotel departments to ensure seamless operations and guest satisfaction.
Monitor departmental performance and implement continuous improvements to enhance service quality and operational efficiency.
Support VIP arrivals, special requests, and high-profile guest experiences.

job.title: Product Manager, Growth (DIY Tax Filing)
job.snippet:
About The Role
We're hiring a Product Manager to own DIY, april's self-serve tax filing flow, inside our Growth squad. DIY is the scale engine of the business: it already serves 1M+ users filing federal and state returns and drives millions of dollars in ARR. It's the product our banking and fintech partners put in front of their entire customer base every tax season, with no preparer in the loop.
You'll own the filer's journey end to end, from the first tap inside a partner's app through the interview, document upload, review, payment, signature, and e-file, to IRS acceptance. Your job is to get more people to a filed, accepted return, faster, with less drop-off, and to turn DIY into a funnel that upgrades filers into assisted tiers when they need help.
You'll report to the VP of Product and work closely with our tax team and GTM teams, alongside engineering, design, and data.
Key Responsibilities

job.title: Product Manager
job.snippet:
Who we are
WeSki is a self-service ski trip booking platform built for the modern traveller. Our vision is simple: to make great ski experiences available to everyone. We enable customers to build and book a fully custom ski holiday in minutes, combining flights, accommodation, transfers, ski passes, equipment and lessons in one seamless flow.
Behind the scenes, our technology checks millions of trip combinations in real time across 1,500+ suppliers and 300+ resorts in 20+ countries, then manages the whole journey, so customers get a trip that just works, backed by a regulated holiday provider.
With sales well above $100M a year, growth is accelerating, unit economics are strong, and the business funds its own growth. High transaction volume, complex infrastructure, real impact, delivered by a small, high-performing team.
We operate in a
~$100B global ski travel market
with no technology-native market leader. The industry is still dominated by traditional tour operators, with business models and infrastructure that have barely evolved in decades. This is a rare opportunity to define the future of ski travel at global scale.
About the role
WeSki is looking for a
Product Manager
to take end-to-end ownership over key product experiences across web applications, infrastructure & integrations, travel operations, AI agent, and customer acquisition.
You’ll be the
primary
Product Manager for a set of product areas, reporting to the Head of Product. You own the outcomes in your areas and share some work with the wider product team. Together with Design, Engineering, Data, CX and Growth, you’ll ship experiences that help skiers plan and book with confidence, then keep making them better.
You’ll thrive here if you love building great experiences and using AI to ship them faster and better. You enjoy B2C, commerce at scale, and the pace of a fast-moving startup. Skier or snowboarder? Even better.
Requirements
5+ years
of product management experience shipping modern digital products.
Meaningful experience delivering web applications
, turning complex exploration and itinerary planning into friendly experiences.
Meaningful experience in B2C
and travel-tech products
at scale
- designing for large user bases, conversion funnels, and iterative growth.
Proven
hands-on experience with AI and AI agents
, using them every day to work faster and better.
What you'll need
High internal motivation: you
love product management
, are curious, and take pride in outcomes.
Comfort operating as
the main owner of multiple product areas
- strong collaboration, prioritization, and communication skills.
Analytical thinker
who digs into data to find the real problem, then sees the fix through to launch.
Experience with A/B testing
, data-driven design and knowledge of experimentation practices.
Process-oriented thinking
: you can structure ambiguity, run end-to-end processes, and choose the right fidelity at the right time.
What you'll do
Own your product areas end-to-end
: set goals, shape the roadmap, and drive work from discovery to launch and beyond.
Influence product strategy
: bring customer, market, and data insights to shape priorities and company roadmap decisions.
Work across the company
: align with Design, Data, Growth, CX, Operations, and leadership, so launches land smoothly.
Partner deeply with Engineering
: work side by side with engineers on problems, trade-offs, and scope, so the team ships fast and well.
Share ownership with the product team
: lead your own areas, and work together with the other PMs on shared ones.
Make decisions with data
: define success metrics, run A/B tests, and use funnel and user data to learn and improve.
Stay close to customers
: run interviews and usability tests, and turn what you learn into product changes.
Write clear specs
: turn ideas into PRDs and user stories the team can build from.
How you'll use AI
AI is part of how we work every day. You’ll use it to:
Write specs
: draft, check, and sharpen PRDs and user stories.
Prototype
: build clickable prototypes to test ideas with users and the team before engineering starts.
Create visuals and mockups
: make flows and mockups that explain your ideas and speed up work with Design.
Ship code
: build small features and fixes that go to production, with Engineering review. You know how, or you’re eager to learn fast.
Research and analyze
: speed up customer research, data analysis, and planning, without dropping quality.

Company Description
WeDev Technologies is a software development agency specializing in designing and developing complex web-based software solutions.
Our company excels in 2 main areas:
Building and maintaining eCommerce shops using the Shopify platform, where our company is one of the only Shopify-certified plus partners in Israel. Building and maintaining complex custom-developed software in a wide variety of technologies for multiple industries. You can find our custom-developed apps in municipalities (such as Tel aviv), government institutions (such as IDF and multiple ministry offices) and in multiple health organizations (such as Assuta and Maccabi)
As a company we are committed to maintaining high standards of technical expertise and guaranteeing superior customer satisfaction.
Role Description
This is a full-time on-site role for a Junior QA Tester located in Holon. As a Junior QA Tester you will be responsible for performing quality control and manual testing of web-based solutions for for huge organizations and brands.
By conducting thorough and pixel-perfect quality tests you will set the development team's and the final product's bar of quality. Ensuring that millions of users will have the best experience possible while using our software solutions.
Qualifications
Basic understanding of web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
Familiarity with how websites work across different browsers and devices
Strong attention to detail and ability to spot inconsistencies or errors
Ability to follow test plans and document results clearly
Good communication skills for working with developers, designers, and project managers
(Bonus) Exposure to tools like Postman, Jira, Trello, or Git — even from personal or academic projects

job.title: Local Support Technician
job.snippet:
Job Description – Local Support Technician
Role Overview
We are looking for a Local Support Technician to join our IT support team within a large international organization. The role is focused on providing on-site end-user support, managing incidents and service requests, and assisting users through the IT Lounge.
Key Responsibilities
Welcome and support users at the IT Lounge, identify their needs, provide guidance, and resolve requests.
Troubleshoot and resolve end-user incidents and service requests.
Install, configure, and set up IT equipment.
Create, track, update, and close tickets using ServiceNow.
Support users with laptops, desktops, smartphones, meeting rooms, and other IT equipment.
Manage and enroll Windows PCs and smartphones.
Provide hands-on support for printers, Wi-Fi, and basic network-related issues.
Maintain and update the IT equipment inventory.
Write and update technical procedures and recommend process improvements.
Provide remote support when required, including assisting with the onboarding of other technicians.
Technical Skills
ServiceNow ticketing tool
Windows 11
Microsoft Office 365
PC and smartphone configuration/enrollment
Desktop and end-user support
Printer, Wi-Fi, and basic networking support
Mac support knowledge is an added advantage
Required Skills
C1-level fluency in Hebrew and English is mandatory.
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Good communication and customer-service skills.
Ability to prioritize incidents and service requests effectively.
Strong team player with a user-focused approach.

job.title: Technical R&D Program Manager – Data Products
job.snippet:
Who We Are
Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
What We Offer
Location:
Rehovot,ISR
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
As a Technical R&D Program Manager in the Data Products Group, you will lead programs and own their full life cycle – from definition and development, through release and field deployment, to support of the installed base – for both NPI and SPI programs. You will lead multidisciplinary teams in a matrix organization, without direct authority, and deliver data platforms, AI applications and CAD-based solutions to their content, quality, schedule and budget targets.
What’s in it for you?
Own strategic programs end to end and have a direct impact on products running in leading semiconductor fabs worldwide.
Work with cutting-edge technology at the intersection of data platforms, AI applications and CAD-based solutions.
Get high exposure to all functions and to senior management, and grow into a broader program role.
Our group
The Data Products Group (DPG), part of SW R&D in Applied Materials’ PDC division, develops data platforms, AI applications and CAD-based solutions deployed at semiconductor fabs worldwide.
Our products run on-premise at customer sites alongside Applied’s inspection, metrology and review tools, and combine high-availability compute platforms with software delivered as configurable, licensed options.
Our program managers work across SW R&D, Computing, Operations, Field Service, Product and Procurement to take products from concept to the installed base and value capture.
What You’ll Be Doing
Lead data-platform programs and own their full life cycle – definition, development, release, field deployment and installed-base support – across NPI and SPI.
Build and run the program framework: charter and scope, success KPIs, integrated plan and critical path, phase gates, governance cadence and decision rights.
Lead a cross-functional core team (SW R&D, Computing, Operations, Field Service, Product, Procurement) without direct authority, align priorities and resolve conflicts with shared platform teams.
Drive decisions: frame options and trade-offs across scope, schedule, cost and quality, make clear recommendations and escalate with a proposal.
Work with Product Management to turn requirements into prioritized, configurable content – standard offering, options and SW features – that is orderable, buildable and upgradable in the field.
Own the path to the field: HW/SW releases and part numbers, site preparation, customer IT and security reviews, installation readiness and a smooth transition to Operations and Field Service.
Manage sustaining activities on the installed base: upgrades and migrations, ECOs, obsolescence and compute-hardware life cycle.
Plan and control the program budget – HC, MCOS, procurement and long-lead material; highlight risks and drive optimizations.
Track and present status, risks, issues and required decisions to senior management, with clear owners and dates.
Take ownership of part of the program-group scope, represent it with leadership and improve program processes and tools.
What You Should Have
Must-have
B.Sc. in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field.
10+ years in R&D of complex HW + SW products, including 5+ years as a project or program manager owning programs end to end.
Proven record leading NPI and/or SPI programs from definition through customer deployment and support of the installed base.
Strong program-management methodology: integrated planning, critical path, risk management, phase gates, governance and budget control.
Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams in a complex, dynamic matrix organization without direct authority.
Strong technical understanding of complex systems – compute platforms, software release processes and their dependencies.
Business sense: budget and cost drivers, procurement and long-lead material, customer environments and challenges.
Excellent communication and presentation skills in English and Hebrew, including to senior management.
Independent, proactive and data-driven; sees the big picture and dives into details when needed.
Nice-to-have
M.Sc. or MBA
Experience in the semiconductor equipment industry or with products installed at customer sites.
Experience with AI/ML products, data platforms or on-premise AI/HPC infrastructure.
Familiarity with CAD-based or design-data applications.
Knowledge of IT infrastructure: servers, storage, networking, security and high availability.
Experience with configurable products: BOM structures, SW licensing and field-upgrade kits.
Hands-on use of PM tools (e.g., Smartsheet, Jira) and GenAI tools to improve program work; PMP or similar certification.
Additional Information
Time Type:
Full time
Employee Type:
Assignee / Regular
Travel:
Yes, 10% of the Time
Relocation Eligible:
Yes
Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

Lead data-platform programs and own their full life cycle – definition, development, release, field deployment and installed-base support – across NPI and SPI.

Lead a cross-functional core team (SW R&D, Computing, Operations, Field Service, Product, Procurement) without direct authority, align priorities and resolve conflicts with shared platform teams.
Drive decisions: frame options and trade-offs across scope, schedule, cost and quality, make clear recommendations and escalate with a proposal.
Work with Product Management to turn requirements into prioritized, configurable content – standard offering, options and SW features – that is orderable, buildable and upgradable in the field.
Own the path to the field: HW/SW releases and part numbers, site preparation, customer IT and security reviews, installation readiness and a smooth transition to Operations and Field Service.
Manage sustaining activities on the installed base: upgrades and migrations, ECOs, obsolescence and compute-hardware life cycle.
Plan and control the program budget – HC, MCOS, procurement and long-lead material; highlight risks and drive optimizations.
Track and present status, risks, issues and required decisions to senior management, with clear owners and dates.

Strong technical understanding of complex systems – compute platforms, software release processes and their dependencies.
Business sense: budget and cost drivers, procurement and long-lead material, customer environments and challenges.

job.title: FP&A Specialist – AI & Automation
job.snippet:
About the position (role & team):
We're looking for an FP&A Specialist with a strong builder mindset to join our Finance team, reporting to the FP&A director. You'll own forecasting, budgeting and performance analysis for our global SaaS business, and you'll design and build the AI-powered tools and workflows that change how FP&A works, from automated reporting to AI agents connected to our planning and data systems. This role is for a finance professional who builds and ships, not only analyzes. The role is hybrid, based in our Tel Aviv office.
Responsibilities:
AI & automation in FP&A
Design, build and maintain AI-powered tools and workflows across finance: AI agents, automated reporting and analysis, and integrations between our planning platform, BI and source systems. Own the FP&A tool stack and data quality, and help the Finance team and other departments adopt the tools you build.
Budget & rolling forecast
Lead the annual budget and rolling forecast process across revenue, opex and headcount, working closely with budget owners across the company.
SaaS metrics & financial modeling
Build and maintain driver-based models for key SaaS metrics: ARR, NRR, churn, CAC, LTV, gross margin and burn.
Budget vs. actuals & variance analysis
Run monthly BvA reviews, explain variances clearly to budget owners and leadership, and highlight risks and opportunities.
Headcount & workforce planning
Partner with department heads on hiring plans, headcount tracking and cost control.
Executive & board reporting
Prepare board and management reporting, KPI dashboards and executive summaries, and support strategic projects such as pricing, new markets and M&A.
Requirements:
Proven hands-on experience as an AI builder: designing and shipping AI-powered processes and tools end to end (e.g. automated finance workflows, AI agents, custom tools), not just using chat assistants. Please share examples of what you've built.
Strong technical skills: Python and SQL for data work and automation, and experience with APIs, integrations and data pipelines between systems.
Practical knowledge of LLM tooling: prompt engineering, agents, tool-calling MCP, on platforms such as Claude or OpenAI. Experience with automation platforms (e.g. n8n, Make, Zapier) – an advantage.
3+ years in FP&A, corporate finance or investment banking, with a proven track record of building forecasts and models that drive business decisions.
3+ years of experience in a SaaS company, with a deep understanding of subscription revenue and unit economics.
Advanced Excel / Google Sheets modeling; experience with an FP&A planning platform (e.g. Adaptive, Anaplan, Pigment) and BI tools.
Excellent communication skills - able to explain complex numbers and technical solutions simply, and influence non-finance stakeholders up to C-level. Fluent English (written and spoken); Hebrew – an advantage.
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science or a related field; CPA, CFA or MBA – an advantage.
Experience in an AI or data-driven tech company and in a global, fast-paced scale-up – an advantage.
About Optibus:
Optibus is a unified software platform revolutionizing public transportation planning, scheduling, and operations in over 8,000 cities worldwide. Using AI, ML, and optimization algorithms, it empowers agencies to design more efficient, equitable, and sustainable transit networks, enhancing passenger access, reducing emissions, and improving driver conditions. With offices globally and a team of 250+ employees, Optibus fosters a collaborative culture centered on innovation, determination, and impact. As the first unicorn in public transportation technology, Optibus is driving the modernization of mass transit to make it the preferred choice for cities and passengers alike.
Why Join Optibus?
Be part of a company revolutionizing public transportation with cutting-edge technology.
Collaborate with global teams passionate about sustainability and innovation.
Enjoy a dynamic and inclusive workplace culture that values growth and creativity.
We offer a hybrid work environment, with employees expected to be in the office 3 days a week. The remaining days can be worked remotely to support work-life balance and flexibility.
Optibus

We hire talented individuals, regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, ancestry, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, cultural background, religious beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. It is our responsibility at Optibus to provide an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all. We will provide reasonable accommodations for all candidates in need of individualised support during the hiring process.

job.snippet:
ס

הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
למשרד עורכי הדין סודרי קינן חן זהר דורפמן ושות׳ בהוד השרון דרוש/ה עוזר/ת מנכ״ל תקתקן/ית וייצוגי/ת!
תפקיד מפתח בלב העשייה של המשרד! אנחנו מחפשים יד ימין אמיתית שתנהל את הלו"ז, המשימות והשוטף ברמה הגבוהה ביותר.
מה בתפקיד?
ניהול יומנים מורכבים, תיאום פגישות וישיבות עבור הנהלת המשרד ספקים ולקוחות VIP.
ניהול אדמיניסטרטיבי שוטף של הלשכה, ניסוח מסמכים, מצגות והתכתבויות.
סיוע בפרויקטים מיוחדים, כנסים ופעילות שיווקית של המשרד.
תנאים והיקף משרה:
מיקום: הוד השרון.
שעות עבודה: א׳–ה׳, 08:30–17:30.
שכר: תנאים מצוינים, סביבת עבודה יוקרתית ואווירה משפחתית ומפרגנת.
דרישות התפקיד
ניסיון קודם בתפקיד עוזר/ת מנכ״ל / ניהול לשכה / ניהול משרד – חובה.
שליטה מלאה ביישומי Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) ויכולת למידה מהירה של מערכות חדשות.
שליטה במערכות - עודכנית פלטינום נט המשפט וכלים שלובים - יתרון משמעותי!
יחסי אנוש מצוינים, ייצוגיות, תושייה, דיסקרטיות ויכולת לתעדף משימות תחת לחץ.
ראש גדול וראייה מערכתית.
* משרה זו פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.

job.snippet: אחראי פיתוח פרוייקטים אנרגיה סולארית- פעילות בינ"ל | כלמוביל | כפר סבא | 3-4 שנים | משרה מלאה | לפני 7 שעות | איך יראה היום שלך? הובלת וקידום פרויקטים הובלת תהליכי הפיתוח של פרויקטים סולאריים ואגירה במדינות השונות. בניית תוכניות פיתוח ומעקב אחר הפרויקטים משלב הרכישה ועד להקמה. קידום תהליכי פיתוח בשלבים שונים, לרבות בחינת קרקעות, התקשרויות עם בעלי קרקע וקידום התנאים הנדרשים למימוש הפרויקט. קידום ומעקב אחר תהליכי סטטוטוריקה, רישוי, היתרים וחיבור לרשת החשמל. זיהוי חסמים וסיכונים, הצפת פערים והובלת פתרונות לקידום הפרויקטים. ניהול ממשקים ושותפים מקומיים ניהול קשרי עבודה שוטפים והנעת מפתחים ושותפים מקומיים במדינות הפעילות. ניהול ותיאום עבודת יועצים כגון: יועצים משפטיים, הנדסיים, סביבתיים ותכנוניים. עבודה מול רשויות, מוסדות תכנון וגורמים רגולטוריים דרך השותפים המקומיים. תיאום בין כלל הגורמים בפרויקט, לרבות הנדסה, משפטי, כספים, מימון ועוד. בקרה תקציבית וניהול תהליכים מעקב ובקרה אחר תקציבים, ניהול ובקרה של לוחות זמנים, ותוכניות עבודה. מעקב אחר מודלים כלכליים ונתוני הפרויקט, והבנת השפעת על כדאיו

job.snippet:
ש
מהנדס.ת ביצועים ו-commissioning

הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
לחברה ציבורית יזמית בתחום האנרגיה הסולארית ואגירת האנרגיה דרוש.ה מהנדס.ת ביצועים ו-commissioning למחלקת ההנדסה.
תחומי אחריות:
- ניתוח ביצועי מתקנים סולאריים ומערכות אגירת אנרגיה, זיהוי בעיות והובלת פעולות לשיפור הביצועים והאמינות.
- הובלת בדיקות ביצועים ובדיקות קבלה של מתקנים והכנתם לקראת תחילת ההפעלה המסחרית.
- ליווי המעבר משלב הקמת המתקנים לשלב התפעול, כולל כתיבה והטמעה של נהלי עבודה, תפעול ותחזוקה.
- מתן תמיכה מקצועית לצוות התפעול, איתור וניתוח תקלות מורכבות ומתן פתרונות הנדסיים.
- תיעוד תקלות ופתרונות, הפקת לקחים ושימור הידע המקצועי בחברה.
- הובלת שדרוגים הנדסיים והטמעת טכנולוגיות חדשות במתקנים קיימים.
- ליווי מקצועי של היבטים טכניים בחוזים מול ספקים וקבלנים, בתחומי הרכש, ההקמה והתפעול, כולל הגדרת יעדי ביצועים, זמינות ותחזוקה.

- מהנדס/ת חשמל עם רישיון חשמלאי/ת מהנדס/ת.
- ניסיון של 3 שנים לפחות בתפקיד הנדסי בתחום החשמל, האנרגיה או התשתיות.
- ניסיון בניתוח ביצועים, זיהוי פערים וניתוח כשל
- יכולת פתרון תקלות מורכבות במערכות חשמל, בקרה ומערכות אנרגיה.
- היכרות עם SCADA, מערכות ניטור ובקרה

interplus

3-4 שנים

הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
אינטר פלוס מגייסת אחראי/ת לוגיסטיקה שיקח/תיקח חלק בהקמת תחמ"שים ( מתח עליון, ומתקני אגירה בערבה)
מיקום הפרויקטים: אתרי הבנייה בערבה – נאות סמדר / נווה חריף / תמנע
נאות סמדר- עולים בנובמבר
נווה חריף + תימנע- עולים בינואר
תחומי אחריות:
אחריות על  המערך הלוגיסטי ומחסן השטח של פרויקט הקמת תחנת משנה (תחמ"ש) ומתקני אנרגיה בערבה.
התפקיד כולל שליטה מלאה על שרשרת קבלת הציוד, הציוד הכבד וחומרי החשמל, אחסונם, ניפוקם לצוותים ולקבלני המשנה, שמירה על סדר ותחזוקת האתר השוטפת.
אחריות על  מחסן האתר ושליטה במלאי: קליטה ופריקה של חומרי חשמל, תשתיות וציוד כבד; סידור המחסן ומשטחי הפריקה בשטח האתר; ניהול ספירות מלאי שוטפות ומניעת פחת או חוסרים.
בקרת קבלת סחורה וקשר מול ספקים: קבלת משאיות ואספקות, בדיקת התאמה בין הציוד שהגיע בשטח לתעודות המשלוח וההזמנות, חתימה וקליטת תעודות משלוח במערכת ממוחשבת.
ניפוק ציוד וכלי עבודה לצוותים ולקבלנים: הוצאת חומרים לקבלני המשנה ולצוותי ההתקנות לפי תוכנית עבודה, רישום קפדני ומעקב שוטף אחר החזרות כלי עבודה וציוד ייעודי.
תחזוקה שוטפת וסדר באתר הבנייה: אחריות על הסדר, הניקיון, השילוט, וסיוע בארגון הלוגיסטיקה הכללית של המחנה/האתר לרווחת הצוותים ובטיחותם.
דרישות התפקיד
ניסיון קודם בלוגיסטיקה / מחסן באתרי בנייה, תשתיות, אנרגיה או תעשייה כבדה – חובה.
ניסיון בקבלת סחורה, עבודה מול תעודות משלוח וניפוק לקבלני משנה – חובה.
היכרות עם ציוד וחומרי חשמל/תשתיות – יתרון משמעותי.
רישיון נהיגה על מלגזה – יתרון משמעותי.
רישיון נהיגה בתוקף
ידע על תוכנות מחשב- פריורטי יתרון
עדיפות- מגורים  באזור מצפה רמון והערבה

•	תמיכה טכנית שוטפת ללקוחות עסקיים – מחשבים, רשתות, Microsoft 365, גיבויים וענן.
•	עבודה לצד מנהל אבטחת המידע: סיוע בסקרי סיכונים, מיפוי מאגרי מידע ויישום דרישות תיקון 13 .
•	שיפור מערכות לקוח ונהלי העבודה לטובת אבטחת מידע .
•	קשר ישיר עם לקוחות, הצעות מחיר, ורעיונות משלך איך לפתח את המחלקה.
•	שילוב של טכני, אבטחת מידע ופיתוח עסקי. לא משעמם לרגע.

מה אנחנו מחפשים?
•	ידע וניסיון ברשתות ובתמיכה במחשבים – חובה.
•	היכרות עם Microsoft 365 וכלי אבטחת מידע – יתרון משמעותי.
•	ראש גדול, יצירתיות ויכולת לעבוד מול לקוחות בגובה העיניים.
•	אוהב/ת אנשים לא פחות ממחשבים, ולא מפחד/ת להציע רעיון.
•	רצון ללמוד ולהתפתח לתחום אבטחת המידע.
•	מתחיל/ה עם ראש פתוח או מנוסה שרוצה שינוי – שניהם מצוינים !

סאני תקשורת

3-4 שנים

רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
Creative Labs היא חברה טכנולוגית בצמיחה, המתמחה בתכנון, פיתוח והטמעה של פתרונות טכנולוגיים חדשניים וחוויות דיגיטליות במרחבים פיזיים, תוך שילוב בין אדריכלות, עיצוב, תוכן וטכנולוגיה.
כחברה קטנה ומתפתחת, אנו מחפשים אחראי/ת מוקד שירות ותמיכה טכנית לתפקיד משמעותי ועצמאי, המשלב ניהול קריאות שירות מקצה לקצה, מתן תמיכה טכנית ראשונית, אבחון ופתרון תקלות מרחוק, תיאום גורמי טיפול והבטחת רציפות השירות ללקוחות החברה.
תחומי אחריות:
- ניהול קריאות שירות מקצה לקצה, משלב פתיחת הקריאה ועד לפתרון וסגירה.
- מתן תמיכה טכנית ראשונית (Tier 1), אבחון ופתרון תקלות בסיסיות מרחוק.
- תיאום טכנאי שטח, ספקים וגורמי תמיכה מקצועיים.
- מעקב אחר זמני תגובה וטיפול בהתאם ליעדי SLA.
- ניהול קשר שוטף עם לקוחות, עדכון סטטוסים ומעקב אחר פתרון תקלות.
- תיעוד תקלות, הפקת דוחות ושיפור תהליכי שירות באמצעות כלי AI ואוטומציה.
דרישות התפקיד
- ניסיון ב-Helpdesk, בתמיכה טכנית או בתיאום שירות טכני.
- ניסיון בעבודה עם מערכות לניהול קריאות שירות.
- ידע טכני במחשבים, Windows, רשתות ופתרון תקלות מרחוק.
- יכולת אבחון תקלות ומתן מענה ראשוני באופן עצמאי.
- ניסיון מעשי בשימוש בכלי AI כגון ChatGPT או Claude – חובה.
- יכולת עבודה מול ממשקים מרובים, סדר וארגון, שירותיות ואחריות אישית.
- אנגלית טכנית טובה.
- ניסיון במערכות Digital Signage, מסכי LED, מערכות AV או CMS – יתרון.

job.title: C++ Embedded Software Team Leader – In-Vehicle HD Maps
job.snippet:
We are part of Mobileye's REM (Road Experience Management) organization, responsible for the HD maps that power Mobileye's autonomous driving technologies.
We develop the in-vehicle map platform, responsible for downloading, caching, managing, and distributing HD map data within the vehicle. Our software runs on automotive computing platforms and provides efficient map APIs to other in-vehicle components, as well as map protocols for communication with other ECUs.
We also develop map-based algorithms, including route calculation and lane network generation, which are key components of autonomous driving systems.
We are looking for a hands-on Software Team Leader to lead a new development team working alongside our existing team. This is a highly technical leadership role combining low-level, real-time C++ development, software architecture, and people management.
What will your job look like:
Lead and grow a small team of C++ software engineers, taking ownership of technical execution, code quality, and delivery. Remain hands-on in software design, architecture, coding, and debugging.
Design and develop high-performance, real-time C++ software for embedded automotive systems.
Develop infrastructure for HD map downloading, caching, storage, management, and distribution.
Design and implement efficient map APIs and communication protocols for in-vehicle components and ECUs.
Develop and optimize map-based algorithms, including routing and lane network generation.
Optimize software for runtime performance, memory efficiency, and reliability under embedded system constraints.
Work closely with the existing team leader to ensure strong technical alignment, effective collaboration, and shared architectural direction.
Collaborate with product and project managers, other development teams, and customers to define requirements and deliver production-ready solutions.
Mentor team members, drive technical excellence, and contribute to architectural and design decisions.
All you need is:
B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
At least 5 years of hands-on experience developing production software in C++, preferably in low-level, embedded, or real-time environments.
Proven experience leading a small software development team, including technical leadership, task planning, mentoring, and delivery ownership.
Strong software architecture, design, and object-oriented programming skills.
Solid understanding of performance optimization, memory management, concurrency, and multithreaded programming.
Excellent coding, debugging, and complex problem-solving abilities.
Ability to lead complex technical projects from design through production.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and organizational boundaries.
Experience working with multiple stakeholders, including project managers, development teams, and customers.
A collaborative mindset and the ability to build a strong working relationship with a peer team leader.
Nice to have:
Experience developing embedded or real-time software for automotive systems.
Experience with Linux-based embedded systems.
Familiarity with map data, navigation, routing algorithms, or geospatial technologies.
Experience developing communication protocols and APIs for embedded systems.
Experience with performance-critical software running under strict CPU and memory constraints.
Mobileye changes the way we drive, from preventing accidents to semi and fully autonomous vehicles. If you are an excellent, bright, hands-on person with a passion to make a difference come to lead the revolution!

job.title: Operations Analyst
job.snippet:
We’re looking for an
Operations Analyst
to join our growing team at Mize, a fast-paced travel-tech startup transforming the way the travel industry operates through cutting-edge technology.
In this role, you'll be at the heart of our operations, ensuring that processes run smoothly, efficiently, and are continuously optimized. You’ll work closely on our flag product, taking ownership of daily operations, data integrity, and customer health. Your responsibilities will include business analysis, identifying growth opportunities, and driving operational excellence.
This role is perfect for someone analytical, curious, and passionate about making an impact across multiple domains of the business. The position is based in Tel Aviv and Rehovot.
What You'll Do
Monitor and maintain daily operations of our flagship product, ensuring all data-related tasks are completed accurately and on time.
Conduct customer and data investigations to uncover insights, optimize performance, and identify areas for improvement.
Perform customer health checks and develop strategies to maximize client satisfaction and engagement.
Analyze business processes and identify opportunities for operational improvements and efficiencies.
Implement standards and workflows to streamline operations and support company scale-up.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve product flows and resolve operational challenges creatively.
Provide reports on operational performance and suggest actionable improvements.
Contribute to data structure integration and maintain high-quality data standards.
Requirements:
2+ years of experience in operations, data analysis, technical support or a similar analytical/operational role
Bachelors degree in Industrial Engineering, Information Technology etc.
Knowledge of SQL, data analytics tools, and reporting platforms
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities
Excellent communication skills in English
Ability to work in a dynamic environment with tight deadlines and shifting priorities
Self-starter with a strong sense of ownership and curiosity
A team player with a can-do attitude and eagerness to learn and grow
Experience in the travel-tech industry – big advantage

ניהול שוטף של אתרי האיקומרס בישראל ובארה״ב.

אחריות על נראות האתר, חוויית המשתמש ושיפור מסע הלקוח.
עבודה על שיפור שיעורי המרה, הגדלת סל הקנייה וביצועי האתר.

שיפור ופיתוח האתר בשיתוף אנשי פיתוח וספקים חיצוניים.
עבודה שוטפת מול צוותי השיווק, הקריאייטיב והסושיאל.

יכולת עבודה עצמאית, דיוק, סדר וירידה לפרטים.
עין עיצובית מפותחת והבנה בשפה מותגית.
ניסיון ב־Canva, Photoshop או תוכנות עיצוב — יתרון.
הבנה ב־SEO, כלי אנליטיקה ודיוור — יתרון.
אנגלית ברמה טובה.
