job.title: CRM & Sales Operations Manager
job.snippet:
Crystalia Glass LLC is a U.S.-based manufacturer and provider of premium glass solutions, specializing in custom glass partitions for residential, commercial, and institutional projects. We operate a full-cycle model — from design and manufacturing to sales, delivery, and installation.
We are strengthening our commercial function and looking for a
CRM & Sales Operations Manager
to own the CRM, the sales process and data quality across the full funnel, from first contact to order handover. This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role with no direct reports.
Employment Type:
Full-time 8.30 am - 5 pm, NY (EST zone)
Remote work
B2B contract (sole proprietorship status or corporate entity)
Key responsibilities:
CRM setup and process design
Personally configure CRM fields, stages, reports and automation; scope complex changes and integrations for developers and test them before release
Define rules for each stage: goal, entry and exit criteria, required data and next steps
Set ownership at each stage and at handover, and agree SLAs for response time and escalation
Process control and data quality
Audit deals to check that CRM stages and next steps match actual client communication
Monitor overdue tasks, stalled deals, missing next steps and missing loss reasons
Keep CRM data accurate and resolve recurring issues with team leads
Training
Write short CRM instructions and train sales reps and team leads to manage deals correctly, including after every change
Reporting and analytics
Build funnel reports and dashboards: conversion by stage, stage duration, loss reasons and SLA adherence
Measure the impact of process changes and share data with sales leadership and the Sales Effectiveness Manager
Automation and AI
Use AI to analyze CRM data and prepare next actions for reps, with human review before anything reaches a client
Build AI workflows for the sales team and maintain AI agents and bots connected to the CRM
Requirements
The core of this role is hands-on CRM administration and sales process design.
5+ years of experience in CRM administration, sales operations or revenue operations, including owning the CRM and sales processes, not only supporting them
Hands-on CRM setup (HubSpot, Salesforce or similar): fields, stages and permissions
Hands-on experience bringing AI into a sales team's daily work, from building to measuring results
Understanding of the full sales cycle, from first contact to order handover
Experience designing deal stages, handover rules and SLAs
Experience automating deal workflows and writing requirements for integrations
Experience fixing CRM data issues and building sales reports personally
Strong analytical skills and careful conclusions from data
Experience training sales reps to work correctly in the CRM
Experience driving change through team leads without direct authority; strong team player
Fluent English (C1/C2)
Nice to have
Setting up or migrating a CRM from scratch
Experience with a complex physical product with a long sales cycle
Benefits
Competitive base salary + performance-based bonuses
Full ownership of the CRM and sales operations in a fast-growing U.S. company, with the freedom to build them the right way
Direct influence on how the sales process runs, with data that leadership relies on
Hands-on work with automation and AI in real sales processes
Joining a highly professional and dynamic team
Exciting experience working with prestigious clients in the US market

job.title: Junior Forward Deployed Engineer | AI Agents
job.snippet:
hms is looking for a Junior Forward Deployed Engineer – AI Agents! 📣
Our Intelligent Automation department is looking for a Computer Science or Software Engineering graduate who enjoys building software, solving real-world problems, and working with people.
This junior role combines hands-on development, AI, integrations, and direct client interaction — from understanding a business need to building, testing, and improving a working solution.
What will you do?
🔹 Design and develop AI agents and end-to-end workflows
🔹 Work with clients to understand their needs and translate them into technical solutions
🔹 Build Backend components, business logic, and integrations with enterprise systems
🔹 Work with JavaScript, TypeScript, REST APIs, Webhooks, and JSON
🔹 Integrate LLMs, AI tools, and data sources into business processes
🔹 Test, deploy, troubleshoot, and continuously improve solutions
🔹 Collaborate closely with development and architecture teams
What are we looking for?
✅ A completed bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering
✅ Hands-on development experience through a meaningful academic, personal, or professional project – building an application, Backend service, or integrated solution
✅ Ability to explain your contribution, technical decisions, testing approach, and how you handled challenges
✅ Ability to learn independently, explore technical documentation, and take ownership of problems
✅ Ability to clarify needs, explain technical ideas clearly, collaborate, and respond to feedback
✅ Curiosity about AI and motivation to build practical solutions
Nice to have:
🔸 Experience building AI agents or working with LLM integrations, tool calling, or RAG
🔸 Familiarity with JavaScript/TypeScript, asynchronous programming, APIs, or system integrations
🔸 Experience working with users, providing training, or mentoring others
No previous professional development experience is required – meaningful projects count!
Why join us?
With us, you'll learn much more than just a tool or technology. You'll learn how to design and build complete AI solutions: from understanding business processes and customer needs, through designing the right architecture and integrations, to development, testing, and implementation in real-world environments.
You'll be part of an experienced team, gain exposure to a wide variety of technologies, clients, and business processes, and continuously learn and grow in the rapidly evolving world of AI.

job.snippet:
רכז/ת קשרי דיירים ומזכיר/ת פרויקט
שבירו הנדסה בניה והשקעות בע"מ

הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
קבוצת שבירו מגייסת רכז/ת קשרי דיירים ומזכיר/ת פרויקט למעונות הסטודנטים בתל אביב ובראשון לציון.
לתפקיד מגוון ודינמי המשלב קשר שוטף עם דיירי המעונות, שיווק והשכרה, שירות לקוחות ואחריות על האדמיניסטרציה השוטפת של המתחם.
תחומי אחריות:
שיווק המעונות למתעניינים, ניהול תהליכי רישום, השכרה וחתימת חוזים.
ליווי דיירים בתהליכי כניסה למעונות, במהלך תקופת המגורים ובסיומה.
מתן שירות ומענה שוטף לדיירים, לרבות טיפול בפניות, תלונות וקריאות שירות.
אחריות על אכיפת תקנון המעונות, קשרי קהילה וחוויית הדייר.
ניהול אדמיניסטרטיבי שוטף של המתחם ומתן תמיכה למנהל/ת האתר.
עבודה מול ספקים, נותני שירות וממשקים פנים־ארגוניים.
ניהול ועדכון נתוני דיירים, חוזים ומסמכים במערכות הממוחשבות.
הפקת דוחות, ביצוע בקרות ומעקב אחר משימות ותהליכים שוטפים.
דרישות התפקיד
ניסיון קודם בתפקיד המשלב שירות לקוחות פרונטלי ואדמיניסטרציה – חובה.
אוריינטציה טכנולוגית גבוהה, שליטה טובה מאוד ביישומי Office, בדגש על Excel, ויכולת למידה מהירה של מערכות ממוחשבות – חובה.
אנגלית ברמה גבוהה – חובה.
ניסיון בעבודה עם Salesforce – יתרון משמעותי.
ניסיון בתחום הנדל"ן המניב, המגורים להשכרה או מעונות סטודנטים – יתרון.
ניסיון בעבודה מול ספקים ונותני שירות – יתרון.
תודעת שירות גבוהה, יחסי אנוש מצוינים ויכולת התמודדות עם מצבים מורכבים.
סדר, ארגון, עצמאות, יוזמה ויכולת ניהול מספר משימות במקביל.
גמישות בשעות העבודה בתקופות כניסה ועזיבה של דיירים.
* משרה זו פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.

רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
CBRE היא חברה גלובלית מובילה בתחום הנדל"ן המסחרי והמניב, המספקת שירותי ניהול, תפעול ואחזקה לחברות וארגונים מובילים. אנו מחפשים חשמלאי/ת אחזקה לתפקיד מגוון הכולל-
* ביצוע עבודות אחזקת מנע ותחזוקת שבר של מערכות חשמל במבנים.
* טיפול בתקלות חשמל ובמערכות אלקטרומכניות.
* עבודה עם לוחות חשמל, מערכות פיקוד ובקרה, תאורה ומנועים.
* ביצוע סיורים תקופתיים ובדיקות שוטפות לשמירה על תקינות המערכות והתשתיות.
* מתן מענה לקריאות שירות וטיפול בתקלות בזמן אמת.
* עבודה עם מערכות בקרת מבנה (BMS) ומערכות תומכות מבנה.
* השתלבות באתר קבוע או במסגרת צוותי שירות ניידים.
דרישות התפקיד
* רישיון חשמלאי/ת מוסמך/ת, ראשי/ת או בכיר/ה בתוקף - חובה.
* ניסיון של שנתיים לפחות באחזקת חשמל, אלקטרומכניקה או תפעול מערכות במבנים - חובה.
* היכרות עם לוחות חשמל, מערכות פיקוד ובקרה ומערכות מיזוג אוויר - יתרון משמעותי.
* רישיון נהיגה בתוקף - חובה למשרות שטח וצוותים ניידים.
* יכולת עבודה עצמאית ופתרון תקלות בשטח.
* תודעת שירות גבוהה, יחסי אנוש מצוינים ויכולת עבודה בצוות.
מה אנחנו מציעים?
* השתלבות בחברה בינלאומית מובילה.
* סביבת עבודה מקצועית ודינמית.
* אפשרויות קידום והתפתחות מקצועית.
* מגוון תפקידים בפריסה ארצית.
* תנאים מצוינים למתאימים/ות.
* משרה זו פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.

job.title: USA Channel Pre-Sales Engineer
job.snippet:
Join D-Fend Solutions — where technology meets purpose.
As the global leader in cyber-takeover counter-drone technology, we develop advanced solutions that keep airspaces safe from evolving drone threats. Our team — including veterans of elite military tech units — pushes boundaries every day to deliver smarter, faster, and safer protection for customers worldwide.
If you’re passionate about cutting-edge technology, real-world impact, and working in a collaborative, high-energy environment — we’d love to have you on board.
Become a D-Fender. Shape the future of airspace security.

Specific Duties and Activities::
• Controlled Partner Demonstrations: Plan, rehearse, and operate live C-UAS system demonstrations for partner-sourced opportunities and multi-stop roadshows. Ensure D-Fend's standard demo processes, system configurations, and safety protocols are followed every time.
• Partner Technical Enablement: Support partner technical onboarding and training curriculums in coordination with Customer Success and HQ. Deliver technical coaching to partner personnel to build system familiarity and support the path to partner-led demos as the channel matures.
• Operational and Regulatory Coordination: Hold regular operational syncs with partner technical points of contact. Review partner roadshow schedules, verify partner-secured flight approvals, and ensure assigned partner pilots are fully certified and briefed.
• Pre-Sales Process and Post-Demo Cadence: Adhere strictly to the pre-sales operational lifecycle, including hold-the-date and confirm-the-date milestones, site surveys, equipment transit logistics, and on-site rehearsals.
• Cross-Functional Surge Support: Provide technical pre-sales and field engineering coverage across the wider U.S. Pre-Sales and Customer Success teams during high-tempo operational periods, major industry events, and strategic direct accounts.
• Pipeline and Operational Feedback: Translate registered partner pipeline and roadshow forecasts into travel and resource plans. Consistently feed partner-reported field requirements, technical objections, and environmental observations back to U.S. leadership and R&D.

Mandatory Requirements::
• Experience Level: 5+ years of professional experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Pre-Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Field Applications Engineer, or Technical Partner Specialist.
• Education: Bachelor's degree in a STEM discipline, Business, Aviation/Aeronautics, or a related field (or equivalent practical technical experience).
• Location Requirement: Must be available for an on-site position based out of our Tysons Corner, VA office when not traveling.
• Channel and Partner Acumen: Demonstrated experience working with value-added resellers (VARs), systems integrators, or distribution partners. Skilled at maintaining high technical standards and clear operational boundaries while enabling external sales teams.
• FAA Remote Pilot Certification: Valid FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate required within 60 days of hire (active Part 107 certification at start is strongly preferred). Familiarity with airspace authorization processes (LAANC, COAs) is desired.
• Field Execution and Logistics: Willingness and physical ability to manage, transport, set up, and operate expeditionary field equipment outdoors in varied operational and weather conditions.
• Audience Command and Presence: Proven ability to present and command confidence in front of mixed audiences, ranging from field operators and tactical law enforcement to executive buyers, aviation and commercial decision makers, as well as defense program staff.
• Process Discipline: Methodical approach and strong attention to detail to documentation, operational checklists, travel planning, after-action reporting, and equipment accountability.
• Travel: Willingness and ability to travel 50% or more across North America, frequently for multi-stop regional roadshows scheduled on tight timelines.
• Work Authorization: Legally authorized to work in the United States.

Ideal Candidate Qualifications::

As the global leader in cyber-takeover counter-drone technology, we develop advanced solutions that keep airspaces safe from evolving drone threats. If you’re passionate about cutting-edge technology, real-world impact, and working in a collaborative, high-energy environment — we’d love to have you on board.
Become a D-Fender. Shape the future of airspace security.

job.snippet:
Looking to have fun and help people in an exciting role?
Open Position at PRT Technologies - Priority Implementation Project Manager
(Note: Relevant only for residents of Israel, no Priority ERP experience required)
Responsible for delivering the following results:
- Getting a satisfaction rating of 8.5 or above (on a 1-10 scale) from clients after delivery of Priority ERP projects that meet their requirements
- Receiving a satisfaction rating of 8.5 or above from clients after training client team members on all modules of Priority, especially financials
- Successfully troubleshooting and solving issues clients have with Priority within 3 days, and within 1 day for critical issues
- Projects for clients went live with requirements met, on time and within budget
- Definitions for software customizations that:
o meet client requirements and
o are bug free when released to clients
You are responsible for creating the definition, testing and training the client team, while our development team does the development.
Required qualities:
- Positive, solution focused attitude
- Ability to listen to clients and communicate effectively with them
- Quick technical grasp
- Excellent English and Fluent Hebrew
Location & Schedule:
- Most work will be done from our offices at 2 Hanofar St. Ra'ananna or at clients’ offices. Most Israeli clients are located between Ashkelon and Haifa. There will be remote work with clients in the USA, UK and worldwide.
Our standard work schedule is 9-5 on Sundays, 9-6 Mon-Thu
For the first 12 months you can expect to work 4 days a week at the office and one from home
Later around once a week on average you will be onsite with a client, two days a week working from home and 2 days a week at the office
What you will get:
- As much responsibility that you want and have proven yourself capable of handling
- Competitive Salary and benefits
- Mentoring on how to be a better Project Manager
To apply, can you send your Resume/CV to careers@priority-t.com? This is in addition to the LinkedIn application.
The Subject of the email should be “Candidate for Project Manager– [Your Name]”, i.e., Candidate for Project Manager – Moshe Cohen” if your name is Moshe Cohen. Start the email with a paragraph in English 3 sentences long starting with exactly these words: “I should be chosen for the position of Project Manager at PRT Technologies because of“ and explain why you are the right person for the role.

job.title: Ecommerce Manager
job.snippet:
Company Description
The Third Ear – האוזן השלישית – is Israel’s best-known distributor of music and film, operating since 1987. The company manages a diverse ecosystem that includes record stores, a bar and concert venue. It also runs Israel’s largest film rental platform for both private and public screenings. Team members are part of a creative environment that connects audiences with music, cinema, and live culture. The Third Ear offers opportunities to work at the intersection of entertainment, retail, and digital media.
We're looking for a
hands on E-commerce Manager
who combines strong technical expertise, commercial thinking, digital marketing skills, and a genuine passion for music and culture to lead and grow our online business.
What You'll Do
Lead the commercial and operational performance of our e-commerce websites and ERP systems
Plan digital marketing campaigns across Meta, Google, and other channels.
Analyze sales data, customer behavior, and KPIs to improve profitability and operational efficiency.
Perform website QA checks, troubleshoot issues, and coordinate technical improvements and automation
Daily website operations, including product listings, inventory updates, and catalog management.
Requirements
3+ years of proven Ecommerce management experience.
Strong technical skills, including hands-on experience with WordPress and WooCommerce.
Solid understanding of Meta Ads, Google Ads, campaign strategy, and performance analysis.
Strong analytical skills, including Excel, sales reporting, and data management.
Genuine passion for music, film, and culture.
This is a full-time job from our offices in central Tel Aviv.
Think you're the right fit? We'd love to hear from you!

job.title: Director of Operations
job.snippet:
About the Role
Pollogen, a Lumenis company, is seeking an experienced, results-driven Director of operations to lead its end-to-end supply chain operations. The role covers production of professional aesthetic medical devices across multiple manufacturing sites and skincare products manufactured at a third-party facility in Israel.
As a member of the Pollogen management team, you will lead a team and ensure efficient operations, reliable product availability, and on-time delivery in alignment with Pollogen's and Lumenis's business objectives.
Key Responsibilities:
Lead and manage all supply chain activities, including production planning, procurement, supplier management, inventory, and logistics.
Coordinate manufacturing activities across multiple sites and external production partners.
Ensure production plans, delivery commitments, and business objectives are consistently met.
Optimize inventory, costs, supplier performance, and operational efficiency.
Identify and resolve supply chain challenges, anticipate risks, and ensure business continuity.
Lead, develop, and motivate the supply chain team, fostering accountability and continuous improvement.
Collaborate with Sales, Finance, R&D, Quality, Operations, and Lumenis stakeholders to align supply chain execution with business needs.
Requirements:
8 to 10+ years of supply chain management experience, preferably in medical devices or another complex manufacturing environment.
Proven experience in production planning, procurement, inventory management, and supplier management.
Experience managing teams and coordinating multiple manufacturing sites or external production partners.
Strong leadership, strategic thinking, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
A hands-on, execution-oriented approach, with the ability to take ownership and deliver results under tight deadlines.
Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken.
Experience with ERP and supply chain planning systems.
Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Business, or a related field.
The Ideal Candidate:
A strong, proactive leader who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution. A team player with excellent managerial skills, strong ownership, and the ability to translate business objectives into action, overcome challenges, and consistently deliver production targets. The successful candidate will be an integral member of the Pollogen management team, supporting the growth and operational success of both Pollogen and Lumenis.

Deep knowledge of WordPress and WooCommerce plugin development.
Strong experience with Node.js and TypeScript.
Experience with WooCommerce HPOS, Checkout Blocks, Hooks, and Filters.
Experience with MySQL, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
Experience with REST APIs, webhooks, and asynchronous processing.
Understanding of authentication, OAuth 2.0, and application security.
Experience with Git, Docker, CI/CD, and automated testing.
Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
Good written and spoken English.
Advantages
Experience in FinTech, payment processing, or eCommerce.

Experience with Shopify, Magento, or other eCommerce platforms.
Experience with NestJS, Kafka, AWS, and Kubernetes.
Experience with React and JavaScript.
Experience with high-volume transaction systems, idempotency, and distributed architectures.
Experience with open-source plugin development and publishing.
Personal Skills
Ability to work independently and take full ownership of projects.
Strong architectural and analytical thinking.
Attention to security, performance, and code quality.
Ability to work in a fast-paced product development environment.
Join PayPlus and help us build the next generation of payment and commerce infrastructure.

job.title: Vacancy: Trainee Bus Drivers
job.snippet:
Careers
Vacancy: Trainee Bus Drivers
We’re looking for amazing, friendly, customer-focused people who can deliver an amazing service to our wonderful customers on our buses across Lanarkshire.
Key Responsibilities
Providing a cheerful, friendly face to our customers, ensuring that all of our customers are delivered amazing customer service.
Driving Company vehicles carefully and safely, complying with all legal and regulatory requirements and company procedures.
Advising customers of fares and taking payment via cash or contactless or checking valid tickets and passes, accounting for fares processed.
Being an amazing team player, ensuring that our services operate day in, day out come rain or shine.
Why Work for Us?
Established since 2009, we are a family owned business and have an excellent reputation in our local area. We can offer job security and ongoing training with opportunities for career progression. There are no costs for your training or uniform (provided that you remain with us for three years or more) and we pay you from day one so you earn while you learn.
What makes a great candidate for this role?
You must have great customer service skills and be a team player. You don’t need to have experience of driving buses or large vehicles, as we’ll provide training to help you get your licence. You must, however, hold a valid car driving licence. A good grasp of basic English and maths is essential as you’ll be dealing with our customers on a daily basis, and a good knowledge of the local Lanarkshire area would be helpful. You need to look smart and professional and be willing to work shifts. If you have these qualities, we can teach you the rest.
You will also need to be able to undergo a Disclosure Scotland check if we offer you a position – that’s a disclosure of any criminal convictions, cautions, etc.
What are the pay and benefits like?
Once you’re fully trained, pay will be between around £36k annually. This position is full time and permanent.
You will also get 28 days paid holiday per year (inclusive of statutory bank holidays), a company pension and free bus travel for you and your partner on our services.
If you would like to work for an ambitious, friendly, family owned company then email your CV and covering letter to mail@jmbtravel.co.uk OR call us on 01698 386030 and Choose Option 3

job.title: Service Technician, Petah Tikva
job.snippet:
What To Expect
At Tesla, our Service Technicians are the backbone of the Service operation, supporting our mission to
accelerate the world’s transition to sustainable energy.
We’ve created one of the most innovative vehicles ever made, and as a Service Technician you will help
ensure an equally innovative service to our customers.
To succeed at Tesla, you must be energetic, highly organized, and smart working. You should have a
passion for the brand and the ability to build on your technical skill set and thrive in a team
environment.
Are you up for the challenge?
We offer:
A dynamic & fast-paced environment where inclusion, learning & collaboration are key to
success
The chance to work with innovative technology, advanced tools and software
Ongoing training and development to help you grow your skills and career
A competitive compensation and benefits package
A safe, clean and fun workplace
What You'll Do
Service, repair and improve: Working with Tesla specific software and advanced tools you will be performing repairs and maintenance on all types of Tesla vehicles
Driven: Efficient in completing repairs and driven to exceed expectations on quality and productiviy
Become proficient to perform most complex repairs autonomously
Ensure top quality: Fix it right first time, we trust you to inspect our vehicles diligently before
return and pre-delivery
Collaborate: Working across teams, you will be sharing support and best practices in order to further improve the service experience
Develop: Setting you up for success our dedicated in-house training teams offer a blended learning strategy to help develop your technical skills. And by also sharing your own skills and knowledge with the team, you’re a part of driving the whole group forward
What You'll Bring
Technically experienced: You have extensive professional experience performing vehicle service and repairs working within either automotive, aviation, marine or similar industries
Technically qualified: You have relevant certification to perform vehicle repairs in Israel. You will self-manage your technical expertise development
A good communicator: You speak and write English and Hebrew well and know how to get your point across clearly and respectfully
Safe to drive: We require you to hold a driver’s license
Flexible: You may work in shifts to support your team, which may include weekends, morning and evening shifts
You are willing to travel when needed
, Tesla

Managing and accompanying projects and new products, including the creation of new item numbers.

Managing materials in terms of delays, postponements, and accelerations.

Ability to lead cross-organizational activities.
Extensive knowledge of Office applications, with an emphasis on Excel.
Experience working with the Priority system – an advantage.
High level of English.
Good interpersonal communication skills.
Ability to read technical drawings.

job.snippet:
Quality Inspector – Mechanical
Ziv-Av Technologies, a leading engineering company, is looking for a Quality Inspector to join our team in the mechanical engineering field.

Perform incoming inspections of parts received from suppliers.
Conduct quality inspections of mechanical parts and assemblies at supplier sites and in-house, and prepare inspection reports.
Perform quality inspections at suppliers’ subcontractors as required.
Conduct in-process inspections and prepare quality reports.
Perform Acceptance Test Procedures (ATP) at supplier sites according to documented test plans.
Handle nonconformities and manage the MRB inventory.
Work closely with customers’ quality inspectors.
Requirements:
Previous experience as a Quality Inspector.
Knowledge and experience in reading and interpreting mechanical drawings.
Experience using measuring instruments, including height gauges and calipers.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to work in a team.
High proficiency in Hebrew and English.
Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
Familiarity with Priority ERP – an advantage.
Familiarity with SolidWorks – an advantage.

job.title: PMO – AI Data Center
job.snippet:
Description: Join Enlight to shape the future of clean energy.
Enlight is a leading global renewable energy company, developing, building, owning and operating large-scale solar, wind and energy storage projects. As one of the fastest-growing renewable platforms, we combine entrepreneurial spirit with the scale, expertise and ambition to deliver projects that make a real impact on the global energy transition.
We’re now entering the AI data center market, and building a dedicated task force to develop, plan, design and construct mega-scale data centers.
﻿About the Role
We are seeking a PMO to join this dedicated data center task force. The PMO will serve as a central function within the task force, acting as a key integrator across all project workstreams and stakeholders.
In this role, the PMO will hold the full project view of mega-scale data center projects, from site development, zoning and permitting, through design and engineering, to construction, commissioning and handover. The PMO will oversee integrated project schedules and deliverables control, and drive reporting, data management and performance visibility across all workstreams.
The PMO will work closely with a large, multidisciplinary group, including designers, team leaders, project managers, engineering teams, consultants, contractors, suppliers and senior management, to ensure alignment, transparency, and informed decision-making, supporting the successful delivery of projects in accordance with contractual milestones and strategic objectives. | Responsibilities: Develop, maintain, and oversee detailed project schedules from early development, zoning and permitting through design, construction, commissioning, and handover to client and O&M
Monitor overall project and portfolio progress, identifying risks, delays, and mitigation strategies
Perform schedule analysis, critical path analysis, and progress tracking across projects
Lead deliverables control across all workstreams, tracking design packages, permit and zoning submissions, contractor and supplier submittals, review cycles and approvals against project milestones
Lead the preparation of management reports, dashboards, deliverables status, and performance insights
Maintain and enhance BI tools, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and timely updates
Provide structured updates and key insights to management to support decision-making
ordinate inputs across engineering, procurement, construction, and subcontractors to ensure alignment
Support change management and development of recovery plans when required
Capture, document, and implement lessons learned across projects to drive continuous improvement
Support the development, standardization, and enforcing of data center specific company and departmental procedures, tools, and best practices
Drive standardization of planning, reporting, and control processes within the department | Requirements: At least 7 years of overall experience, including 4 years in a PMO or Project Manager role, within infrastructure or similar industries (renewable energy – advantage)
Academic degree or professional certificate studies in Engineering, Construction Management, Industrial Engineering, or a related field, combined with solid hands-on experience
Strong knowledge with MS Project
Fluent English
Good understanding of construction methodologies and the full project lifecycle, including design, permitting and zoning
Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into insights
Ability to work both independently and within a multidisciplinary team
Excellent communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills
Experience with reporting tools and BI platforms (e.g., Power BI) – advantage
Experience with deliverables or document control systems (e.g., Aconex, Procore) – advantage
Experience with AI tools - advantage
Experience with data center projects – advantage

job.title: Analog Chip Designer
job.snippet:
Description: Power the Future with us!
SolarEdge (NASDAQ: SEDG), is a global leader in high-performance smart energy technology, with over 3000 employees, offices in 33 countries, and millions of products installed in over 133 countries.
Our diverse product offering comprises intelligent solar inverters, battery storage, backup systems, EV charging, and complete home energy management ecosystems.
By leveraging world-class engineering capabilities and with a relentless focus on innovation, we strive to create a world where clean, green energy from the sun is the primary source of power for our homes, businesses, and just about everywhere we thrive.
Joining the Analog ASIC group means more than designing components – it’s your chance to shape and influence the entire system through system-level innovation and end-to-end ownership, from specification to real-world implementation.
Our Analog ASIC group leads chip development at the core of SolarEdge products. We collaborate closely with system, software, and hardware teams to ensure complete optimization across the entire process.
We are seeking a passionate, Analog Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing and developing complex analog and mixed-signal ICs for SolarEdge’s cutting-edge products in the renewable energy sector.
What will you be doing:
Architecture planning using behavioral models for simulation of analog and mixed-signal circuits.
Design, implement and verify circuits & systems to meet product requirements including schematic entry, simulation, layout and supervision.
Verification of analog and mixed-signal sub-systems and the entire design using transistor-level.
Validation of design by laboratory measurement.
Support product engineering to meet manufacturing and production needs. | Requirements: B.Sc./M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering from a recognized university.
Professional experience in analog or mixed-signal design, simulation, and characterization of circuits such as operational amplifiers, comparators, reference circuits, ADC/DAC, PLL, etc.
It would be an advantage if you have:
Strong knowledge of MOS, Bipolar transistors, and high-voltage IC processes (e.g., BCD, SOI).
Experience with integrated power electronic circuits such as DC-DC converters, gate drivers, charge pumps, rectifiers, and LDOs.
Experience in full-chip integration, including interfaces with digital and hardware.
Familiarity with layout verification and extraction tools.

job.snippet:
Description: Global Enterprise Applications & Oracle Architect
Position Details
Reports to: VP, IT Applications
Managerial Position: No
Direct Reports: None
Position Type: Senior Individual Contributor, Hands-On
Location: India Primeco Towers - 5th Floor Bannerghatta Main Road, Arekere Gate / Panduranga Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560076.
Scope: Global
Position Overview
We are seeking an experienced Global Enterprise Applications Architect with strong business process expertise and deep hands-on knowledge of Oracle Fusion Cloud.
The Architect will design and implement scalable end-to-end solutions across global business processes, Oracle Fusion, and connected enterprise applications. The role combines cross-system architecture, hands-on implementation, AI-driven solution thinking, documentation, training, and knowledge transfer.
Key Responsibilities
Design global end-to-end business processes and application solutions across systems, functions, and regions.
Translate business requirements into scalable, maintainable, and integrated solutions.
Define the role of Oracle Fusion and connected applications within each business process.
Lead solution architecture from business requirements through implementation, go-live, and stabilization.
Drive global process standardization, simplification, and operational efficiency.
Apply Oracle Fusion Cloud capabilities and best practices while minimizing unnecessary customization.
Review and challenge designs proposed by internal teams, vendors, and implementation partners.
Remain hands-on in solution design, configuration review, testing, cutover, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis.
Identify where AI, automation, and AI agents can improve business processes, controls, productivity, and user experience.
Translate relevant AI opportunities into practical and measurable application solutions.
Stay current with Oracle Cloud releases, product roadmaps, AI capabilities, and emerging enterprise application solutions.
Define cross-system process flows, ownership, integrations, controls, exception handling, and data dependencies.
Document business processes, solution designs, integrations, controls, and architectural decisions.
Create reusable architecture standards, solution patterns, templates, and playbooks.
Develop training materials and deliver structured knowledge transfer to teams in Israel and India.
Mentor application professionals and strengthen internal knowledge and capabilities. | Requirements: Mandatory Requirements
10+ years of experience in enterprise applications, ERP solutions, or application architecture.
Previous experience with Oracle Consulting or an international consulting or implementation company .
Proven experience leading application and solution architecture for multiple global clients or companies.
Strong business understanding and proven ability to design end-to-end solutions across systems, functions, countries, and organizational units.
Deep practical expertise in Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications/Experience with multiple Oracle implementations.
Experience with Oracle Fusion implementation from design through go-live and stabilization.
Strong understanding of global business processes across Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Inventory, Manufacturing, Planning, Order Management, and Logistics, with deep functional expertise in a major business domain.
Proven ability to translate business requirements into scalable cross-system solutions.
Experience leading architecture and solution design discussions with business and technology stakeholders.
Hands-on experience with solution design, configuration, testing, cutover, and complex issue resolution.
Experience reviewing and validating solutions and configurations delivered by internal teams or implementation partners.
Ability to assess business processes and identify relevant opportunities for AI, automation, and AI agents.
Ability to evaluate new Oracle and AI capabilities based on business value, feasibility, risk, and operational impact.
Experience producing solution design documents, process documentation, and architectural decision records.
Experience delivering training, mentoring, and structured knowledge transfer.
Experience working with global teams and offshore delivery models.
Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud or equivalent enterprise integration solutions.
Excellent professional and business English.

job.title: Automation R&D Manager
job.location: Ho Chi Minh, Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam
job.snippet:
Description: Power the Future with us!
At SolarEdge (NASDAQ: SEDG), we're a global leader in smart energy technology, with over 3,000 employees, offices in 34 countries, and millions of installations worldwide.
Our innovative solutions include solar inverters, battery storage, backup systems, EV charging, and AI-based energy management. We're committed to making clean, green energy the primary power source for homes, businesses, and beyond.
With the growing demand for electricity, the need for smart, clean energy sources is constantly rising. SolarEdge offers amazing opportunities to develop your skills in a multidisciplinary environment, covering everything from research and development to production and customer supply. Work with talented colleagues, tackle exciting challenges, and help create a sustainable future in an industry that's always evolving and innovating. Join us and be part of a company that values creativity, agility, and impactful work.
We are establishing a new automation competency center in Vietnam, and we are looking for an experienced Automation R&D Manager to lead it.
This is a founding role. You will be our first hire on site: you will build the engineering team from the ground up, and then lead the design, build, and deployment of automated machines that support our mass production lines. You will manage a multidisciplinary team, own the delivery of multiple automation projects in parallel, and work day to day with our R&D and engineering teams at headquarters in Israel.
This is a hands-on leadership position for someone who has grown from the engineering floor into management, who is comfortable building something new, and who takes full ownership of outcomes.
Key Responsibilities:
Build the Vietnam automation team from the ground up — recruit, onboard and develop approximately 8 engineers and technicians during the first months of operation.
Establish team culture, ways of working, and engineering standards on site.
Manage local supplier and machine-builder relationships.
Work day to day with the R&D and engineering teams at headquarters in Israel. Technical architecture and design direction are set jointly with HQ; delivery and local execution are owned by you.
Lead a multidisciplinary team covering mechanical, electrical, control and software engineering, with procurement and assembly support.
Manage the full lifecycle of automated machine projects — from concept and design through build, commissioning, and hand-off to production.
Plan, prioritize, and deliver multiple automation projects simultaneously, balancing timelines, budgets, and resources.
Ensure automated machines meet the throughput, quality, reliability, and safety requirements of mass production lines.
Define technical specifications, review designs, and oversee integration of mechanical, electrical, control and software systems.
Collaborate closely with manufacturing, quality, R&D, and procurement teams.
Track project progress and report status, risks, and results to management.
Why This Role?
Build a new engineering center from the ground up, with the backing of an established global company.
Direct ownership of the site's technical capability, team, and standards.
Work on automation for high-volume production of products sold worldwide. | Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Control/Automation Engineering, or a related field.
Over 5 years of experience managing a team that designs and builds automated machines for mass production lines.
Solid understanding of automated machine design, control systems, and production-line integration.
Proven ability to manage multiple projects at once and deliver on schedule.
Fluent English, written and spoken — daily collaboration with headquarters in Israel.
Strong problem-solving skills and a structured, results-oriented approach
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience building or scaling an engineering team, including recruiting and onboarding engineers.
Experience working with, or reporting to, an overseas parent company or customer.
Prior hands-on experience working directly on automated machines (design, build, or commissioning) before moving into a management role.
Experience in a high-volume manufacturing environment.
Familiarity with PLCs, robotics, vision systems, and/or motion control.
What We're Looking For
Takes ownership and full responsibility for team results and project outcomes.
Comfortable and effective managing several projects in parallel under competing priorities.
Strong leadership presence, with the ability to build, guide and grow an engineering team.
Self-starting and independent — able to make progress and make decisions without close day-to-day supervision.
Proactive, dependable, and solution-focused.

Read and deeply understand the complex embedded systems written in C.
Opportunity to grow into Embedded software development over time.

job.title: Embedded Automation Engineer
job.snippet:
Description: About the role
We are looking for a Senior Automation Engineer to design, build and maintain test automation for embedded products. You will write Python frameworks and C test code that run against real hardware, simulators and production firmware. You will work closely with firmware, hardware and system teams to catch defects early and make every release faster and safer.
This is a senior, hands-on role. You will own the automation architecture, lead technical decisions and mentor other engineers, and you should be comfortable debugging at the boundary between software and hardware.
Responsibilities
Own the architecture and long-term roadmap of the test automation framework and infrastructure for embedded products.
Design, develop and maintain automated test frameworks in Python, setting coding standards and best practices for the team.
Write and maintain test code, test hooks and tools in C for firmware running on microcontrollers and DSPs.
Lead the design of hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) and system-level test setups, including control of lab equipment (power supplies, electronic loads, oscilloscopes, DAQs).
Automate testing over communication interfaces such as UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, Modbus and Ethernet.
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitLab CI, Jenkins) and keep them fast and reliable.
Define test strategy, test plans and coverage together with firmware, hardware and system engineers.
Lead root-cause investigations of complex failures across firmware, hardware and system level.
Mentor and guide junior and mid-level engineers, and lead code and design reviews.
Evaluate new tools and technologies and drive improvements in test efficiency, stability and coverage. | Requirements: Requirements
B.Sc. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or a related field.
At least 5 years of hands-on experience developing in Python, including designing test frameworks or automation tools from scratch (e.g. pytest).
At least 5 years of hands-on experience developing in C.
Proven experience leading test automation for software that runs on hardware, from architecture to deployment.
Strong background in software design, object-oriented design and clean, maintainable code.
Deep understanding of software testing methods: unit, integration, system and regression testing.
Experience with Git and CI/CD tools, including setting up and maintaining pipelines.
Comfortable working in Linux environments and with scripting.
Ability to read schematics and datasheets and use lab equipment for debugging.
Experience mentoring engineers or leading technical work in a team.
Good English, written and spoken.
Advantages
Experience with embedded systems, preferably from power electronics, automotive, robotics or similar industries.
Experience with hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing, simulators or test benches (e.g. dSPACE, NI, Typhoon HIL, Speedgoat).
Familiarity with real-time operating systems (RTOS) and bare-metal firmware.
Knowledge of communication protocols such as CAN, Modbus, SPI, I2C, UART and Ethernet.
Background in power electronics: inverters, converters, motor drives or battery systems.
Experience with automotive or safety standards (ISO 26262, IEC 61508, ASPICE) or functional safety testing.
Experience automating lab instruments with SCPI, VISA or PyVISA.
Experience with C++, Docker or cloud-based test infrastructure.
What we offer
Work on products used at large scale in the field.
A hands-on role with access to real hardware and well-equipped labs.
Collaboration with experienced firmware, hardware and system engineers.
Room to shape the automation strategy and tools.

job.title: Embedded Engineer
job.snippet:
Description: SolarEdge is a global leader in smart energy solutions, manufacturing a wide range of products including intelligent inverters, storage systems, and innovative EV chargers. We are transforming the way electricity is produced and consumed worldwide.
Our team develops products from the application level down to the lowest level, including drivers and beyond, utilizing a variety of technologies. We are looking for a highly self-motivated programmer who is independent and thinks outside the box. You will have the opportunity to be involved in all stages of architecture and design planning, development and testing, and integration within SolarEdge hardware products, cloud infrastructures, and field deployment.
What you will be doing:
You will develop high-quality code solutions for energy management devices and systems.
You will design, develop and verify embedded SW, both in low level and system level.
You will work with adjacent teams such as hardware, integration, support and ATE | Requirements: Requirements:
B.Sc in electrical engineering, computer science or equivalent.
3-6 years of hands-on embedded software development experience.
Expertise in C programming - must.
Experience in RTOS and/or IoT operating systems – must.
Experience with ADC, I2C, SPI, UART, RS-485 , RS-232, canBus – must.
Experience with ARM SoC or similar – advantage.
Experience Lwip IP stack, FreeRTOS – advantage.
Experience with low level and drivers development – advantage.
Other programming language (C++, C#, Python) - advantage.
Experience with communication protocols Wi-Fi, openThread, internet and Modbus – advantage.
Experience with RF or RF protocols (2.4G, subGig, 6lowpan, ieee802.14.5.) – advantage.
Additional skills:
Self and fast learning abilities.
Ability to work independently.
Problem solving skills and out-of-the-box thinking.
Strong analytical skills.
Great interpersonal skills
Fluent in both written and spoken English

job.title: Embedded Infrastructure Engineer
job.snippet:
Description: Power the Future with us!
SolarEdge (NASDAQ: SEDG), is a global leader in high-performance smart energy technology, with over 3000 employees, offices in 33 countries, and millions of products installed in over 133 countries.
Our diverse product offering comprises intelligent solar inverters, battery storage, backup systems, EV charging, and complete home energy management ecosystems.
By leveraging world-class engineering capabilities and with a relentless focus on innovation, we strive to create a world where clean, green energy from the sun is the primary source of power for our homes, businesses, and just about everywhere we thrive.
The Embedded Infrastructure Team builds and maintains the shared embedded software foundations used across the department. We develop reusable code and core technologies that enable multiple projects and teams to succeed, while spearheading the adoption of new technologies within the organization. By providing a robust, scalable base, we empower product teams to move faster with confidence.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and maintain embedded software for a cross-platform SDK at the core of SolarEdge embedded products.
Develop bootloaders, drivers, bare-metal, and RTOS-based firmware for ARM & ARC processors.
Collaborate across software, hardware, and architecture teams to develop and integrate features, from design through implementation and system-level validation.
Participate in design reviews/code reviews and develop high-quality code following best practices, including unit tests and automated system tests.
Define and improve development environments and build flows that enable efficiency and flexibility across all teams.
Navigate a hardware-oriented environment encompassing chip bring-up, physical device integration, complex troubleshooting, and software-hardware validation.
Apply AI-driven tools and methodologies to accelerate development and enhance code quality. | Requirements: Basic Qualifications :
B.Sc. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
At least 2 years of experience in real-time embedded systems firmware development using C/C++.
Hands-on experience in development and troubleshooting on embedded micro-controllers and processors.
Experience with firmware debugging tools such as JTAG and logic analyzers.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Experience with embedded peripheries drivers (UART, SPI, I2C, ADC, PWM, Timers, DMA).
Excellent teamwork skills, flexibility, and ability to handle multiple tasks.
Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies and domains.
Familiarity with multi-threaded and/or RTOS-based systems.
Preferred Qualification :
Experience with AI-driven development tools and workflows
Hands-on experience with communication protocols such as CAN-FD, Ethernet, or TCP/IP.
Experience developing tools and scripts for automation using Python or other scripting languages.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Gitlab CI, Github Actions, Jenkins, etc) and automation workflows.
Familiarity with command-line build systems such as CMake, Bazel, Meson, etc.
SolarEdge recognizes its talented and diverse workforce as a key competitive advantage. Our business success is a reflection of the quality and skill of our people.
SolarEdge is committed to seeking out and retaining the finest human talent to ensure top business growth and performance.

Description: Help shape how AI data centers are powered.
At SolarEdge (NASDAQ: SEDG), we're a global leader in smart energy technology, with over 3,000 employees, offices in more than 20 countries, and millions of installations worldwide. Solaredge is expanding its innovation into the fast-growing world of AI data-center power infrastructure. Building on our leadership in solar, storage, and power electronics, we are creating a next-generation Power Ecosystem — integrating Solid-State Transformers (SST), Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS as UPS), and advanced power-conversion platforms designed for the AI era.
Join our UPS Data Centers group and play a key role in developing SolarEdge's next generation of high-performance power conversion and backup power solutions for data centers. As a Senior Hardware Design Engineer, you will take ownership of hardware development throughout the entire product lifecycle—from concept and design through validation and mass production—working on complex, multidisciplinary systems in a fast-paced environment.
We are looking for an experienced Embedded Software Developer to lead the design, development, and integration of embedded firmware solutions for complex HW/SW systems. The role involves developing production-grade software, driving technical decisions, supporting product bring-up, and working closely with hardware, validation, automation, and system engineering teams.

Design, develop, and maintain embedded firmware in C/C++ for real-time systems.

Experience with Git-based development workflows.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

Experience with power electronics or energy products.
Experience with Zephyr RTOS.
Experience with Embedded Linux application development
Experience in functional safety or secure boot implementations.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines.
Python scripting and automation experience.
Experience working with Linux-based development environments.
Knowledge of OTA/FOTA update mechanisms.

job.title: Failure Analysis Engineer
job.snippet:
Description: Are you ready to power the future?
At SolarEdge (NASDAQ: SEDG), we're a global leader in smart energy technology, with over 4,000 employees, offices in 34 countries, and millions of installations worldwide.
Our innovative solutions include solar inverters, battery storage, backup systems, EV charging, and AI-based energy management. We're committed to making clean, green energy the primary power source for homes, businesses, and beyond.
With the growing demand for electricity, the need for smart, clean energy sources is constantly rising. SolarEdge offers amazing opportunities to develop your skills in a multidisciplinary environment, covering everything from research and development to production and customer supply. Work with talented colleagues, tackle exciting challenges, and help create a sustainable future in an industry that's always evolving and innovating. Join us and be part of a company that values creativity, agility, and impactful work.
Join a fast-moving engineering team where your curiosity, grit, and hands-on problem-solving skills will directly improve the reliability of power electronics in the field. We are looking for a Failure Analysis Engineer who loves digging into tough hardware problems, building creative test setups, and turning complex failures into clear technical answers.
This is not a sit-back-and-follow-the-checklist role. You will own investigations end to end, move quickly from evidence to insight, and work closely with engineering teams to help make products stronger, safer, and more reliable. If you are energized by mystery-solving, high-voltage hardware, and the chance to make a visible impact, this role is built for you.
Location : Milpitas, CA
Duties and Responsibilities:
Take ownership of failure investigations on power electronic hardware, including field returns, prototype failures, and in-lab anomalies.
Create smart, practical investigation plans tailored to each failure mode, deciding what to test, measure, inspect, and validate.
Investigate and characterize failures across power conversion topologies including DC-DC converters, isolated buck converters, dual active bridge (DAB), inverters, and related power electronic circuits.
Build, modify, and troubleshoot custom test setups from the ground up, including wiring, soldering, crimping, instrumentation, and fixture configuration.
Operate and interpret results from lab equipment: oscilloscopes, power analyzers, curve tracers, function generators, thermal cameras, and high-voltage power supplies.
Conduct materials-level analysis including cross-sectioning, metallographic inspection, and examination of thermal and mechanical damage.
Work safely and confidently on systems up to 690V while following rigorous electrical safety practices, including LOTO, arc flash awareness, and energized-equipment protocols.
Support investigations in varied physical environments, including equipment rooms and elevated platforms, with the ability to lift and maneuver heavy equipment as needed.
Translate findings into crisp, actionable reports that help design, reliability, and engineering teams move faster and make better decisions. | Requirements: Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent hands-on experience, vocational training, or self-taught expertise in electronics will also be strongly considered.
Relentless curiosity and the drive to chase root cause until the technical story is clear, complete, and defensible.
Solid working knowledge of power electronics, including switching behavior, magnetics, gate drive circuits, thermal management, and common power conversion topologies.
Hands-on experience debugging, testing, and validating real hardware in the lab, not just analyzing circuits on paper or in simulation.
Confidence building and adapting test setups independently, including soldering THT and SMD components, crimping terminals, routing wiring, and selecting the right equipment for the job.
Strong safety background and demonstrated experience working confidently on low-voltage systems up to 690V — including LOTO, arc flash awareness, and safe practices around energized equipment.
Comfort working at heights and in physically demanding environments, including the ability to lift and maneuver heavy equipment.
Familiarity with materials or metallurgical analysis, such as cross-sectioning, failure-surface inspection, SEM, or similar methods, is a strong plus.
Strong mechanical intuition, whether developed through formal training, machining, mechanical design, fabrication, motorsports, model building, or other hands-on technical work.
A self-starter mindset with the ability to prioritize, make sound technical calls, and keep momentum without waiting for step-by-step direction.
FAIR PAY & A JUST WORKPLACE
At SolarEdge, we are committed to fair, transparent pay, and we strive to provide competitive, market-informed compensation. The pay range for this position in California at the start of employment is expected to be between $80K- $110K. It is anticipated that most qualified candidates will fall near the middle of this range. However, base pay offered is based on market location and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations.
Even more importantly, please note that salary is only one component of total compensation at SolarEdge. Subject to those same considerations, the total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a bonus and/or equity awards, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits. Our highly competitive benefits package is designed to support your success at work, at home, and at play. Your recruiter will be happy to discuss all that SolarEdge has to offer!
SolarEdge proudly seeks to build a richly diverse workforce by hiring people with a diversity of thoughts, identities, perspectives, and experiences that help advance the difference we make for consumers, and by ensuring our people experience equity and inclusion in their work lives. We encourage members of traditionally underrepresented communities to apply, including women, LGBTQIA people, people of color, and people with disabilities.

job.title: Field Analysis Engineer
job.snippet:
Description: About the Role
SolarEdge is expanding its India-based engineering team to accelerate Failure Analysis and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for our RSS2.5 Residential Storage System — our home battery product currently in mass production. As a Failure Analysis Engineer, you will investigate field-returned units, trace issues from real-world data down to root cause, and work cross-functionally to drive corrective actions that improve product quality and reliability. This is a foundational role in building a dedicated India center of excellence for Failure Analysis, working closely with hardware, firmware, and system teams in Israel.
What You’ll Be Doing
Investigate and analyze field-returned RSS2.5 residential storage battery units to identify suspected root causes of reported failures.
• Review and analyze field logs and telemetry data to detect failure patterns and narrow down suspected root causes.
• Design and execute in-depth lab investigations — spanning electrical, hardware, and system/software level testing — to confirm or refute suspected root causes.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with hardware, firmware, and system engineering teams to resolve findings and define corrective actions.
• Apply AI-assisted tools to accelerate log analysis, pattern detection, and root cause investigation.
• Document investigation findings, root cause reports, and recommendations to drive continuous product quality improvement.
• Contribute to the development and improvement of failure analysis methodologies, tools, and lab processes. | Requirements: Requirements
• B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field.
• 3–6 years of experience in failure analysis, hardware/system debugging, or root cause analysis — ideally in battery, energy storage, or power electronics products.
• Ability to work across hardware, software, and system-level investigations — not limited to a single domain.
• Comfortable analyzing field logs and telemetry data and correlating findings with hands-on lab testing.
• Hands-on lab and debugging skills (e.g., electrical measurement and testing equipment).
• Comfortable using AI-assisted tools to support log analysis, pattern detection, and investigation workflows.
• Strong written and verbal English — required for close collaboration with global R&D teams and clear technical reporting.
Advantageous Qualifications
• Direct experience with Battery Management Systems (BMS) or residential/commercial energy storage systems.
• Scripting experience (e.g., Python) for log analysis and data correlation.

job.title: Hardware Team Leader – Mixed-Signal Design
job.snippet:
Description: Power the Future with us!
At SolarEdge (NASDAQ: SEDG), we're a global leader in smart energy technology, with over 3,000 employees, offices in 34 countries, and millions of installations worldwide.
Our innovative solutions include solar inverters, battery storage, backup systems, EV charging, and AI-based energy management. We're committed to making clean, green energy the primary power source for homes, businesses, and beyond.
With the growing demand for electricity, the need for smart, clean energy sources is constantly rising. SolarEdge offers amazing opportunities to develop your skills in a multidisciplinary environment, covering everything from research and development to production and customer supply. Work with talented colleagues, tackle exciting challenges, and help create a sustainable future in an industry that's always evolving and innovating. Join us and be part of a company that values creativity, agility, and impactful work.
We are seeking a sharp, experienced Hardware Team Leader to lead the design of the digital and mixed-signal boards at the heart of SolarEdge's advanced energy storage products. This is a hands-on technical leadership role for an engineer with deep, real-world experience in the disciplines that make or break a mixed-signal design - grounding, EMI, robust communication, and accurate measurement - and, just as importantly, in how these are verified at the board and full-system level.
What will you be doing:
Leading the HW design of the digital and mixed-signal boards and products, from concept through mass production
Owning the design of accurate measurements, robust communication, grounding, and power distribution - across the boards and at the system level
Defining how these are verified and characterized, both on the bench and within the complete system
Managing and growing the team - owning the team's tasks, design reviews, and timelines
Leading several development projects in parallel, across all project stages up to mass production
Working in a multidisciplinary environment and collaborating across departments and sites | Requirements: B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering
7+ years of hands-on mixed-signal HW design, taken to mass production
2+ years of proven technical leadership and mentoring experience, ideally across distributed teams
Deep expertise in precise analog measurement - accuracy budgeting, error sources, calibration - and in verifying accuracy at board and system level
Strong command of grounding, return-path, and power-distribution design
EMI/EMC design-for-compliance experience - designed in up front, not fixed late
Working experience with communication protocols, such as CAN, SPI, I2C, UART, differential
Experience designing protection circuits (overvoltage, overcurrent, short circuit)
Knowledge of power electronics and DC-DC converters (Buck, Boost, Flyback, Forward)
Proficiency in simulation tools such as LTspice, PSpice, or PSIM
Strong problem-solving, debugging, and lab bring-up skills, with a systematic verification mindset
Strong documentation skills - design reviews and product lifecycle management
Strong command of AI tools and a demonstrated ability to leverage them to accelerate engineering work — analysis, documentation, scripting, and debugging
Advantageous Qualifications:
Experience with Battery Management Systems (BMS) or energy storage technologies (Li-Ion, Solid State, etc.)
Familiarity with functional safety concepts and safety standards for battery and energy storage systems
Understanding of thermal management in electronic designs
Familiarity with regulatory compliance in electronics (CE, UL, etc.)
﻿SolarEdge recognizes its talented and diverse workforce as a key competitive advantage. Our business success is a reflection of the quality and skill of our people.
SolarEdge is committed to seeking out and retaining the finest human talent to ensure top business growth and performance.

job.title: Layout Design Team Leader
job.snippet:
Description: SolarEdge (NASDAQ: SEDG) is a global leader in high-performance smart energy technology, with over 3,000 employees, offices in 34 countries, and millions of products installed in over 133 countries. Our diverse product offering comprises intelligent solar inverters, battery storage, backup systems, EV charging, and complete home energy management ecosystems. By leveraging world-class engineering capabilities and maintaining a relentless focus on innovation, we strive to create a world where clean, green energy from the sun is the primary source of power for our homes, businesses, and beyond.
We are looking for an experienced Layout Design Team Leader to lead a team of PCB Layout Designers within the SolarEdge Hardware division. The team is responsible for the PCB layout of our core hardware products, including high-voltage power boards, optimizers, communication circuits, and complex battery management systems (BMS).
This is a hands-on leadership role combining people management, technical ownership, and active involvement in complex PCB layout projects. You will develop the team’s capabilities, drive design quality, and manage priorities across multiple projects, working closely with Hardware, Quality & Reliability (Q&R), Mechanical, and Manufacturing teams to deliver robust, production-ready designs.
What you will do:
Lead, mentor, and develop a team of PCB Layout Designers, providing technical guidance, ongoing feedback, and support for professional growth.
Own the team’s work plan, resource allocation, priorities, and delivery schedules across multiple concurrent projects.
Lead PCB layout activities from concept through production release, ensuring design quality, compliance with requirements, and timely execution.
Take a hands-on role in designing complex multi-layer PCBs, including placement, routing, verification, and preparation of final manufacturing outputs.
Guide the translation of schematics into optimized layouts, addressing Signal Integrity (SI), Power Integrity (PI), EMI/EMC, high-voltage spacing, thermal performance, and manufacturability requirements.
Conduct layout reviews, resolve technical challenges, and support the team in making design trade-offs.
Drive effective use of Cadence Allegro, OrCAD Capture, Allegro Constraint Manager, and collaborative layout tools such as Symphony.
Coordinate closely with Hardware, Mechanical, Q&R, and Manufacturing engineers to align requirements, resolve constraints, and support the transition to production.
Own and continuously improve the team’s design guidelines, layout methodologies, review processes, and internal layout “Cookbook.”
Oversee tape-out and manufacturing release activities, ensuring complete, accurate, and controlled documentation packages.
Support recruitment and onboarding of new team members. | Requirements: At least 5 years of hands-on experience in complex, multi-layer PCB layout design.
Previous experience leading a PCB layout team or providing technical leadership, mentoring, and coordination across multiple layout projects.
High proficiency in Cadence Allegro / OrCAD PCB Designer, with strong knowledge of OrCAD Capture.
Deep experience with constraint-driven layout design and Allegro Constraint Manager.
Proven experience with high-voltage design, heavy copper routing, grounding strategies, and electrical clearance and creepage requirements.
Strong understanding of Signal Integrity (SI), Power Integrity (PI), high-speed routing, and mixed-signal digital/analog design considerations.
In-depth knowledge of DFM/DFA/DFT requirements, including ICT/ATE test point placement, thermal reliefs, and manufacturing constraints associated with wave, laser, and robotic soldering.
Experience with tape-out procedures, ODB++/Gerber generation, and preparation and review of complete manufacturing packages.
Experience collaborating with Mechanical engineers using 3D IDF/IDX interfaces.
Ability to prioritize workloads, allocate resources, and drive multiple projects to completion under tight schedules.
Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to develop people and drive effective cross-functional collaboration.
A proactive, accountable approach, with strong problem-solving skills and a commitment to continuous improvement.

Minimum 6 years of proven experience in mechanical design and development.
Demonstrated experience in designing for manufacturability (DFM) with a strong understanding of mass production processes.
Preferred: Experience in designing components for plastic injection molding, die casting, extrusion, and metal forming.
Preferred: Experience in the mechanical integration of PCBs within electronic enclosures.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to perform engineering calculations and simulations.
Proficiency in CAD software (specify preferred software, e.g., SolidWorks, Creo, etc.).
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

The Mechanical/Industrial Engineer is a hands-on manufacturing engineering leader responsible for designing, optimizing, and sustaining production systems to improve capacity, labor efficiency, quality, cost, and equipment utilization. The role analyzes operations, develops mechanical tooling and production solutions, resolves manufacturing defects, and leads continuous improvement projects in partnership with Production, Quality, Maintenance, Automation, Test, Product/Process Engineering, R&D, and Supply Chain teams.
The engineer supports safe, stable, repeatable, and scalable manufacturing across equipment, tooling, layouts, material flow, labor methods, and product transitions.
Location : Austin, TX.
Duties and Responsibilities:
Production and process optimization: Analyze manufacturing workflows, equipment, labor utilization, cycle time, line balancing, and constraints. Identify bottlenecks and implement improvements that increase throughput, efficiency, and manufacturing stability.
Capacity and workforce efficiency: Perform capacity analysis, establish production standards, and recommend staffing, workstation, line, and cell configurations that maximize headcount efficiency while supporting quality and cost requirements.
Mechanical tooling and fixture development: Design, develop, qualify, and improve jigs, fixtures, tools, workstations, and mechanical production aids for top-level assembly (TLA) and related manufacturing processes. Maintain accurate tooling documentation in Agile or the applicable product lifecycle management system.
Defect resolution and corrective action: Lead root-cause investigations and corrective actions for TLA and production defects. Use structured problem-solving, data analysis, and cross-functional follow-through to prevent recurrence.
Layout and material flow: Develop and maintain efficient production layouts, material movement, storage, and point-of-use presentation. Recommend layout updates that improve flow, ergonomics, safety, and capacity.
Continuous improvement: Lead Lean, Six Sigma, and other structured improvement initiatives to reduce waste, variation, downtime, rework, and operating cost while improving yield, productivity, and equipment utilization.
Quality and compliance: Support defect prevention, statistical process control, process capability, control plans, risk assessments, work instructions, and root-cause analysis. Ensure changes are documented and implemented through applicable engineering change and deviation processes.
Cost reduction: Evaluate manufacturing costs and identify opportunities for labor, material, tooling, equipment, floor-space, and resource savings without compromising product quality or production readiness.
Project and change leadership: Lead cross-functional projects involving equipment upgrades, tooling deployment, process changes, automation opportunities, new technologies, and new product introduction or mass-production readiness.
Documentation and performance reporting: Create and maintain manufacturing documentation, engineering specifications, layouts, standards, and project records. Track and present relevant KPIs, project status, risks, results, and recommended next actions to management.
Technical leadership: Provide technical guidance, mentor less-experienced team members, coordinate vendor or contractor support when needed, and promote disciplined engineering practices across manufacturing operations.

Increase manufacturing capacity and equipment utilization through data-based process, tooling, layout, and workflow improvements.

Demonstrated experience with manufacturing process optimization, capacity analysis, line balancing, work measurement, material flow, and production layout.
Hands-on experience designing, developing, qualifying, or improving mechanical tooling, fixtures, jigs, and production workstations.
Proficiency with Lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, structured problem-solving, root-cause analysis, and corrective action methods.
Ability to collect, analyze, and interpret production data and translate findings into practical engineering solutions.
Strong project management, technical documentation, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
3D modelling for tooling and additive manufacturing experience

Experience with electronics assembly equipment, automation, test interfaces, and production equipment qualification.
Experience using CAD (2D and 3D) tools for mechanical design and production layout development. Familiarity with product lifecycle management systems such as Agile and with engineering change, deviation, and document-control workflows.

The Mechanical/Industrial Engineer is a hands-on manufacturing engineering leader responsible for designing, optimizing, and sustaining production systems to improve capacity, labor efficiency, quality, cost, and equipment utilization.
