job.title: Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI) Developer
job.snippet:
Description: Role Summary
We are looking for a Senior Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI) Developer to design, build and maintain analytics content on the Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence platform (formerly Fusion Analytics Warehouse). The role focuses on delivering actionable reporting and dashboards for Finance/ERP and Supply Chain (SCM) stakeholders.
The successful candidate will extend Oracle's prebuilt ERP and SCM analytics with custom subject areas, KPIs and data augmentations, integrate external data sources, and ensure data quality, performance and security across the platform. This is a hands-on senior position that also involves mentoring, stakeholder engagement and technical ownership of the FDI environment.
Key Responsibilities
• Design and build custom dashboards, workbooks, KPIs and analytic cards on Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI/FAW) for ERP and SCM domains.
• Extend Oracle's prebuilt ERP Analytics and SCM Analytics content — build custom subject areas and semantic model extensions to meet business needs.
• Model and enrich data using Data Augmentation and Custom Data Configurations, sourcing from Oracle Fusion Cloud applications and external systems.
• Configure and maintain data pipelines (functional and external), monitor refresh schedules, and troubleshoot data load and reconciliation issues.
• Implement role-based and data-level (row-level) security, security assignments and content access in line with governance requirements.
• Optimize dashboards and semantic models for performance, and ensure data accuracy across Financials (GL, AP, AR, FA, Costing) and SCM (Inventory, Procurement, Order Management, Manufacturing).
• Produce technical documentation, promote content across environments, and support release and change-management processes. | Requirements: Required Qualifications
Proficiency with the Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI) tool itself is the core competency for this role and is mandatory. The items below establish the required senior baseline; candidates without proven, hands-on delivery experience will not be considered.
Demonstrated proficiency with Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI) as a core competency — the candidate must be able to build and extend analytics content directly on the FDI platform (custom subject areas, KPIs, cards, dashboards, Data Augmentation and semantic model extensions).
Substantial hands-on experience in BI / data warehouse / analytics development at a senior level. This is a senior position; extensive, demonstrable delivery experience is essential and applicants without it will not be considered.
Advanced SQL and PL/SQL; solid data modeling and dimensional (star-schema) design skills.
Understanding of data-level and role-based security models within Fusion analytics.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting and requirements-gathering ability with Finance and SCM stakeholders.
Advantageous Skills and Experience
The following are not mandatory, but are considered strong advantages. Together they enable the developer to deliver comprehensive FDI analytics solutions that leverage both foundational and contemporary Oracle analytics technologies:
Hands-on experience with the Supply Chain Management (SCM) and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) modules within FDI — a major advantage and highly relevant to this role.
Knowledge of Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence (OTBI) integration — a significant advantage, given OTBI's role in providing real-time data into FDI.
Understanding of the Fusion ERP and SCM database schemas and their underlying table structures — a substantial advantage that allows the developer to work effectively with the data.
Prior experience with Oracle Business Intelligence Enterprise Edition (OBIEE), the on-premise Oracle analytics platform — a major advantage that provides valuable foundational business-intelligence expertise.
Understanding of Business Intelligence Cloud Connector (BICC) extracts and the associated ETL processes for extracting and loading data from Fusion Cloud Applications — an important advantage for data-pipeline implementation.
Additional Preferred Qualifications
Oracle certifications in FDI / Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC) or Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW).
Experience with Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW) and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
Scripting experience (e.g. Python) and familiarity with Git/version control and CI/CD for analytics content.
Prior experience in a manufacturing, supply-chain or technology organization.
Technical Skills Snapshot
Platforms & Tools: Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI/FAW), Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC), Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW), Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
Data & Development: SQL, PL/SQL, dimensional data modeling, semantic modeling, Data Augmentation, custom subject areas, data pipelines.
Domain: Oracle Fusion ERP/Financials (GL, AP, AR, FA, Costing) and SCM (Inventory, Procurement, Order Management, Manufacturing).
Reporting & Integration: OTBI (real-time reporting into FDI), OBIEE (on-premise foundation), BICC extracts and ETL processes.

job.title: Power Electronics Engineer - Battery Systems
job.snippet:
Description: About the Role
We are seeking a motivated Hardware Engineer to join our team designing the Power electronics and signal conditioning circuits at the heart of SolarEdge’s advanced energy storage products. This is a hands-on design role for an engineer with deep, real-world experience in the disciplines of converter design, signal conditioning circuits, grounding, EMI, robust communication, accurate sensing and measurement — and in how these are verified at the board and full-system level.
What You’ll Be Doing
Designing Embedded Electronics Hardware for Battery Management Systems under the guidance of Senior engineers, from concept through mass production for Battery energy storage products.
Designing Power electronics converter circuits for Battery Energy storage products.
Designing accurate measurements, robust communication, grounding, and power distribution — at both board and system level.
Supporting verification and characterization of designs, on the bench and within the complete system.
Participating in design reviews and growing your technical craft.
Working in a multidisciplinary environment and collaborating across departments and sites. | Requirements: B.Tech. in Electrical, Electronics Or related Engineering Streams. Masters/PhD is Preferred.
3+ years of hands-on Power electronics HW design and Signal conditioning circuits, taken to mass production.
Solid foundation in analog measurement and understanding of accuracy, error sources, calibration.
Understanding of designing protection circuits (overvoltage, overcurrent, short circuit).
Basic Knowledge of power electronics and DC-DC converters (Buck, Boost, Flyback, Forward).
Familiarity in simulation tools such as LTspice, PSpice, or PSIM.
Strong problem-solving, debugging, and lab bring-up skills, with a systematic verification mindset.
Basic understanding of grounding, return-path, and power-distribution design.
Familiarity with communication links (CAN, SPI, I2C, UART, differential).
Strong command of AI tools and a demonstrated ability to leverage them to accelerate engineering work — analysis, documentation, scripting, and debugging.
Good documentation Habits.
Advantageous Qualifications
Experience with Battery Management Systems (BMS) or energy storage technologies (Li-Ion, Solid State, etc.).
Understanding of thermal management in electronic designs.
Familiarity with regulatory compliance in electronics (CE, UL, etc.).

job.title: Process Engineer
job.snippet:
Description: Power the Future with us!
SolarEdge (NASDAQ: SEDG), is a global leader in high-performance smart energy technology, with over 5000 employees, offices in 34 countries, and millions of products installed in over 133 countries.
Our diverse product offering comprises intelligent solar inverters, battery storage, backup systems, EV charging, and complete home energy management ecosystems.
By leveraging world-class engineering capabilities and with a relentless focus on innovation, we strive to create a world where clean, green energy from the sun is the primary source of power for our homes, businesses, and just about everywhere we thrive.
We are currently seeking an experienced Process Engineer to join our manufacturing team in Austin. This role provides senior-level technical leadership for front-end (FE) production processes, with responsibility for process stability, equipment utilization, quality, cost, and readiness for high-volume manufacturing. The Process Engineer will lead complex problem-solving, equipment and product qualification, continuous improvement, and new product introduction initiatives in a production environment involving PCB fabrication and printed circuit board assembly (PCBA).
Location : Austin, TX
Duties and Responsibilities:
Production Process Leadership: Own, develop, document, and continuously improve PCB fabrication and PCBA production processes, including SMT, solder paste printing, component placement, reflow, wave/selective soldering, cleaning, inspection, and test-related process controls.
FE Production Performance: Ensure front-end production output and maximum equipment utilization are achieved at expected quality and cost by monitoring throughput, cycle time, downtime, capacity, yield, scrap, and rework performance.
Root Cause and Corrective Action: Lead structured root cause investigations and corrective actions for FE defects and complex PCBA issues, including solder defects, placement errors, opens, shorts, tombstoning, bridging, contamination, insufficient wetting, and delamination.
Equipment and Product Qualification: Plan and execute equipment, process, material, tooling, and product qualifications; establish acceptance criteria, validate capability, document results, and support release to production.
NPI and Mass Production Readiness: Lead manufacturing readiness for new product introduction and production ramp-up, partnering with design engineering, quality, test, operations, and supply chain on DFM reviews, process validation, risk reduction, product qualification, capacity, and scalable production controls.
Process Controls and Documentation: Define and maintain critical process parameters, control plans, SOPs, work instructions, process specifications, process flow maps, risk assessments, FMEAs, and production standards to ensure repeatable and compliant operations.
Tooling, Jigs, and Stencils: Develop, review, qualify, and continuously improve jigs, fixtures, pallets, carriers, and SMT stencils to strengthen process stability, solder paste deposition quality, manufacturability, ergonomics, and repeatable production performance.
Continuous Improvement: Lead Lean, Six Sigma, and data-driven improvement projects that increase equipment utilization and throughput, improve line balance, reduce cycle time and defects, and identify sustainable cost-reduction opportunities.
Equipment Lifecycle Support: Evaluate and implement production equipment and technologies, establish preventive maintenance, calibration, verification, and spare-parts requirements, and partner with maintenance and suppliers to resolve equipment-related constraints.
Supplier and Vendor Coordination: Coordinate with external suppliers on equipment, tooling, materials, services, and technical deliverables; support quotation reviews, purchase documentation, and timely processing of approved vendor payment requirements.
Cross-Functional Leadership and Compliance: Provide technical guidance to production and engineering partners, drive actions to closure, and ensure processes meet internal standards, customer requirements, IPC workmanship criteria, ESD controls, environmental requirements, and applicable safety regulations. | Requirements: Education: Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Manufacturing, Industrial, Materials Engineering, or related technical field.
Senior-Level Manufacturing Experience: Substantial process engineering experience in PCB fabrication, PCBA, SMT assembly, or electronics manufacturing within a high-volume production environment, including ownership of complex production issues and improvement initiatives.
PCBA Process Expertise: Advanced working knowledge of solder paste printing, component placement, reflow profiling, wave/selective soldering, cleaning, inspection, rework, and test-related process controls.
Quality and Reliability: Strong knowledge of IPC workmanship standards, ESD controls, quality systems, statistical process control, process capability, control plans, and electronics manufacturing best practices.
Analytical Problem-Solving: Demonstrated ability to analyze SPC trends, first-pass yield, equipment utilization, capacity, defect Pareto data, scrap, rework, and downtime to determine root causes and implement sustainable corrective actions.
Improvement Methods: Hands-on experience using 5 Why, fishbone diagrams, 8D, DMAIC, FMEA, Lean, and Six Sigma methods to lead measurable process improvements.
NPI and Qualification: Experience leading manufacturing readiness, DFM reviews, process validation, equipment and product qualification, risk assessment, and high-volume production ramp-up.
Equipment and Tooling: Experience qualifying production equipment and developing or improving SMT stencils, tooling, fixtures, jigs, pallets, and carriers, including maintenance, calibration, verification, and spare-parts considerations.
Technical Documentation: Ability to create and control clear SOPs, work instructions, process specifications, flow maps, qualification reports, troubleshooting guides, and manufacturing control documentation.
Software and Data: Proficiency with Microsoft Office and experience with manufacturing systems, statistical analysis tools, MES/ERP platforms, or data visualization tools used for process monitoring and decision-making.
Leadership and Collaboration: Strong communication, project leadership, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to influence production, quality, test, maintenance, supply chain, design engineering, headquarters teams, and external suppliers.
Production Support: Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment, respond to urgent production needs, make sound technical decisions, and drive actions to closure with minimal supervision.
﻿FAIR PAY & A JUST WORKPLACE
SolarEdge proudly seeks to build a richly diverse workforce by hiring people with a diversity of thoughts, identities, perspectives, and experiences that help advance the difference we make for consumers, and by ensuring our people experience equity and inclusion in their work lives. We encourage members of traditionally underrepresented communities to apply, including women, LGBTQIA people, people of color, and people with disabilities.

At SolarEdge (NASDAQ: SEDG), we're a global leader in smart energy technology, with over 4,000 employees, offices in 34 countries, and millions of installations worldwide.
Our innovative solutions include solar inverters, battery storage, backup systems, EV charging, and AI-based energy management. We're committed to making clean, green energy the primary power source for homes, businesses, and beyond.
With the growing demand for electricity, the need for smart, clean energy sources is constantly rising. SolarEdge offers amazing opportunities to develop your skills in a multidisciplinary environment, covering everything from research and development to production and customer supply. Work with talented colleagues, tackle exciting challenges, and help create a sustainable future in an industry that's always evolving and innovating. Join us and be part of a company that values creativity, agility, and impactful work.
We are seeking an Quality Engineer to oversee and optimize project execution within our solar manufacturing operations. This role involves coordinating cross-functional teams, managing timelines, ensuring compliance, and driving operational efficiency for solar production and deployment.
Location : Austin, TX
Duties and Responsibilities:
Report to SolarEdge Quality Manager in NAM and will be part of SolarEdge team located at Austin TX, USA.
Support the Quality Manager to implement improved monitoring methods and lesson learn activities on the production line.
Cooperate with Local EMS teams to monitor and improve the Quality and the performance of SolarEdge Products manufactured in Flex, TX
Responsible to investigate the root cause of workmanship-related failures and lead EMS teams for CAPA/SCAR implementation.
Lead implementations of improvement plans and actions that shall result in improved production FPYs and Fielded Reliability.
Cooperate with SolarEdge Head Quarters Quality and Reliability members and support the global Quality and Reliability targets and goals. | Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering
Additional education in Quality as a minimum, Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) is an advantage.
At least 3 years experience in Quality of multidisciplinary electronics mass production at OEM Contract Manufacturers.
Proven experience in different production methodologies, technologies, and processes of High-end Electronics, Electro-Mechanics, and Mechanical Products.
The Quality Engineer shall have knowledge of reading Electrical and Mechanical drawings and good technical skills for the assembly of modules/systems.
Good Personal skills.
Good knowledge in computing Microsoft Office-must, others-advantage.
Ability to identify, log, and/or troubleshoot issues that arise during production.
Certification in IPC-A-610, IPC-A-620, IPC-7011/7021, J-STD-002/003 preferred.
Ability to lift up to 50 pounds repetitively.
Good verbal and writing skills.
FAIR PAY & A JUST WORKPLACE
SolarEdge proudly seeks to build a richly diverse workforce by hiring people with a diversity of thoughts, identities, perspectives, and experiences that help advance the difference we make for consumers, and by ensuring our people experience equity and inclusion in their work lives. We encourage members of traditionally underrepresented communities to apply, including women, LGBTQIA people, people of color, and people with disabilities.

SolarEdge (NASDAQ: SEDG), is a global leader in high-performance smart energy technology, with over 5000 employees, offices in 34 countries, and millions of products installed in over 133 countries. We are looking for an Assistant Controller to join our Revenue group
what you will be doing:
Accountant who will ensure revenue transactions are accurately recorded in accordance with US GAAP.
Work with the sales, legal and sales operations group on any revenue recognition issues
Manage and ensure accurate and timely quarterly accounting close of revenue related accounts and accounts receivable.
Control all incentive plans offered to the company customers.
Review client contracts and determine the proper treatment of revenue recognition
Design, manage and execute certain key revenue controls
Create and document the Company’s revenue recognition policy for new products and services.
Drive the development of the project plan to implement the new revenue recognition standards and monitor any other SEC and FASB developments related to revenue recognition.
Implementation of the Group’s accounting policies related to revenue recognition at subsidiaries
Submission and consolidation of subsidiary's monthly and quarterly reports.
Work on ad hoc projects as assigned from time to time. | Requirements: Requirements:
CPA- must
Extensive Revenue Recognition Experience- must
In-depth knowledge of US GAAP - (ASC 606) BESP, SSP
At least 3+ years' experience in a Big 4 accounting firm auditing global hi-tech companies or work at global hi-tech companies
High-level English
Strong EXCEL experience
Experience with Oracle ERP system – MUST

job.title: Senior Accounts Receivable
job.snippet:
Description: Position Summary
The Senior Accounts Receivable Accountant will own collections and credit activity for the North America business from our India finance team. In addition to the core AR responsibilities, this role prepares the monthly AR report with management-level analysis, performs customer credit checks, and acts as second-in-command to the AR lead, providing strong support in managing AR activities and processes. The role reports to the AR lead.
Are you ready to power the future?
At SolarEdge (NASDAQ: SEDG), we're a global leader in smart energy technology, with over 4,000 employees, offices in 34 countries, and millions of installations worldwide.
Our innovative solutions include solar inverters, battery storage, backup systems, EV charging, and AI-based energy management. We're committed to making clean, green energy the primary power source for homes, businesses, and beyond.
With the growing demand for electricity, the need for smart, clean energy sources is constantly rising. SolarEdge offers amazing opportunities to develop your skills in a multidisciplinary environment, covering everything from research and development to production and customer supply. Work with talented colleagues, tackle exciting challenges, and help create a sustainable future in an industry that's always evolving and innovating. Join us and be part of a company that values creativity, agility, and impactful work.
Duties and Responsibilities
Own a list of assigned customers and be on top of every account for collection: follow up proactively on open and past-due balances and drive timely payment
Communicate directly with customers on invoices, payments and past-due balances, and build strong working relationships with the customers you own
Reconcile customer payments in the system, including cash application, unapplied cash and payment discrepancies
Support month-end close for AR and assist with audit PBC documentation
Prepare the monthly AR report, including analysis, and highlight key points that require management attention
Perform customer credit checks and review credit availability
Prepare credit increase recommendations and communicate effectively with HQ on credit processes
Work effectively with AI tools and identify opportunities to use them to improve AR processes and efficiency
Act as second-in-command to the AR lead: provide strong support in managing AR activities and processes, and serve as backup in their absence
Develop/improve business processes to maintain and strengthen internal controls and efficiency
Additional duties as assigned | Requirements: Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field
Experienced; 6+ years in accounts receivable, collections or credit, with experience in a senior or lead role
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Office Suite is required; strong analytical and reporting skills
Experience with Corporate ERP systems is preferable
Ability to work effectively with AI tools and a mindset for continuous process improvement
Strong communication skills in English, including direct communication with customers, HQ and US-based colleagues, with working hours that overlap with US time zones
Ability to maintain absolute confidentiality and exercise appropriate judgment as required.
Ability to be flexible and to work well under pressure to support the fast paced environment.
High standards for organization ethics
Superior attention to detail, accuracy and efficiency.
Able to handle multiple assignments independently and concurrently.
Strong listening, written and oral communication skills.
Strong team contributor; ability and willingness to work hard to achieve department objectives.
Must have a strong work ethic.

job.title: Senior Analog Engineer
job.snippet:
Description: SolarEdge (NASDAQ: SEDG) is a global leader in high-performance smart energy technology, with over 3,000 employees, offices in 33 countries, and millions of products installed in more than 133 countries.
Our solutions include class-leading solar inverters, battery backup systems, EV charging, and complete home energy management ecosystems. With world-class engineering and a relentless focus on innovation, we are helping make clean, green solar energy the primary source of power wherever people live, work, and thrive.
About the Team
Our Analog ASIC group leads chip development at the core of SolarEdge products, working closely with system, software, and hardware teams to optimize performance across the full product lifecycle.
Joining this group means more than designing components — it is an opportunity to shape the entire system through system-level innovation and end-to-end ownership, from specification to real-world implementation.
The Role
We are seeking an experienced Senior Analog Engineer to design and develop complex analog and mixed-signal ICs for SolarEdge’s advanced renewable energy products.
In this role, you will help turn advanced analog design into reliable, scalable technology that supports the global transition to renewable energy.
Responsibilities
Define system-level analog architecture and IP specifications based on product requirements.
Develop analog, mixed-signal, and power IP, including ownership of analog subsystems and chip top-level integration.
Verify designed IP, subsystem, and chip top-level functionality using transistor-level and mixed-signal analog-to-digital simulations.
Define layout guidelines and perform layout reviews for analog, mixed-signal, and power IP.
Perform post-silicon IP design validation in the lab.
Support product engineering to meet manufacturing and production needs. | Requirements: Requirements
B.Tech/ M.Tech in Electrical / Electronics / VLSI or similar Streams in Engineering from a recognized university.
Over 6 years of experience in analog or mixed-signal design, simulation, and characterization of circuits such as operational amplifiers, comparators, reference circuits, ADC/DAC, PLL, etc.
Advantages
Strong knowledge of MOS, Bipolar transistors, and high-voltage IC processes (e.g., BCD, SOI).
Experience with integrated power electronic circuits such as DC-DC converters, gate drivers, charge pumps, rectifiers, and LDOs.
Experience in full-chip integration, including interfaces with digital and hardware.
Familiarity with layout verification and extraction tools.
High-Voltage Technology (BCD, say 130nm)
Design of Buck-Boost or Similar Power Conversion Topologies .

job.title: SENIOR AUTOMATION QA ENGINEER
job.snippet:
Description: About SolarEdge
SolarEdge is a global leader in smart energy technology. We develop advanced solutions for solar energy generation, storage, EV charging, and energy management, helping transform how energy is produced, consumed, and managed worldwide.
Our Global IT Data, AI & Software organization drives SolarEdge's digital transformation through enterprise platforms, data and AI innovation, automation, and modern software engineering practices.
The Role
We are looking for an experienced Senior Automation QA Engineer to lead quality engineering practices across enterprise applications, AI-driven solutions, integrations, data platforms, and digital products. You will work closely with software engineers, product owners, architects, DevOps engineers, and global business stakeholders to build scalable automation frameworks and embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle.
This is a hands-on senior role for someone who combines strong automation engineering expertise with curiosity about emerging technologies and a passion for reliable, high-quality software.
Key Responsibilities
· Design, develop, and maintain scalable automated testing frameworks for enterprise and digital applications.
· Build and execute automated functional, regression, integration, API, and end-to-end test suites.
· Partner with development teams to embed quality early in the Software Development Lifecycle through Shift-Left and continuous testing practices.
· Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to support fast, reliable, and repeatable releases.
· Test cloud-native applications, REST APIs, microservices, integrations, and data-driven solutions.
· Use AI-assisted testing capabilities and emerging technologies to improve test creation, coverage, maintenance, and defect detection.
· Participate in architecture and design reviews to ensure solutions are testable, scalable, secure, and maintainable.
· Analyze failures, investigate root causes, and collaborate with engineering teams to resolve defects efficiently.
· Define and monitor quality KPIs, automation coverage, defect trends, and release-readiness criteria.
· Mentor QA engineers and promote automation standards, reusable assets, and quality engineering best practices.
· Continuously evaluate new tools, frameworks, and methodologies and translate them into practical improvements. | Requirements: Required Qualifications
· Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
· 7+ years of experience in software quality assurance, including at least 5 years of hands-on test automation development.
· Strong programming skills in at least one language, such as Python, Java, TypeScript, or C#.
· Proven experience with modern automation frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or Appium.
· Strong experience in API and integration testing using tools such as Postman, Rest Assured, or similar.

job.title: Senior Budget Analyst
job.snippet:
Description: Position Summary
The Senior Budget Analyst will support the North America finance team from our India finance team, focusing on revenue analysis, purchase order analysis and the company budget. The role sets up the budget, builds the budget forecast from purchase order analysis, monitors actuals against it, and highlights key points that require management attention. The role works closely with the HQ FP&A team in Israel, aligning on budget assumptions, forecasts and analysis, and sharing results. The role reports to the Sr. Accountant Lead.
Are you ready to power the future?
At SolarEdge (NASDAQ: SEDG), we're a global leader in smart energy technology, with over 4,000 employees, offices in 34 countries, and millions of installations worldwide.
Our innovative solutions include solar inverters, battery storage, backup systems, EV charging, and AI-based energy management. We're committed to making clean, green energy the primary power source for homes, businesses, and beyond.
With the growing demand for electricity, the need for smart, clean energy sources is constantly rising. SolarEdge offers amazing opportunities to develop your skills in a multidisciplinary environment, covering everything from research and development to production and customer supply. Work with talented colleagues, tackle exciting challenges, and help create a sustainable future in an industry that's always evolving and innovating. Join us and be part of a company that values creativity, agility, and impactful work.
Duties and Responsibilities
Perform revenue analysis, including trends, drivers and variances, and highlight key points that require management attention
Support the annual budget set-up, including collecting inputs from budget owners and building and maintaining the budget model
Monitor the budget throughout the year: track actuals against budget, analyze variances and report results to management
Analyze purchase orders, including open commitments and spend trends, and build the budget forecast
Collaborate with the HQ FP&A team in Israel on the budget, forecast and financial analysis
Support forecast updates and ad hoc financial analysis as requested
Prepare monthly budget and revenue reporting packages for the Finance Director and department heads
Work effectively with AI tools and identify opportunities to use them to improve budgeting and analysis processes
Develop/improve business processes to maintain and strengthen internal controls and efficiency
Additional duties as assigned | Requirements: Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field
3-5 years of budgeting, FP&A or financial analysis experience
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Office Suite is required; strong financial modeling skills
Experience with Corporate ERP and reporting systems is preferable
Ability to work effectively with AI tools and a mindset for continuous process improvement
Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to work with HQ in Israel and US-based colleagues, including working hours that overlap with Israel and US time zones
Ability to maintain absolute confidentiality and exercise appropriate judgment as required.
Ability to be flexible and to work well under pressure to support the fast paced environment.
High standards for organization ethics
Superior attention to detail, accuracy and efficiency.
Able to handle multiple assignments independently and concurrently.
Strong listening, written and oral communication skills.
Strong team contributor; ability and willingness to work hard to achieve department objectives.
Must have a strong work ethic.

job.title: Senior Cyber Security Engineer
job.snippet:
Description: Join SolarEdge as a Senior Cyber Security Engineer, where you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding our systems and data. Leverage your expertise to implement advanced security measures and ensure compliance with industry standards.
Location: Bangalore / Hybrid (as applicable)
Experience: 5+ Years
Education: B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, Electronics, or related discipline
Position Overview
SolarEdge is seeking an experienced Regulatory & Compliance Specialist to join the GRC Security Team. Reporting to the GRC Security Lead, this role will be responsible for translating regulatory, compliance, and cybersecurity requirements into practical security controls across SolarEdge's product ecosystem.
Key Responsibilities
Monitor and analyze emerging cybersecurity regulations and standards impacting SolarEdge products.
Translate regulatory requirements into actionable security controls.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Cloud, and IoT teams to implement security-by-design practices.
Conduct compliance assessments and risk evaluations across software, hardware, cloud, and connected product environments.
Define, document, validate, and test security controls.
Identify compliance gaps and drive remediation activities.
Support internal and external audits and prepare compliance evidence.
Maintain compliance dashboards and provide leadership updates.
Collaborate with global stakeholders to achieve compliance objectives. | Requirements: Required Qualifications
• 5+ years of experience in GRC, Regulatory Compliance, Information Security, Risk Management, or Audit.
• Strong understanding of compliance frameworks, security controls, and audit processes.
• Experience with Software, Hardware, Cloud, SaaS, IoT, or Embedded products.
• Knowledge of ISO 27001, NIST CSF, SOC 2, IEC 62443, CRA, NIS2, and related standards.
• Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to work independently in a global environment.
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with product security and Secure Development Lifecycle (SDLC).
• Certifications such as CISA, CRISC, CISSP, CISM, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor/implementer.
• Experience supporting cloud, SaaS, energy, or IoT compliance programs.
Why Join SolarEdge?
Be part of a global leader in renewable energy and smart technology, work on innovative products, collaborate with international teams, and drive cybersecurity and regulatory excellence across next-generation energy solutions.

job.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
job.snippet:
Description: Power the Future with us!
SolarEdge (NASDAQ: SEDG) is a global leader in high-performance smart energy technology, with over 4,000 employees, offices in 34 countries, and millions of products installed in more than 133 countries. Our diverse product offering includes intelligent solar inverters, battery storage, backup systems, EV charging, and complete home energy management ecosystems. With world-class engineering and a relentless focus on innovation, we are creating a world where clean, green energy from the sun powers our homes, businesses, and communities.
Responsibilities:
We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to own and evolve our AWS cloud infrastructure, drive our FinOps discipline, and ensure our systems are scalable, secure, and cost-efficient. This is a hands-on role with real ownership — you will architect solutions, automate operations, and work closely with R&D teams to deliver reliable infrastructure that powers SolarEdge products worldwide. We offer a hybrid model of work - two days at the office .
AWS Cloud Infrastructure
﻿Design, build, and maintain scalable, highly available AWS infrastructure across multi-account environments.
Own core AWS services including EC2, EKS, RDS, S3, VPC, IAM, Route53, CloudFront, and CloudWatch
Implement and manage Infrastructure as Code using Terraform — reusable modules, remote state, workspaces, and policy-as-code.
Architect secure, well-governed AWS environments using Organizations, SCPs, and Control Tower patterns.
Ensure infrastructure security through IAM least-privilege policies, VPC design, encryption, and compliance controls.
FinOps & Cloud Cost Management
Own the FinOps practice: implement cost tagging strategies, enforce resource governance, and deliver regular cost visibility reports.
Identify and execute on rightsizing, Reserved Instance, and Savings Plan optimization opportunities.
Build budget alerting, cost anomaly detection, and automated guardrails to prevent cloud spend overruns.
Work with engineering teams to embed cost-awareness into architecture and development decisions.
Kubernetes & Containerization
Provision, operate, and maintain EKS clusters for production and non-production workloads.
Provision, operate, and maintain On-Prem Rancher cluster and non-production workloads
Manage Helm chart deployments, configure autoscaling (HPA/VPA/Karpenter), and enforce RBAC and network policies.
Support containerization efforts and ensure Docker best practices across development and production environments.
CI/CD & Automation
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitLab, integrating automated testing, SAST/SCA scanning, and deployment gates.
Automate operational tasks — provisioning, patching, scaling, backups, and incident remediation — using Python and Bash.
Observability & Reliability
Build and maintain the observability stack: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, and alerting pipelines.
Define and monitor SLOs/SLIs, own incident response runbooks, and contribute to post-mortem culture.
Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, reliability risks, and security gaps. | Requirements: Must-Have
3–5 years of hands-on DevOps or cloud engineering experience in production AWS environments.
Strong AWS expertise: EC2, EKS, S3, RDS, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, Cost Explorer — with the ability to design end-to-end solutions.
﻿Proven Terraform skills: writing modules, managing state, and enforcing infrastructure standards.
Demonstrated FinOps experience: cost tagging, rightsizing, and budget governance.
Hands-on Kubernetes experience: EKS, On-prem rancher rke2, Helm, RBAC, autoscaling, Vault and network policies.
﻿ CI/CD pipeline experience with GitLab or equivalent; familiarity with SAST/SCA tooling.
Scripting proficiency in Python and/or Bash for automation and operational tooling.
Solid understanding of networking fundamentals: DNS, load balancing, VPC peering, TLS.
Nice to Have
Experience with ArgoCD, GitOps workflows, or progressive delivery strategies.
Familiarity with Pulumi or AWS CDK as IaC alternatives.
Exposure to DevSecOps practices: secrets management (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager), container image scanning, and compliance-as-code.
AWS certifications: Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, or FinOps Practitioner (FinOps Foundation).
Experience with observability tooling: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or OpenTelemetry.
Interest in GenAI-powered automation and developer tooling.
SolarEdge recognizes its talented and diverse workforce as a key competitive advantage. Our business success is a reflection of the quality and skill of our people.
SolarEdge is committed to seeking out and retaining the finest human talent to ensure top business growth and performance.
Only short-listed candidates will be contacted.

job.title: Senior Electrical Engineer (Licensed Engineer Electrician)
job.snippet:
Description: Power the Future with us!
At SolarEdge (NASDAQ: SEDG), we're a global leader in smart energy technology, with over 3,000 employees, offices in 34 countries, and millions of installations worldwide.

Join us and be part of a company that values creativity, agility, and impactful work.
We are looking for an Electrical Engineer to join our Data Centers Group
We are seeking an experienced Electrical Engineer with a valid Israeli Engineer Electrician License (רישיון חשמלאי מהנדס) to join our Data Center Power Solutions team. In this role, you will be responsible for the design, development, testing, and commissioning of electrical power systems and electrical panels for advanced power conversion and distribution solutions.
The ideal candidate will combine strong electrical design capabilities with hands-on experience in electrical installations, panel assembly, commissioning, troubleshooting, and laboratory work. Experience with medium-voltage (MV) and low-voltage (LV) systems is highly desirable.
Key Responsibilities
Design electrical power distribution systems, switchboards, and control panels for industrial and data center applications.
Create electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, single-line diagrams (SLDs), and cable schedules.
Select and specify electrical components including breakers, contactors, relays, busbars, transformers, CTs, sensors, and protection devices.
Design electrical cabinets and panel layouts while ensuring compliance with IEC, UL, and applicable electrical standards.
Support MV and LV power system architecture and integration activities.
Perform electrical calculations including load analysis, cable sizing, short-circuit studies, voltage drop calculations, and protection coordination.
Lead hands-on electrical assembly, wiring, commissioning, testing, and troubleshooting activities in the laboratory and field.
Work closely with mechanical, hardware, embedded software, and system engineers to ensure successful product integration.
Support prototype builds, validation, and design verification testing.
Develop test procedures and execute electrical safety and functional tests.
Interface with suppliers, contractors, panel manufacturers, and certification bodies.
Create and maintain technical documentation, test reports, specifications, and design guidelines.
Support installation and startup activities at customer and demonstration sites. | Requirements: B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering.
Valid Israeli Engineer Electrician License (רישיון חשמלאי מהנדס).
Minimum 5 years of experience in electrical engineering.
Proven experience designing electrical panels, switchboards, or industrial electrical systems.
Experience with MV and/or LV power distribution systems.
Strong understanding of electrical protection, grounding, and safety practices.
Experience with electrical schematics and CAD tools (AutoCAD Electrical, EPLAN, or equivalent).
Hands-on experience in electrical assembly, commissioning, testing, and troubleshooting.
Knowledge of IEC and electrical safety standards.
Ability to independently lead electrical design activities from concept through commissioning.
Strong technical documentation and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with medium-voltage equipment and power conversion systems.
Experience in data centers, renewable energy, energy storage, EV charging, or industrial power systems.
Experience working with transformers, power electronics systems, UPSs, SSTs, or grid-connected equipment.
Knowledge of PLCs, industrial communications, and control systems.
Experience working with high-power laboratory environments.
Previous experience supporting products through certification and compliance processes.

Our innovative solutions include solar inverters, battery storage, backup systems, EV charging, and AI-based energy management. We're committed to making clean, green energy the primary power source for homes, businesses, and beyond.
With the growing demand for electricity, the need for smart, clean energy sources is constantly rising. SolarEdge offers amazing opportunities to develop your skills in a multidisciplinary environment, covering everything from research and development to production and customer supply. Work with talented colleagues, tackle exciting challenges, and help create a sustainable future in an industry that's always evolving and innovating. Join us and be part of a company that values creativity, agility, and impactful work.
Our R&D division is growing globally, and we are looking for an experienced Sr. Embedded Control Firmware Engineer to join our dynamic team at the new R&D site in Bangalore, India.
As a Sr. Embedded Control Firmware Engineer , you will be a crucial member of the SolarEdge India R&D team, responsible for developing embedded control firmware for our advanced solar energy products. You will play a key role in designing, implementing, and testing embedded control firmware, ensuring its reliability, performance, and seamless integration with our hardware platforms.
Responsibilities:
Lead, design and development of embedded control firmware for SolarEdge's solar power conversion products, including inverters, power optimizers, and energy storage converter.
Collaborating with cross-functional teams, including hardware engineers, embedded developers, and product/project managers, to define system requirements, design concepts/ideas and agreed with innovative architect embedded solutions.
Develop and implement efficient and reliable embedded digital control firmware in C/C++ for various microcontrollers and processors used in SolarEdge products.
Conduct thorough testing and verification of embedded control firmware to ensure its functionality, performance, and compliance with quality standards.
Troubleshoot and debug embedded control firmware and hardware interactions, identifying and resolving issues throughout the product development lifecycle.
Participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback to team members and ensuring code quality and adherence to coding standards.
Stay abreast of industry trends and advancements in embedded systems to propose and integrate cutting-edge technologies into SolarEdge's products.
Collaborate with manufacturing and validation teams to support the production and testing of embedded control firmware during the manufacturing process.
Support the certification process by providing necessary documentation and technical inputs to comply with relevant safety and regulatory standards. | Requirements: Bachelor's (B.E./B.Tech.) in Electrical/Electronic Engineering with 8+ years of relevant industrial experience in embedded control firmware design and development ( Or )
Master’s degree (M.E./M.Tech.) in Power Electronics/ Control System/Embedded System Engineering with 6+ years of relevant industrial experience in embedded control firmware design and development ( Or ) • Ph.D . in Closed loop control firmware design and development for Power converter/Inverter/DC-DC Converter with 3+ years of relevant industrial experience in embedded control firmware design and development.
Design and Implementation of embedded digital control algorithms in C/C++ for power converter, such as DC/AC Inverters and DC/DC converters operating at high switching frequency.
Strong knowledge and proven experience in developing control algorithms for Power electronics converters/Inverters.
Experience in optimizing firmware algorithms to enhance system efficiency and reliability .
Experience in Control loop Simulation and Software-in-the-loop (SIL) using PLECS/MATLAB tools.
Experience with Hardware-in-the Loop (HIL) using Typhoon HIL /MATLAB is desirable.
Experience in Real-time operating systems (RTOS) and bare-metal code development.
Strong understanding of microcontrollers/microprocessors and it’s peripherals , and embedded system architectures.
Hands on embedded control firmware experience using MCU’s such as TI/ST/Renesas etc.
Working knowledge on the protocols and devices driver for SPI, I2C, UART, CAN.
Ability to identify, troubleshoot firmware / hardware technical problems.
Experience developing device drivers and execute a tight interrupt loop in bare metal implementation.
Working knowledge in using JTAG/SWD debugger.
Experience in board bring-up, peripheral integration, and device driver development.
Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, with a track record of delivering robust and reliable embedded software.
Knowledge of software development tools, version control systems, and debugging tools for embedded systems.
Excellent communication and teamwork skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Experience in the renewable energy or power electronics industry is an added advantage. • Provide technical support and troubleshooting assistance during product development. Stay up to date with the latest advancements in power electronics and firmware technologies.
Drive results within constraints of Product life cycle development and production at scale.
Results-oriented mindset with a focus on achieving tangible and measurable results.
SolarEdge recognizes its talented and diverse workforce as a key competitive advantage. Our business success is a reflection of the quality and skill of our people. SolarEdge is committed to seeking out and retaining the finest human talent to ensure top business growth and performance.

job.title: Senior Embedded Infrastructure Engineer
job.snippet:
Description: Power the Future with us!
SolarEdge (NASDAQ: SEDG), is a global leader in high-performance smart energy technology, with over 3000 employees, offices in 33 countries, and millions of products installed in over 133 countries.
Our diverse product offering comprises intelligent solar inverters, battery storage, backup systems, EV charging, and complete home energy management ecosystems.
By leveraging world-class engineering capabilities and with a relentless focus on innovation, we strive to create a world where clean, green energy from the sun is the primary source of power for our homes, businesses, and just about everywhere we thrive.
The Embedded Infrastructure Team builds and maintains the shared embedded software foundations used across the department. We develop reusable code and core technologies that enable multiple projects and teams to succeed, while spearheading the adoption of new technologies within the organization. By providing a robust, scalable base, we empower product teams to move faster with confidence.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and maintain embedded software for a cross-platform SDK at the core of SolarEdge embedded products.
Develop bootloaders, drivers, bare-metal, and RTOS-based firmware for ARM & ARC processors.
Collaborate across software, hardware, and architecture teams to develop and integrate features, from design through implementation and system-level validation.
Participate in design reviews/code reviews and develop high-quality code following best practices, including unit tests and automated system tests.
Define and improve development environments and build flows that enable efficiency and flexibility across all teams.
Navigate a hardware-oriented environment encompassing chip bring-up, physical device integration, complex troubleshooting, and software-hardware validation.
Apply AI-driven tools and methodologies to accelerate development and enhance code quality. | Requirements: Basic Qualifications :
B.Sc. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
At least 5 years of experience in real-time embedded systems firmware development using C/C++.
Hands-on experience in development and troubleshooting on embedded micro-controllers and processors.
Experience with firmware debugging tools such as JTAG and logic analyzers.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Experience with embedded peripheries drivers (UART, SPI, I2C, ADC, PWM, Timers, DMA).
Excellent teamwork skills, flexibility, and ability to handle multiple tasks.
Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies and domains.
Familiarity with multi-threaded and/or RTOS-based systems.
Preferred Qualification :
Experience with AI-driven development tools and workflows
Hands-on experience with communication protocols such as CAN-FD, Ethernet, or TCP/IP.
Experience developing tools and scripts for automation using Python or other scripting languages.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Gitlab CI, Github Actions, Jenkins, etc) and automation workflows.
Familiarity with command-line build systems such as CMake, Bazel, Meson, etc.
SolarEdge recognizes its talented and diverse workforce as a key competitive advantage. Our business success is a reflection of the quality and skill of our people.
SolarEdge is committed to seeking out and retaining the finest human talent to ensure top business growth and performance.

job.title: Senior Hardware Engineer
job.snippet:
Description: Power the Future with us!
At SolarEdge (NASDAQ: SEDG), we're a global leader in smart energy technology, with over 3,000 employees, offices in 34 countries, and millions of installations worldwide.
Our innovative solutions include solar inverters, battery storage, backup systems, EV charging, and AI-based energy management. We're committed to making clean, green energy the primary power source for homes, businesses, and beyond.
With the growing demand for electricity, the need for smart, clean energy sources is constantly rising. SolarEdge offers amazing opportunities to develop your skills in a multidisciplinary environment, covering everything from research and development to production and customer supply. Work with talented colleagues, tackle exciting challenges, and help create a sustainable future in an industry that's always evolving and innovating. Join us and be part of a company that values creativity, agility, and impactful work.
As a Senior Hardware Engineer , you'll lead a team of hardware engineers developing the analog and communication circuits at the heart of SolarEdge's solar inverters and optimizers. You'll guide designs through the entire R&D lifecycle - from concept and feasibility studies through simulation, schematic design, and lab verification, all the way to mass production.
This is a hands-on leadership role where you'll set the technical standards for the team, mentor engineers in their day-to-day work, and collaborate closely with software, system, mechanical, and production teams to bring robust, high-quality products to market. It's an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to remain deeply involved in analog engineering while developing a team and shaping our hardware design processes.
What will you be doing?
Lead, mentor, and manage a team of hardware engineers specializing in analog circuit design, simulation, and testing.
Research, design, and develop analog and communication circuits, from initial requirements through to mass production.
Perform lab characterization and verification of analog circuits using spectrum analyzers, oscilloscopes, and other laboratory equipment.
Lead design reviews and serve as the technical authority for the team's area of expertise.
Collaborate with software, system, mechanical, and production teams to ensure seamless hardware-software integration and a smooth transition to manufacturing.
Manage technical scope, schedules, risks, and product quality across the team's projects. | Requirements: B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering.
5+ years of experience in discrete analog circuit and PCB design.
Experience in people management or team leadership, or senior engineering experience with a track record of technical leadership and mentoring.
Proven hands-on experience with laboratory equipment, including spectrum analyzers, oscilloscopes, power supplies, and electronic loads.
Strong background in analog circuit design, including passive and active filters and op-amp topologies.
Experience with PCB layout - an advantage
Knowledge of PSpice or LTspice simulation tools - an advantage.
Expertise in RF, communications, or power electronics - an advantage.
Python programming skills - an advantage.

Oversee network and security projects from inception through completion, ensuring all deliverables meet specified timelines and quality standards.

job.title: Senior PCB Layout Designer
job.snippet:
Description: SolarEdge (NASDAQ: SEDG) is a global leader in high-performance smart energy technology, with over 3000 employees, offices in 34 countries, and millions of products installed in over 133 countries. Our diverse product offering comprises intelligent solar inverters, battery storage, backup systems, EV charging, and complete home energy management ecosystems. By leveraging world-class engineering capabilities and with a relentless focus on innovation, we strive to create a world where clean, green energy from the sun is the primary source of power for our homes, businesses, and just about everywhere we thrive.
We are looking for an experienced PCB Layout Designer to join our Layout Design team within the SolarEdge Hardware division. The Layout Design team is responsible for the layout of all core Hardware products, including High-Voltage power boards, optimizers, communication circuits, and complex battery management systems (BMS).
This is a highly challenging role where you will work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, handling multiple priority projects under tight schedules while working closely with Hardware, Q&R, and Mechanical engineers.
What you will do:
Design and develop multi-layer PCB layouts from concept to production, including placement, routing, and final manufacturing outputs.
Translate schematics into optimized layouts considering Signal Integrity (SI), Power Integrity (PI), EMI/EMC mitigation, thermal, and manufacturability constraints.
Work in a Cadence Allegro and OrCAD Capture environment, including the use of parallel layout tools like Symphony to accelerate delivery.
Collaborate closely with Mechanical engineers (handling 3D IDF/IDX transfers), R&D teams, and Reliability (Q&R) teams to meet strict mechanical constraints.
Strictly adhere to our internal "Design Considerations" guidelines and the team's layout "Cookbook" methodologies to ensure standardized execution. | Requirements: At least 3 years of hands-on experience with complex PCB layout.
High proficiency with OrCAD PCB Designer / Cadence Allegro.
Deep experience with constraint-driven layout design and Allegro Constraint Manager.
Proven experience with High-Voltage (HV) design, heavy copper routing, and advanced grounding/net-spacing practices.
Strong understanding of Signal Integrity (SI), Power Integrity (PI), high-speed routing, and mixed-signal (digital/analog) considerations.
Deep knowledge of DFM/DFA/DFT considerations, including ICT/ATE test point placement, thermal reliefs, and manufacturing limitations such as wave, laser, and robotic soldering.
Experience in tape-out procedures, generating ODB++/Gerber files, and preparing complete manufacturing packages.
Highly motivated, self-learning, with excellent communication skills to thrive in a cross-functional team.

job.title: Senior Power Electronics Engineer
job.snippet:
Description: Are you ready to power the future?
At SolarEdge (NASDAQ: SEDG), we're a global leader in smart energy technology, with over 4,000 employees, offices in 34 countries, and millions of installations worldwide.
Our innovative solutions include solar inverters, battery storage, backup systems, EV charging, and AI-based energy management. We're committed to making clean, green energy the primary power source for homes, businesses, and beyond.
With the growing demand for electricity, the need for smart, clean energy sources is constantly rising. SolarEdge offers amazing opportunities to develop your skills in a multidisciplinary environment, covering everything from research and development to production and customer supply. Work with talented colleagues, tackle exciting challenges, and help create a sustainable future in an industry that's always evolving and innovating. Join us and be part of a company that values creativity, agility, and impactful work.
Our R&D division is growing globally, and we are looking for an experienced Senior Power Electronics Engineer to join our dynamic team at the new R&D site in Bangalore, India.
As a Senior Power Electronics Engineer at SolarEdge India R&D , you will play a pivotal role in the design, development, and optimization of power electronics and power electronics systems for our advanced solar energy products. You will be responsible for driving the innovation and technical excellence of our power solutions, contributing to the success of SolarEdge's mission to make solar energy more accessible and efficient.
Responsibilities:
Lead the design, analysis, and development of advanced power electronics and power systems for SolarEdge's solar energy products, including inverters, power optimizers, and energy storage solutions.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including electrical engineers, Mechanical Engineers/Designers, PCB Layout Engineers, and firmware developers, to ensure seamless development, integration, and optimization of power systems.
Conduct power system studies, such as load flow analysis, transient stability, and harmonic analysis, to assess system performance and reliability.
Perform detailed design and analysis of power electronic circuits, ensuring compliance with industry standards and safety regulations.
Prepare detailed design documentation, Schematics, BoM, and test procedures.
Lead the testing and verification of power electronics and power systems, both in the lab and field, to ensure they meet design specifications and quality standards.
Participate in design reviews, providing technical expertise and guidance to the team to drive continuous improvement and innovation.
Collaborate with suppliers and manufacturing teams to support the transition of designs from R&D to mass production, addressing any design-related issues during production.
Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment. | Requirements: Bachelor's (B.E./B.Tech.) in Electrical/Electronics Engineering with 8+ years of relevant industrial in power converter design and development ( Or )
Master’s degree (M.E./M.Tech) in Electrical/Power Electronics/Energy System Engineering with 6+ years of relevant industrial experience in power electronics design and development ( Or )
Ph.D . in Electrical / Power Electronics with 3+ years of relevant industrial experience in power electronics system analysis and design, preferably in the solar energy or renewable energy industry.
Experience with simulation tools (e.g., PLECS, PSpice, LT SPICE, Simulink etc.)
Knowledge of power converter topologies (e.g., DC/DC, DC/AC and AC/DC ), including resonant and bi-directional converters and grid-tied inverters .
Strong understanding of Power Semiconductor devices (Including SiC and GaN ), gate drive circuits , and magnetic components used in power converters.
Excellent knowledge of PCB layout rules , considering high-current traces, thermal management, creepage, clearance requirements for HV and LV traces.
Ensure compliance with best practices for power distribution, component placement, and impedance control.
Implement EMI/EMC best design practices to ensure compliance with regulatory standards.
Familiarity with international safety and regulatory standards for power electronics and solar energy products.
SolarEdge recognizes its talented and diverse workforce as a key competitive advantage. Our business success is a reflection of the quality and skill of our people. SolarEdge is committed to seeking out and retaining the finest human talent to ensure top business growth and performance.

Description: About the Role
We are seeking a strong Senior Hardware Engineer to design Power electronics and signal conditioning circuits at the heart of SolarEdge’s advanced energy storage products. This is a hands-on design role for an engineer with deep, real-world experience in the disciplines of converter design, signal conditioning circuits, grounding, EMI, robust communication, accurate sensing and measurement — and in how these are verified at the board and full-system level.
What You’ll Be Doing
Designing Embedded Electronics Hardware for Battery Management Systems from concept through mass production for advanced energy storage products.
Designing Power electronics converter circuits for Battery Energy storage products.
Designing accurate measurements, robust communication, grounding, and power distribution — at both board and system level
Owning verification and characterization of your designs, on the bench and within the complete system
Taking technical ownership of subsystems and driving them independently
Contributing to design reviews and mentoring junior engineers
Working in a multidisciplinary environment and collaborating across departments and sites | Requirements: B.Tech. in Electrical, Electronics Or related Engineering Streams. Masters/PhD is Preferred.
5+ years of hands-on Power electronics HW design and Signal conditioning circuits, taken to mass production.
Deep expertise in precise analog measurement — accuracy budgeting, error sources, calibration — and in verifying accuracy at board and system level.
Experience designing protection circuits (overvoltage, overcurrent, short circuit).
Knowledge of power electronics and DC-DC converters (Buck, Boost, Flyback, Forward).
Proficiency in simulation tools such as LTspice, PSpice, or PSIM.
Strong problem-solving, debugging, and lab bring-up skills, with a systematic verification mindset.
Strong command of grounding, return-path, and power-distribution design.
EMI/EMC design-for-compliance experience — designed in up front, not fixed late.
Experience designing robust, noise-immune communication links (CAN, SPI, I2C, UART, differential) protocol-agnostic; robustness, isolation, and signal integrity are what matter.
Experience with multilayer PCB layout Review.
Strong command of AI tools and a demonstrated ability to leverage them to accelerate engineering work — analysis, documentation, scripting, and debugging
Strong documentation skills — design reviews and product lifecycle management
Advantageous Qualifications
Experience with Battery Management Systems (BMS) or energy storage technologies (Li-Ion, Solid State, etc.)
Familiarity with functional safety concepts and safety standards for battery and energy storage systems
Understanding of thermal management in electronic designs
Familiarity with regulatory compliance in electronics (CE, UL, etc.)

job.title: Senior System Integration Engineer
job.snippet:
Description: Power the future of AI with us.
Join SolarEdge’s Data Centers group and help shape the next generation of power infrastructure for AI-driven data centers .
Our integrated power ecosystem brings together Solid-State Transformers (SST), battery energy storage for uninterruptible power supply (UPS), and advanced power-conversion platforms.
Our SST technology is designed to convert high-voltage grid power into 800V DC, enabling a new approach to powering tomorrow’s data centers.
With 20 years of DC leadership and deep expertise in power electronics, we are positioned to lead the market with a high-efficiency SST solution.
Bring your expertise to a multidisciplinary team tackling complex engineering challenges at the intersection of energy and advanced computing, turning bold ideas into real-world systems.
What will you be doing:
Define system requirements, behavior, logic, and interfaces, considering all disciplines (Hardware, Software, Integration, User Interface, and more).
Lead cross-discipline feasibility and trade-off studies, architecture alternatives, and design reviews.
Conduct hands-on proof-of-concept activities on HW in the lab and field.
Lead system integration, validation, and verification activities, including test plan definition and hands-on participation in execution.
Investigate and solve complex system-level problems, including analysis of data and telemetry.
Interact with engineers across the company: Embedded SW, HW, Power, Cloud, Product, Integration, etc.
Act as the primary contact for system-related issues. | Requirements: B.Sc. or higher in Electrical Engineering, Embedded SW Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field.
5+ years of relevant experience in System Engineering or new product development.
5+ years of relevant experience in multidisciplinary technology fields involving Systems, HW, Embedded SW, Software, or Algorithms.
Must have hands-on R&D experience.
Understanding of energy storage systems, batteries, and power electronics – advantage.
Experience with Python, MATLAB, and/or simulation tools – advantage.
Highly motivated, proactive team player with excellent interpersonal skills.
Ability to work effectively across multiple interfaces (SW/HW/Mechanical engineers, Integration engineers, Product, etc.).
Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities.

job.title: Senior Thermal Analysis Engineer
job.snippet:
Description: Power the Future with us!
At SolarEdge (NASDAQ: SEDG), we're a global leader in smart energy technology, with over 3,000 employees, offices in 34 countries, and millions of installations worldwide.
Our innovative solutions include solar inverters, battery storage, backup systems, EV charging, and AI-based energy management. We're committed to making clean, green energy the primary power source for homes, businesses, and beyond.
With the growing demand for electricity, the need for smart, clean energy sources is constantly rising. SolarEdge offers amazing opportunities to develop your skills in a multidisciplinary environment, covering everything from research and development to production and customer supply. Work with talented colleagues, tackle exciting challenges, and help create a sustainable future in an industry that's always evolving and innovating. Join us and be part of a company that values creativity, agility, and impactful work.
We are seeking a sharp, experienced Senior Thermal Analysis Engineer to develop all of SolarEdge's product lines. We are searching for a self-motivated and passionate Mechanical Engineer to take part in research and development of the company's innovative products in the fields of renewable energies.
What you will be doing:
Analyze thermal performance of electronic boxes with high power dissipation components (PCBs, transformers, batteries)
Design air/water cooling solutions including air filtration, heat radiation, and solar loading
Analyze systems from component to cabinet level
Work in close collaboration with electrical and mechanical designers
Select off-the-shelf components (fans/ heat sinks / thermal interface materials)
Design and conduct validation experiments
Optimize existing designs for cost reduction | Requirements: B. Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Mechanical engineering from a recognized university
At Least 5 years of experience in flow and thermal simulations
Ability to analytically model simple problems
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, collaborate effectively within a team, and adapt flexibly to changes.
It would be a great advantage if you have:
Experience in thermal management of power electronics
Familiarity with electronic packaging design
Familiarity with mechanical design for manufacturing by plastic injection, die casting, metal forming, and mass production
Familiarity with PCB design

job.title: SIEM Integrator
job.snippet:
Description: Role Summary
The SIEM Integrator owns the end-to-end integration of log sources, security tools, and data pipelines into the organization's SIEM platform. This role is responsible for onboarding new data sources, building and tuning correlation rules and use cases, and ensuring the SIEM ecosystem is reliable, scalable, and aligned with detection and compliance requirements. The role bridges security operations, IT infrastructure, and engineering, and is responsible for the technical roadmap of the SIEM environment.
Key Responsibilities
• Lead the design, deployment, and lifecycle management of SIEM integrations across on-prem, cloud, and hybrid environments.
• Define and prioritize the SIEM onboarding roadmap in collaboration with SOC leadership, IT, and application owners.
• Build, tune, and maintain correlation rules, parsers, use cases, and dashboards to improve detection coverage and reduce false positives.
• Ensure log source health, data quality, and pipeline reliability through monitoring, alerting, and periodic audits.
• Partner with detection engineering and SOC analysts to translate threat scenarios into actionable SIEM content.
• Own SIEM platform architecture decisions, including sizing, retention, licensing, and integration with SOAR and other security tools.
• Document integration standards, onboarding procedures, and use-case libraries; drive knowledge sharing across the team.
• Act as the primary escalation point for SIEM-related technical issues and outages. | Requirements: Requirements
• 5+ years of hands-on experience with SIEM platforms - QRadar,
• Proven experience integrating diverse log sources (network, endpoint, cloud, identity, application) into SIEM
• Strong understanding of log formats, parsing, normalization, and correlation rule development.
• Solid knowledge of networking, operating systems, and common enterprise security tools.
• Familiarity with scripting/automation (Python, PowerShell, or similar) for integration and data enrichment tasks.
• Understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and how it maps to detection use cases.
• Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally with SOC, IT, and engineering teams.
Nice to Have
• Experience with SOAR platforms and security automation/orchestration.
• Relevant certifications (e.g., Splunk Certified, Microsoft SC-200, GIAC/GCIA/GCDA).
• Experience in regulated environments requiring compliance-driven logging (SOX, PCI-DSS, ISO 27001).

Description: Are you ready to power the future?
At SolarEdge (NASDAQ: SEDG), we're a global leader in smart energy technology, with over 4,000 employees, offices in 34 countries, and millions of installations worldwide.
Our innovative solutions include solar inverters, battery storage, backup systems, EV charging, and AI-based energy management. We're committed to making clean, green energy the primary power source for homes, businesses, and beyond.
With the growing demand for electricity, the need for smart, clean energy sources is constantly rising. Our R&D division is growing globally, and we are looking for an experienced Technical Lead Embedded Control Firmware to join our dynamic team at the new R&D site in Bangalore, India.
As a Technical Lead Embedded Control Firmware , you will be a crucial member of the SolarEdge India R&D team, responsible for developing embedded control firmware for our advanced solar energy products. You will play a key role in designing, implementing, and testing embedded control firmware, ensuring its reliability, performance, and seamless integration with our hardware platforms.

Lead, design and development of embedded control firmware for SolarEdge's solar power conversion products, including inverters, power optimizers, and energy storage converter.
Collaborating with cross-functional teams, including hardware engineers, embedded developers, and product/project managers, to define system requirements, design concepts/ideas and agreed with innovative architect embedded solutions.
Develop and implement efficient and reliable embedded digital control firmware in C/C++ for various microcontrollers and processors used in SolarEdge products.
Conduct thorough testing and verification of embedded control firmware to ensure its functionality, performance, and compliance with quality standards.

Participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback to team members and ensuring code quality and adherence to coding standards.

Ph.D. in Closed loop control firmware design and development for Power converter/Inverter/DC-DC Converter with 10+years of relevant industrial experience in embedded control firmware design and development.
Design and Implementation of embedded digital control algorithms in C/C++ for power converter, such as DC/AC Inverters and DC/DC converters operating at high switching frequency.
Strong knowledge and proven experience in developing control algorithms for Power electronics converters/Inverters.

Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, with a track record of delivering robust and reliable embedded software.

Excellent communication and teamwork skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Experience in the renewable energy or power electronics industry is an added advantage.
