job.title: Technical Lead - Power Electronics Design Review Engineer
job.snippet:
Description: About the Role
SolarEdge is seeking an experienced and highly skilled Technical Lead - Power Electronics Design Review (DR) Engineer to join the Quality & Reliability (QnR) organization.
In this role, you will serve as a technical assessor responsible for reviewing new power electronics designs throughout the product development cycle. Working closely with R&D, System Engineering, Hardware, Mechanical, Reliability, and Operations teams, you will independently analyze, calculate, simulate, and verify design robustness, ensuring products meet performance, quality, reliability, manufacturability, and safety requirements before release to production. The review will mainly include a high reliability and quality power electronic systems.
The ideal candidate combines deep hands-on Power converter design experience with strong analytical capabilities and excellent communication skills.
Responsibilities
Perform comprehensive Design reviews (DRs) for new SolarEdge products and technologies.
Review power electronics architectures from concept stage through production release.
Independently analyze and verify converter topologies, power stages, control loops, protection mechanisms, and overall system performance.
Conduct engineering calculations and simulations to validate design assumptions and identify technical risks.
Evaluate thermal design, component derating, power dissipation, cooling solutions, and long-term reliability.
Review magnetic component designs, including transformers, inductors, and current sensing elements.
Analyze EMC/EMI performance and filtering solutions.
Assess PCB layouts for electrical performance, creepage and clearance, manufacturability, reliability, and signal integrity.
Review processor-based designs, embedded hardware interfaces, and communication protocols.
Identify design weaknesses, reliability concerns, production risks, and field failure risks.
Issue detailed Design Review reports that document findings, recommendations, and corrective actions.
Present review results to QnR, R&D, and management teams.
Drive technical discussions and challenge design assumptions through fact-based engineering analysis.
Support root-cause investigations and provide technical guidance on reliability and quality issues when required.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams throughout the development process. | Requirements: Masters ( M.Tech / M.S ) in Power Electronics or Related Electrical & Electronics Engineering.
10+ years of proven experience in power electronics design and development.
Extensive experience taking products from concept and design stages through validation and mass production.
Deep understanding of DC/DC converters, inverters, rectifiers, and switched-mode power supplies.
Good knowledge of analog and digital circuit design.
Experience with power semiconductor technologies including MOSFETs, IGBTs, and SiC devices.
Strong experience in magnetic design, including transformer and inductor calculations.
Solid understanding of EMI/EMC design practices and filter design.
Experience with simulation tools such as LTspice, PSpice, Simplis, MATLAB/Simulink, or equivalent.
Familiarity with microcontrollers, DSPs, processors, and embedded hardware architectures.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
Excellent technical writing and presentation skills.
Ability to communicate findings effectively to engineers, managers, and executive stakeholders.
Optional Requirements ( Preferred )
Review of analog, digital, and mixed-signal circuits for functionality, robustness, and reliability.
Strong expertise in thermal design and thermal analysis.
Experience with industry communication protocols such as CAN, RS485, SPI, I²C, UART, Ethernet, and similar.
Experience in solar, renewable energy, energy storage, EV, UPS, or industrial power conversion products.
Familiarity with reliability engineering methodologies, failure analysis techniques, and design-for-reliability principles.
Knowledge of safety and regulatory standards applicable to power electronics products.
Experience conducting formal design reviews in multidisciplinary development environments.
Personal Attributes
Independent and highly analytical.
Detail-oriented with a passion for engineering excellence.
Strong technical leadership and influencing skills.
Comfortable challenging designs through evidence-based engineering analysis.
Excellent interpersonal and cross-functional communication abilities.
Committed to quality, reliability, and continuous improvement.

job.title: Technical Lead Engineer – Senior Power Electronics - Battery Systems
job.snippet:
Description: About the Role
We are seeking a strong Technical Lead Hardware Engineer to design the digital and mixed-signal boards at the heart of SolarEdge’s advanced energy storage products. This is a hands-on design role for an engineer with deep, real-world experience in the disciplines that make or break a mixed-signal design — grounding, EMI, robust communication, and accurate measurement — and in how these are verified at the board and full-system level.
What You’ll Be Doing
Define system architecture and converter topology selection for new product lines; conduct trade-off analysis on efficiency, cost, size, and reliability
Mentor and guide senior and junior engineers; review detailed designs, simulations, PCB layouts, firmware code, and test results
Review & Designing digital and mixed-signal boards, from concept through mass production
Review & Designing accurate measurements, robust communication, grounding, and power distribution — at both board and system level
Owning verification and characterization of your Project designs, on the bench and within the complete system
Taking technical ownership of subsystems and driving them independently
Contributing to design reviews and mentoring junior engineers
Working in a multidisciplinary environment and collaborating across departments and sites | Requirements: Requirements
B.Tech. in Electrical, Electronics Or related Engineering Streams. Masters/PhD is Preferred.
12+ years of hands-on mixed-signal HW design, taken to mass production
Deep expertise in precise analog measurement — accuracy budgeting, error sources, calibration — and in verifying accuracy at board and system level
Strong command of grounding, return-path, and power-distribution design
EMI/EMC design-for-compliance experience — designed in up front, not fixed late
Experience designing robust, noise-immune communication links (CAN, SPI, I2C, UART, differential) — protocol-agnostic; robustness, isolation, and signal integrity are what matter
Experience designing protection circuits (overvoltage, overcurrent, short circuit)
Knowledge of power electronics and DC-DC converters (Buck, Boost, Flyback, Forward)
Proficiency in simulation tools such as LTspice, PSpice, or PSIM
Strong problem-solving, debugging, and lab bring-up skills, with a systematic verification mindset
Experience with high-density, multilayer PCB layout
Strong command of AI tools and a demonstrated ability to leverage them to accelerate engineering work — analysis, documentation, scripting, and debugging
Strong documentation skills — design reviews and product lifecycle management
Advantageous Qualifications
Experience with Battery Management Systems (BMS) or energy storage technologies (Li-Ion, Solid State, etc.)
Familiarity with functional safety concepts and safety standards for battery and energy storage systems
Understanding of thermal management in electronic designs
Familiarity with regulatory compliance in electronics (CE, UL, etc.)

job.title: Flight Test Technician
job.snippet:
Description: Role Overview
Management, preparation, and direct technical support of the company’s ground and flight test operations. The role includes integration, installation, and testing of electro-optical/electronic test systems on ground test setups, operation of complex test equipment, and close collaboration with test managers and development engineers.
Key Responsibilities
Test Setup Preparation and Maintenance: Assembly, wiring, functional checks, and integration of ground stations and documentation/recording systems ahead of test days.
Ongoing Operation During Tests: Operating measurement systems, test equipment, video/IR imaging, and real-time data acquisition and download, on the ground and in the air (as needed).
Troubleshooting: Identifying and resolving hardware, cabling, communication, and power issues, both in the lab and under pressure in the field.
Test Logistics and Safety: Managing equipment cases, tools, and spare parts for field deployments, and ensuring full compliance with occupational safety rules and airfield/firing range procedures. | Requirements: Requirements (Mandatory)
Practical Engineer or Technician in Electronics, Instrumentation & Control, or Mechanical Engineering.
At least 3 years of experience as an integration, maintenance, or test technician in the defense industry or the Israeli Air Force.
Hands-on experience working with test equipment.
High technical proficiency: fine soldering, manufacturing and repairing wiring harnesses, reading electrical schematics, and mechanical assembly.
Willingness to work flexible and non-standard hours, including concentrated field days (with deployments to bases and remote test sites).
Good technical English (reading specifications and drawings, writing fault reports).
Valid security clearance (or eligibility to obtain one).
Significant Advantages
Background in an Israeli Air Force technical unit, such as a Level B/D technician at the IAF Flight Test Center.
Experience with installations on helicopters or transport/mission aircraft.
Willingness and medical approval to participate in test flights as needed.
Desired Personal Profile
Attention to Detail and Meticulousness (FOD / Safety Awareness): Must be able to work according to checklists and safety procedures.
Strong Hands-On Skills and Resourcefulness: Heightened situational awareness to identify and resolve faults in field conditions in an orderly, verified manner.
Teamwork and Interpersonal Skills: Ability to work effectively with development engineers, external contractors, and customers.

job.title: Hardware Design Engineer (Board Design)
job.snippet:
Description: BIRD Aerosystems is a global leader in the development of advanced airborne defense, intelligence, and surveillance solutions for military, governmental, and commercial aviation.
Our innovative technologies are deployed worldwide, supporting mission-critical operations and protecting aircraft through advanced multidisciplinary systems.
As we continue to grow, we are looking for a talented Hardware Design Engineer (Board Design) to join our Hardware Development team and contribute to the design and development of advanced electronic boards for complex aerospace and defense systems.
What You’ll Do
· Design, develop, and modify electronic boards throughout the entire product lifecycle.
· Perform board bring-up activities following development and initial manufacturing.
· Troubleshoot hardware issues, analyze failures, and implement design improvements.
· Edit schematics and support PCB layout activities.
· Improve product manufacturability and maintain production documentation.
· Support PCB manufacturers and electronic assembly subcontractors while ensuring compliance with IPC standards.
· Investigate manufacturing failures and provide engineering solutions.
· Work closely with multidisciplinary teams including Mechanical, Software, Firmware, and System Engineering.
· Participate in design reviews (PDR/CDR).
· Prepare engineering documentation, test procedures, and product verification documents.
Support the transition from development to production. | Requirements: · B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering / Electronics Engineering – Mandatory .
· Up to 5 years of professional experience in Hardware Design Engineering (excluding mandatory military service).
· Proven experience in analog board design and high-power power supply design – Mandatory .
· Hands-on experience performing board bring-up for digital boards and power supply boards – Mandatory .
· Experience with schematic editing and PCB layout support – Mandatory .
· Experience preparing and participating in design reviews (PDR/CDR) – Mandatory .
· Experience writing ATP and POD documentation – Mandatory .
· Experience supporting PCB manufacturing and electronic board assembly.
· Strong proficiency with OrCAD and Allegro .
· Excellent Microsoft Office skills.
· Fluent Hebrew and English.
Nice to Have
· Experience in the aerospace and defense industry.
· Experience working with complex multidisciplinary systems.
· Familiarity with IPC standards and production processes.
Strong understanding of development in compliance with MIL-STD and DO-160 testing standards
Why Join BIRD Aerosystems?
· Work on advanced aerospace and defense technologies with global impact.
· Take part in designing complex electronic systems deployed worldwide.
· Collaborate with experienced engineers across multiple disciplines.
· Join a professional, innovative, and growing organization.
· Develop your expertise in a challenging and technology-driven environment.
If you are passionate about hardware development, electronics, and advanced aerospace technologies, we would love to hear from you.

job.snippet:

We are seeking a hands-on Junior System Engineer to take overall technical ownership of an existing multidisciplinary system—from production and integration through ongoing product and customer support. you will lead engineering efforts to solve complex system-level issues manage engineering change orders (ECOs) and provide technical support to production lines and clients You will work cross-functionally with Hardware, Firmware, Software, Mechanical, QA, and Production teams.

Support system integration, testing, and troubleshooting activities in the laboratory and production environment.
Perform hands-on debugging and fault isolation across hardware, software, FPGA, and embedded subsystems.
Operate test equipment, including oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, power supplies, and Automated Test Equipment (ATE).
Own technical problems end to end: identify the issue, isolate the root cause, and drive a practical solution through to implementation and verification.

Maintain and update technical documentation, including test procedures, test reports, interface documentation, ECO, maintenance, and work instructions.

Familiarity with FPGA, MCU, and embedded software.

job.title: RT SW Developer
job.snippet:
Description: About the role
Bird Aerosystems is hiring a senior real-time embedded software engineer for a team of 11 that builds firmware for airborne systems.
The role sits at the hardware/software boundary. You will bring up new boards, write drivers and real-time firmware on ARM and FPGA-based platforms, and take features from design through lab integration to field trials. We are looking for an electronics engineer who writes production C/C++ and is at home with a scope and a schematic. | Requirements: Responsibilities
Design and develop real-time embedded software in C/C++ on ARM-based platforms (STM32, Xilinx Zynq / UltraScale+) under an RTOS or bare metal
Bring up new boards: low-level drivers, BSP, bootloader and embedded Linux kernel adaptation
Implement and integrate communication interfaces and protocols (SPI, I2C, UART, RS-422/485, Ethernet, TCP/IP)
Work closely with hardware, FPGA and RF engineers to define and debug HW/SW interfaces
Debug in the lab with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers and JTAG debuggers
Implement and optimize signal-processing and control algorithms on embedded targets
Build PC-side test, simulation and automation tools (Python, C#)
Own modules end to end: requirements, design, documentation, integration, testing and field trials
Requirements
B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Electrical or Electronics Engineering
5+ years of hands-on real-time embedded software development
Strong C and C++ on ARM microcontrollers or SoCs
Development on an RTOS (e.g. VxWorks, FreeRTOS, uC/OS, INTEGRITY) or bare metal, not only embedded Linux
Proven board bring-up and low-level driver/BSP experience, including lab debugging with a scope and logic analyzer
Hands-on experience with peripheral and communication interfaces: SPI, I2C, UART, RS-422/485, Ethernet, TCP/IP
Professional working English (reading and writing technical documents)
﻿Advantages
Strong advantage:
Signal processing, communications or RF background: DSP algorithms, SDR, modems, radar, image or video processing
FPGA exposure (VHDL/Verilog, Xilinx Vivado or Intel Quartus), enough to work closely with FPGA developers
Defense, airborne, UAV or electro-optical systems experience
Built a system from scratch through integration and field trials
Writes own PC-side tools in Python, C#, Qt or LabVIEW
Nice to have:
Xilinx Zynq / UltraScale+ experience
Embedded Linux kernel, u-boot and Yocto/Buildroot
Technical leadership or module ownership in a small team
DO-178 or another safety-critical development process
Hebrew

job.title: Structural Engineering Analyst
job.snippet:
Description: The successful applicant will perform advanced structural, stress, and fatigue analyses to ensure the safety, durability, and compliance of aerospace components.
You will bridge the gap between initial concepts and final, certified designs by validating both metallic and composite structures using a mix of traditional hand calculations and modern finite element modeling (FEM) software. | Requirements: Education & Experience
• B.Sc or M.Sc in Mechanical or Aeronautical Engineering.
• Experience of 5+ years of hands-on structural analyses in the aerospace industry, including stress, structural dynamics response, fatigue and damage tolerance analyses.
Knowledge of metallic and composite material behaviour and analytical methods.
Technical Skills
• Perform stress analysis using classical hand calculations (Bruhn, Niu, Roark…) conventional analytical tools in static/dynamic stress analysis.
• Experience with using finite element analysis (structural computational tools). Experience with NASTRAN/PATRAN/APEX - advantage.
• Perform fatigue and metal damage tolerance analyses. Experience with NASGRO or AFGRO - advantage.
• Ability to work in teamwork with structural design group members.
Standards & Compliance
• Previous experience in working with specifications & requirements for civilian aircraft (FAA, EASA, JAA…) - an advantage.

job.title: Business Manager
job.snippet:
Working in Business means always seeing the full picture. You spot the trend, align the stakeholders, and don't rest until you see the move through. From partnerships to revenue operations, those who thrive here are commercially minded, analytical, and excited to solve problems without obvious solutions. So if you're a born strategist who never leaves anything unfinished, the Fiverr Business team has just the job for you.
We are looking for a highly strategic and accountable
Business Manager
to lead high-impact projects that drive business growth across Fiverr's ecosystem. This role requires an Entrepreneurial mindset and ownership mentality, with a focus on identifying opportunities, building actionable plans, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to bring them to life. You’ll need to think like a business owner, considering market research and trends, resource allocation, and product enhancements to drive success.
What am I going to do?:
Opportunity Identification: Research and analyze new market opportunities, identifying growth potential, target audiences, and competitive gaps.
Strategic Project Leadership: Develop and execute structured, cross-functional plans to launch or grow initiatives, ensuring alignment with Fiverr’s goals.
Entrepreneurial Mindset: Apply a data-driven, business-owner approach to assess revenue potential and prioritize actions with the highest ROI.
Collaboration & Leadership: Work closely with teams across product, marketing, taxonomy, and data to drive execution, ensuring deliverables are met.
Performance Tracking: Define and track KPIs to measure success, iterating on strategies based on data insights.
Data-Driven Decisions: Use insights and analytics to guide priorities and measure project impact.
Stakeholder Communication: Present findings, updates, and recommendations to leadership with clarity and impact.
Creative Problem-Solving: Identify and address gaps or challenges in Fiverr’s offerings with innovative, practical solutions.
Requirements:
5+ years of experience in category management, e-commerce, or cross-functional project leadership.
Strong market research and user analysis capabilities, with the ability to identify market opportunities, understand customer needs and behaviors, assess competitive landscapes, and translate insights into actionable strategies that support GTM planning and execution.
Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to use data to inform strategic decisions.
Strong technical orientation and the ability to manage development-related domains, including an understanding of web and AI technologies, code workflows, and mobile app environments
Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to identify and capitalize on market trends.
Excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills to align diverse teams around common goals.
Adaptable and results-oriented, capable of thriving in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Experience in launching new verticals, products, or services is a strong advantage.
Equal opportunities:
At Fiverr, we prioritize diversity. We celebrate difference and embed it into every aspect of our workplace and product, as well as our community. Fiverr is proud and committed to providing equal opportunity employment to all individuals regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, citizenship, national origin, disability, Veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. In addition, Fiverr will provide accommodation to individuals with disabilities or a special need.

job.title: Channel Manager
job.snippet:
Description: Location: remote within Europe
Reports to Head of Partnerships
About Driivz
Driivz, a Vontier company, powers the e-mobility revolution with a market-leading, end-to-end EV charging and energy management platform for global charge point operators and electric mobility service providers. We offer a scalable, integrated SaaS solution that ensures a seamless charging experience and drives high driver retention for leading EV charging networks such as EVgo, Shell, Circle K, Mer, and Volvo Group. Driivz facilitates the global transition to a forward-looking EV charging ecosystem by powering networks in more than 35 countries across the U.S., Europe, and Asia, with its platform supporting over 3 million charging ports and more than 6 million EV drivers worldwide.
Join our team and work alongside brilliant, disruptive minds focused on leading the e-mobility industry and building a greener world.
The role
We are looking for a Channel Manager to build and scale our partner channel across Europe. job.title: CRO
job.snippet:
Description: Driivz, a Vontier company, powers the e-mobility revolution with a market-leading, end-to-end EV charging and energy management platform for global charge point operators and electric mobility service providers.
We offer a scalable, integrated SaaS solution that ensures a seamless charging experience and drives high driver retention for leading EV charging networks such as EVgo, Shell, Circle K, Mer, and Volvo Group.
Driivz facilitates the global transition to a forward-looking EV charging ecosystem by powering networks in more than 35 countries across the U.S., Europe, and Asia, with its platform supporting over 3 million charging ports and more than 6 million EV drivers worldwide.
Join our team and work alongside brilliant, disruptive minds focused on leading the e-mobility industry and building a greener world.
﻿
﻿Role Overview
We are seeking an experienced, strategic, and hands-on Head of Sales / Commercial to lead our global sales function, drive long-term growth, and expand our footprint with enterprise utilities and large-scale partners. This leader will own revenue delivery, commercial strategy, and the execution of complex multi-million-dollar deals.
This is a high-impact leadership role requiring deep SaaS experience, strong familiarity with the EV / Energy management ecosystem, and a proven ability to manage global teams and deliver annual sales of tens of millions of dollars.
Key Responsibilities
• Lead and scale the global sales organization, including regional directors, account executives, and pre-sales teams.
• Develop and execute a comprehensive commercial strategy aligned with company growth goals and market expansion.
• Own the full enterprise sales cycle, including pipeline creation, forecasting, contracting, and long-term commercial partnerships.
• Drive new business with Tier-1 and Tier-2 utilities, charge point operators, commercials, energy retailers, and large-scale enterprise customers.
• Build and maintain C-level relationships with strategic accounts, partners, and industry stakeholders.
• Manage annual revenue targets in the tens of millions of dollars, ensuring predictable growth and strong unit economics.
• Partner cross-functionally with Product, R&D, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and Customer Success to support commercial execution.
• Establish a data-driven sales culture with clear KPIs, governance processes, and ongoing team coaching.
• Represent Driivz at global industry events, conferences, and customer forums.
Requirements
• 10+ years of experience in enterprise SaaS sales, including at least 5 years selling into Tier-1 or Tier-2 utilities or large energy companies.
• Proven track record of managing annual sales quotas of tens of millions of dollars and consistently overachieving targets.
• Experience leading global sales teams across multiple regions and time zones.
Deep understanding of SaaS commercial models, complex enterprise procurement processes, and long-cycle sales motions.
• Strong executive presence and ability to build trust with C-level stakeholders.
• Demonstrated experience driving large, multi-year, multi-market deals.
High analytical capability with strong forecasting, pipeline management, and data-driven decision-making.
• Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
• Experience in the EV, utilities, or energy-tech sectors — advantage.
Personal Attributes
• Strategic thinker with strong operational execution.
Highly collaborative, low-ego, and comfortable in both scale-up and corporate environments.
• Resilient, proactive, and thrives in a fast-moving, global SaaS environment.
• Strong leadership presence with the ability to inspire high-performing teams.
Success Indicators
• Achievement of annual global revenue targets.
• Growth of strategic Tier-1/2 utility accounts.
• Scalable commercial processes and improved forecasting accuracy.
• Strong cross-company collaboration and customer satisfaction.

job.title: Junior Battery Data Analytics & Algorithm Engineer
job.snippet:
Power the Future with us!
At SolarEdge (NASDAQ: SEDG), we're a global leader in smart energy technology, with over 3,000 employees, offices in 34 countries, and millions of installations worldwide.
Our innovative solutions include solar inverters, battery storage, backup systems, EV charging, and AI-based energy management. We're committed to making clean, green energy the primary power source for homes, businesses, and beyond.
With the growing demand for electricity, the need for smart, clean energy sources is constantly rising. SolarEdge offers amazing opportunities to develop your skills in a multidisciplinary environment, covering everything from research and development to production and customer supply. Work with talented colleagues, tackle exciting challenges, and help create a sustainable future in an industry that's always evolving and innovating. Join us and be part of a company that values creativity, agility, and impactful work.
We are looking for a curious, analytical, and hands-on engineer to help us understand and improve how our batteries perform, both in the lab and in the field. You will design and run experiments, work with large sets of battery data, leverage AI and automation tools, and collaborate closely with algorithm, hardware, software, and system teams to turn insights into real product improvements.
Responsibilities:
Design, own, and execute battery testing in the lab, from test planning and setup through data collection, analysis, and documentation.
Analyze experimental data and apply statistical methods to identify trends, anomalies, and actionable insights.
Leverage AI tools to accelerate data analysis, automate repetitive tasks, and improve development efficiency.
Build and maintain dashboards that provide clear visibility into test progress, results, and battery performance.
Manage testing activities, priorities, and timelines in Jira, ensuring clear communication and alignment with relevant stakeholders.
Analyze field and fleet data from deployed batteries to identify trends, validate assumptions, and drive improvements in battery performance and algorithms.
Collaborate with algorithm developers to develop and validate battery management algorithms, translating lab and field findings into algorithmic improvements.
Work cross-functionally with hardware, software, systems, and algorithm teams to understand the broader product impact of test results.
Troubleshoot technical issues, perform root cause analysis, and clearly document findings, test methodologies, and algorithm logic.
Requirements:
BSc in Industrial Engineering and Management, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Exact Sciences, or a related quantitative/engineering field.
Hands-on experience using AI tools, such as LLM assistants or AI-assisted coding tools, as part of day-to-day technical work.
Experience building and maintaining data dashboards.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and failure-analysis skills.
High level of ownership, initiative, and ability to work independently while seeing the broader system and product picture.
Ability to collaborate effectively in a multidisciplinary environment.
Strong organizational skills and attention to high-quality technical documentation.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
Nice to have:
Understanding of battery technologies, battery management systems (BMS), or electrochemical systems.
Experience with laboratory testing, test equipment, algorithm development, or data modeling.
Programming and data-analysis experience with Python and/or MATLAB.
Strong Excel skills and experience working with SQL.

job.title: Diagnostic Technician
job.snippet:
Imagry is looking for an electrical, software, electronics, or mechatronics practical engineer to perform testing, integration, and upgrades on autonomous vehicles. The role includes work from our Haifa office as well as field activity in Nahariya and around the world.
Responsibilities:
You will be responsible for implementing software and hardware systems in autonomous vehicles and buses, identifying and reporting faults, and working closely with integration and software teams. This is an opportunity to join the forefront of the global autonomous driving industry and gain hands-on experience working with advanced systems and testing capabilities in real field conditions with real vehicles (not just simulations).
Requirements:
Practical Engineer degree in electronics, software or mechanics.
Experience in diagnosing and maintaining electronic systems. Automotive experience is a great advantage (passenger car / bus).
Ability to read schematics and understand both software and electrical systems in passenger cars and / or buses.
Experience with advanced diagnostic equipment for vehicle diagnosis.
Understanding of computer hardware, with the ability to build and upgrade computerized systems (e.g. high-end gaming PCs).
Willing to perform electrical and software tests and ride an autonomous vehicle/bus for several hours a day in varying weather conditions.
Willing to work in the field under pressure and meet deadlines.
Willing to travel abroad for extended periods (2–4 weeks at a time) several times a year.
High proficiency in both English and Hebrew, in order to communicate with teams in Israel and worldwide.
Valid passenger vehicle driver's license — mandatory.
Familiarity with the autonomous vehicle field — an advantage.
Location: Haifa, Israel
job.description:
Imagry is looking for an electrical, software, electronics, or mechatronics practical engineer to perform testing, integration, and upgrades on autonomous vehicles. The role includes work from our Haifa office as well as field activity in Nahariya and around the world.
Responsibilities:
You will be responsible for implementing software and hardware systems in autonomous vehicles and buses, identifying and reporting faults, and working closely with integration and software teams. This is an opportunity to join the forefront of the global autonomous driving industry and gain hands-on experience working with advanced systems and testing capabilities in real field conditions with real vehicles (not just simulations).
Requirements:
Practical Engineer degree in electronics, software or mechanics.
Experience in diagnosing and maintaining electronic systems. Automotive experience is a great advantage (passenger car / bus).
Ability to read schematics and understand both software and electrical systems in passenger cars and / or buses.
Experience with advanced diagnostic equipment for vehicle diagnosis.
Understanding of computer hardware, with the ability to build and upgrade computerized systems (e.g. high-end gaming PCs).
Willing to perform electrical and software tests and ride an autonomous vehicle/bus for several hours a day in varying weather conditions.
Willing to work in the field under pressure and meet deadlines.
Willing to travel abroad for extended periods (2–4 weeks at a time) several times a year.
High proficiency in both English and Hebrew, in order to communicate with teams in Israel and worldwide.
Valid passenger vehicle driver's license — mandatory.
Familiarity with the autonomous vehicle field — an advantage.
Location: Haifa, Israel

Network & Information Security Engineer | Central Israel
Mertens – MalamTeam is hiring a Network & Information Security Engineer

Key Responsibilities
Design and implement network and security solutions, including HLD and LLD documentation and hands-on implementation
Monitor and analyze network traffic for security, troubleshooting, and performance optimization
Lead networking and information security projects, manage complex systems, and collaborate with external vendors
Requirements
At least 5 years of experience deploying, managing, and operating Enterprise networks and security infrastructure
Proven experience with Cisco equipment, Load Balancing, and Firewall solutions
Experience with Radware and Imperva products for WAF and Layer 7 DDoS protection
Deep knowledge of BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, VPN, IPsec, SSL, QoS, and 802.1X protocols
Experience with network security solutions, Firewalls, IPS, and anomaly detection, particularly Cisco, Fortinet, Check Point, and Palo Alto

הכנת ניירות עבודה ועבודה שוטפת מול רו"ח מבקר.
עבודה מול מחלקת הנהלת החשבונות ומנהלת החשבונות הראשית.
ניהול ובקרה על תהליכי בקרה פנימית ו-ISOX.
הכנת דוחות ניהוליים וביצוע בקרות פיננסיות.
מעורבות בפרויקטים כלכליים וחשבונאיים נוספים.

יכולת אנליטית גבוהה וירידה לפרטים.
יכולת עבודה עצמאית לצד עבודה בצוות.
יחסי אנוש מצוינים ויכולת עבודה מול ממשקים מרובים.

job.snippet:

כלמוביל
ראש העין
3-4 שנים

הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
מטרת התפקיד:
ניהול ותפעול חשבות השכר בכלמוביל בתהליכים החודשיים ובפרויקטים רלוונטיים, תוך הקפדה על מצוינות תפעולית, דיוק הנתונים, מענה לעובדים, עמידה ברגולציה ובקרות שכר תקינות – כל זאת על מנת להבטיח חוויית עובד מיטבית.
איך יראה היום שלך?
הפקת שכר ובקרות: ניהול מלא של תהליך הפקת השכר החודשי לכלל עובדי החברה, לרבות עמידה בלוחות זמנים, ביצוע בקרות ואימות נתונים, וניהול איכות הנתונים ובקרה על מידע ממערכות משאבי אנוש (SAP).
טיפול בתיקים מורכבים: טיפול בנושאי שכר מורכבים, כולל גמרי העסקה, פיצויים, הסדרי העסקה מיוחדים וזכאויות, תוך הבטחת עמידה מלאה בדרישות החוק, הרגולציה ודיני העבודה.
ניהול צוות ופיתוח מקצועי: הובלה מקצועית של צוות חשבות השכר, חלוקת משימות, הדרכה, ליווי שוטף והטמעת נהלים וסטנדרטים.
ניהול פרויקטים ומערכות: הובלת פרויקטים בתחום השכר והנוכחות (אוטומציה, שיפור תהליכים ושדרוג מערכות), הטמעת חברות בנות במערך השכר, וניהול ביקורות שכר מול רואי חשבון ורשויות (מס הכנסה, ביטוח לאומי, גופים פנסיוניים).
ממשקים ארגוניים: עבודה שוטפת מול יחידות משאבי אנוש, כספים ומנהלים בארגון, ומתן מענה מקצועי ויעיל.

job.title: Junior Battery Data Analytics & Algorithm Engineer
job.snippet:
Description: Power the Future with us!
At SolarEdge (NASDAQ: SEDG), we're a global leader in smart energy technology, with over 3,000 employees, offices in 34 countries, and millions of installations worldwide.
Our innovative solutions include solar inverters, battery storage, backup systems, EV charging, and AI-based energy management. We're committed to making clean, green energy the primary power source for homes, businesses, and beyond.
With the growing demand for electricity, the need for smart, clean energy sources is constantly rising. SolarEdge offers amazing opportunities to develop your skills in a multidisciplinary environment, covering everything from research and development to production and customer supply. Work with talented colleagues, tackle exciting challenges, and help create a sustainable future in an industry that's always evolving and innovating. Join us and be part of a company that values creativity, agility, and impactful work.
We are looking for a curious, analytical, and hands-on engineer to help us understand and improve how our batteries perform, both in the lab and in the field. You will design and run experiments, work with large sets of battery data, leverage AI and automation tools, and collaborate closely with algorithm, hardware, software, and system teams to turn insights into real product improvements.
Responsibilities:
Design, own, and execute battery testing in the lab, from test planning and setup through data collection, analysis, and documentation.
Analyze experimental data and apply statistical methods to identify trends, anomalies, and actionable insights.
Leverage AI tools to accelerate data analysis, automate repetitive tasks, and improve development efficiency.
Build and maintain dashboards that provide clear visibility into test progress, results, and battery performance.
Manage testing activities, priorities, and timelines in Jira, ensuring clear communication and alignment with relevant stakeholders.
Analyze field and fleet data from deployed batteries to identify trends, validate assumptions, and drive improvements in battery performance and algorithms.
Collaborate with algorithm developers to develop and validate battery management algorithms, translating lab and field findings into algorithmic improvements.
Work cross-functionally with hardware, software, systems, and algorithm teams to understand the broader product impact of test results.
Troubleshoot technical issues, perform root cause analysis, and clearly document findings, test methodologies, and algorithm logic. | Requirements: BSc in Industrial Engineering and Management, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Exact Sciences , or a related quantitative/engineering field.
Hands-on experience using AI tools , such as LLM assistants or AI-assisted coding tools, as part of day-to-day technical work.
Experience building and maintaining data dashboards .
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and failure-analysis skills.
High level of ownership, initiative, and ability to work independently while seeing the broader system and product picture.
Ability to collaborate effectively in a multidisciplinary environment.
Strong organizational skills and attention to high-quality technical documentation.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
Nice to have:
Understanding of battery technologies, battery management systems (BMS), or electrochemical systems.
Experience with laboratory testing, test equipment, algorithm development, or data modeling.
Programming and data-analysis experience with Python and/or MATLAB .
Strong Excel skills and experience working with SQL .

job.title: Subsidiaries Assistant Controller
job.snippet:
Description: Power the Future with us!
SolarEdge (NASDAQ: SEDG), is a global leader in high-performance smart energy technology, with over 5000 employees, offices in 34 countries, and millions of products installed in over 133 countries. Our diverse product offering comprises intelligent solar inverters, battery storage, backup systems, EV charging, and complete home energy management ecosystems.
By leveraging world-class engineering capabilities and a relentless focus on innovation, we strive to create a world where clean, green energy from the sun is the primary source of power for our homes, businesses, and just about everywhere we thrive.
About the role
We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Subsidiaries Assistant Controller to join our global finance team.
This role offers the opportunity to own financial reporting and accounting processes across SolarEdge's international subsidiaries, work closely with global finance teams, and contribute to the company's financial operations and reporting.
Key responsibilities:
Oversee day-to-day accounting and financial activities across SolarEdge's international subsidiaries.
Review and support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing processes, ensuring accuracy and timely reporting.
Work closely with local finance teams, providing professional guidance and ensuring alignment with corporate accounting policies.
Review financial statements, general ledger reconciliations, and supporting schedules.
Manage and monitor intercompany transactions, balances, and reconciliations.
Prepare financial analyses and supporting information for quarterly and annual reporting.
Ensure compliance with corporate reporting requirements, internal controls, and applicable accounting standards.
Support transfer pricing processes and ongoing tax-related matters in coordination with corporate tax teams.
Collaborate with corporate accounting, FP&A, treasury, tax, and other finance functions.
Identify opportunities to improve financial processes, strengthen controls, and increase operational efficiency.
Participate in cross-functional initiatives, system implementations, and ad hoc finance projects. | Requirements: Certified Public Accountant (CPA) with experience at a Big Four accounting firm.
Strong knowledge of accounting principles and financial reporting.
Excellent analytical skills and attention to detail.
Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
Advanced Excel skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across global teams.
Independent, proactive, and hands-on approach with strong problem-solving abilities.
Advantages qualifications:
Previous experience in a global or multinational company.
Familiarity with US GAAP and international financial reporting requirements.
Experience working with ERP systems, particularly Oracle.
Experience with consolidation processes and intercompany accounting.

We are looking for electrical Engineer/Technician who is eager to grow into a customer-facing technical expert, combining hands-on technical work with customer interaction and exposure to real-world system applications.
The role supports global activities and offers the opportunity to work closely with customers and cross-functional teams. As part of a global environment, the role requires flexibility and collaboration across different time zones.
Key Responsibilities:
Work closely with Sales and R&D teams to define solutions based on customer needs and requirements.
Have detailed technical knowledge on company products.
Participate in technical discussions with customers to understand requirements.
Provide pre-sale technical support.
Interface with Sales, Project Management, and Configuration Management throughout the project lifecycle.
Support preparation of technical proposals (RFIs/RFPs/RFQs) and compliance matrices.
Support global customers, including occasional availability outside standard hours.
Requirements:
B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering or a Practical Electrical Engineering– Mandatory.
Strong technical knowledge of electrical equipment.
Prior experience in technical pre-sales activities, including customer engagement, solution presentations, and support throughout the sales process.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to learn quickly.
High motivation to grow in a technical, customer-facing role.
Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken).
Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional, team-oriented environment.
Advantages:
Experience in a technical customer-facing role (Application Engineer, Technical Support, Pre/Post-Sales Engineering).
Background in Power solutions, embedded systems.
Experience Writing Technical Documentation (including Proposals, Datasheets, System Descriptions).
Hands-on experience with system integration, lab work, or troubleshooting.

job.title: QA Automation Engineer
job.snippet:
Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us.
At Itron, we're building the digital foundation for the next generation of utility infrastructure. Our Resiliency Solutions business helps the world's largest energy providers modernize how they plan, build, inspect, and operate the networks that power communities every day. As utilities invest hundreds of billions of dollars in grid modernization, storm hardening, renewable integration, and critical infrastructure expansion, we're creating the platform that connects the field, the office, and the enterprise in real time.
Joining our team means becoming part of Locusview, Itron's fast-growing Resiliency Solutions business unit, a unique environment that combines the speed, innovation, and entrepreneurial spirit of a technology startup with the scale, resources, and global reach of an industry leader. This is more than a product opportunity; it's a chance to help shape a rapidly expanding platform at the center of one of the world's largest infrastructure transformations. As we continue to expand into new markets, workflows, technologies, and use cases, the opportunities to grow, innovate, and make a lasting impact are virtually limitless.
Position Overview
The Automation Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining automated test frameworks and scripts to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of our products. The role works closely with QA, developers, and product managers to deliver scalable and robust test automation solutions across the system.
Duties And Responsibilities
Join one of our R&D teams and collaborate with developers to design, build, and test innovative solutions.
Research, design, and execute test plans to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of new and existing features.
Design and implement automation architecture, transitioning from end-to-end UI testing to code-level automation.
Analyze existing R&D processes and develop automation infrastructure to improve unit testing, API testing, and overall test coverage.
Design, develop, and execute automated functional and regression tests for software products.
Maintain and enhance the existing automation infrastructure and automated test suites.
Participate in design and code reviews to ensure high-quality, testable software.
Document, analyze, and communicate automation test results and quality metrics.
Investigate test failures and perform root cause analysis to identify and resolve issues.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines by integrating, maintaining, and improving automated tests.
Continuously learn new technologies and proactively expand technical and professional skills.
﻿
Required Skills And Experience
At least 4+ years of experience in QA Automation
Strong hands-on experience with UI automation frameworks using TypeScript, for web and mobile applications.
Familiarity with Java-based backend applications and frontend technologies such as Angular or React, including an understanding of client-server architecture and end-to-end testing.
Experience with REST APIs, JSON, and API testing tools (e.g., Postman)
Hands-on experience with AI-powered tools to improve test automation, test case generation, debugging, and overall QA efficiency.
Experience testing GIS-based applications or working with geospatial data, including maps, coordinates, and spatial data validation.
Experience working with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins)
Familiarity with relational databases (SQL)
Experience with manual testing of mobile applications, including functional, exploratory, and regression testi ng.
Understanding of Agile software development methodologies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong time management, prioritization, and communication skills
Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for!
The successful candidate's starting wage will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience.
Itron is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you require an accommodation to apply, please contact a recruiting representative at 1-800-635-5461 or email Accessibility@itron.com.
Itron is transforming how the world manages energy, water and city services. Our trusted intelligent infrastructure solutions help utilities and cities improve efficiency, build resilience and deliver safe, reliable and affordable service. With edge intelligence, we connect people, data insights and devices so communities can better manage the essential resources they rely on to live. Join us as we create a more resourceful world: www.itron.com

job.title: Maintenance Engineer
job.snippet:
Company Description
Epsilor Electric Fuel Ltd. designs and manufactures advanced batteries, chargers, and wearable power electronics for demanding professional applications, including defense, aerospace, medical, marine, railway, and safety markets. Its products support people and systems operating in extreme environments and critical missions, from global yacht races and rough-terrain trains to innovative cancer treatment devices and LEO satellites in more than 50 countries. The company’s engineering teams specialize in multiple electro-chemistries, power electronics, and Battery Management Systems (BMS), enabling robust and reliable power solutions. Epsilor Electric Fuel is a fully owned subsidiary of Arotech Corporation, providing the stability and resources of a larger technology group while maintaining a focus on innovation in power systems.
Role Description
This is a full-time, on-site Maintenance Engineer role based in Beit Shemesh. The Maintenance Engineer will be responsible for performing routine and corrective maintenance on production equipment and facility systems to ensure continuous and safe operation. Daily tasks include diagnosing mechanical and electrical issues, coordinating repairs, executing preventive maintenance plans, and documenting maintenance activities in accordance with company procedures. The role involves collaborating with production, engineering, and quality teams to minimize downtime, support process improvements, and maintain compliance with safety and operational standards. The Maintenance Engineer will also help implement upgrades to equipment and contribute to reliability and efficiency initiatives across the site.
Qualifications
Candidates should possess strong skills in Equipment Maintenance and general Maintenance & Repair for industrial machinery and systems.
Candidates should possess Maintenance Engineering experience, including troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and reliability-focused improvements.
Candidates should possess expertise in Preventive Maintenance, including planning, scheduling, and executing maintenance routines.
Candidates should possess Electrical Maintenance skills, including working with electrical panels, controls, and safety procedures.
Relevant technical education (e.g., diploma or degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering, or similar field).
Experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment, ideally related to electronics, batteries, or high-tech production.
Ability to read technical drawings and equipment manuals, and use diagnostic tools and maintenance management software.
Strong commitment to safety, attention to detail, and the ability to work both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.

job.snippet:
דרוש/ה מנהל/ת חשמל למפעל תעשייתי | רכב צמוד | אשדוד
(877270)
תיאור המשרה
יש לך ניסיון בניהול צוותי חשמל בתעשייה, יכולת להתמודד עם אתגרים טכניים מורכבים ורצון להוביל מערך חשמל במפעל גדול?
למפעל מוביל בתחום עיבוד הברזל באשדוד דרוש/ה מנהל/ת חשמל לתפקיד ניהולי משמעותי, המשלב הובלת צוות מקצועי, אחריות על מערכות החשמל וקווי הייצור, פתרון תקלות מורכבות והובלת פרויקטים לשדרוג ופיתוח תשתיות החשמל במפעל.

Description: Power the Future with us!
At SolarEdge (NASDAQ: SEDG), we're a global leader in smart energy technology, with over 3,000 employees, offices in 20+ countries, and millions of installations worldwide.
Our innovative solutions include solar inverters, battery storage, backup systems, EV charging, and AI-based energy management. We're committed to making clean, green energy the primary power source for homes, businesses, and beyond.
With the growing demand for electricity, the need for smart, clean energy sources is constantly rising. SolarEdge offers amazing opportunities to develop your skills in a multidisciplinary environment, covering everything from research and development to production and customer supply. Work with talented colleagues, tackle exciting challenges, and help create a sustainable future in an industry that's always evolving and innovating. Join us and be part of a company that values creativity, agility, and impactful work.
The Integration Engineer will develop, perform and analyze System Validation tests and will take part in the system review processes, with an understanding of the market requirement, system design, and the end user’s expectations.
